How to Create a Google Map With Excel Data and Fusion Tables'
Creating maps of data from Excel and Google Fusion Tables is now easier than ever! While it can require a bit of setup, once it's complete it can be useful for tracking customer locations, demographics, and more. Here's how to create a Google map with Excel data and Fusion Tables.

First, get your information together. You'll need an Excel or .csv file that has information you need to track, such as addresses, customer names, or sales numbers.

Next, log into Google Fusion Tables. You can access this at https://www.google.com/fusiontables/data?dsrcid=im. Once you're signed in, you'll see a list of public tables. To create a new table, click "Create Table" on the left.

Once you've clicked "Create Table," the "Import" page will pop-up in a new browser tab or window, so be sure it isn't blocked by any pop-up blockers on your computer. To upload your .csv file, click the "Choose File" button in the import page. After you have selected your file, click "Next" to start uploading.

The final import screen will allow you to set any table descriptions. This is optional, but it can provide additional context for the data. Once you have provided any information you'd like, click "Finish".

Now, in order for people to be able to see this data outside of the Fusion Tables site, we'll have to "share" it. Click the "Share" button on the main table page. You should see a variety of options for sharing, and you'll need to choose at least one as "Public on the web."

Once you have your address data and it's on Google's site, it's time to map it! From the Fusion Tables main page, click the "Map" tab on the top right of the page. Then, click the link on the right that says "Get Embeddable Link."

A new window will appear with some HTML code that shows a map made with your data. You may have noticed, however, that not all of the addresses were translated to a map location. To finish up, you can "manually" move a map marker.

To do this, go back to the Fusion Tables main page and click the "Map" tab. This time, scroll towards the bottom until you see the Location Selector window. You can use this window to search for the exact location of the address you need to pin, or you can use the text box to put in an address to search for. Keeping changing your search until is displays a green marker where you want it, then click that green marker and select "Use This Location". This will add a blue marker to your map, and people will be able to see the address for the data you're trying to represent. And that's it! You now have a Google Map with Excel data and Fusion Tables.

Creating a stuffed chicken breast is a great way to add some pizzazz to a dinner plate. Whether you go for a classic preparation like chicken kiev or a creative combination like a savory apple filling, stuffing chicken breasts can make a delicious and impressive meal. Here's how to make stuffed chicken breast in a few simple steps. 

To begin, buy thick boneless, skinless chicken breasts. Lay the chicken breast on a cutting board and pierce into the side with a small knife. Slice across the entire side, then expand the cut using your fingers. You should end up with a deep pocket where you'll place the stuffing. 

Now, it's time to prepare the stuffing. Chicken kiev is a classic type of stuffed chicken breast and requires a few ingredients, like butter, garlic, shallot, lemon juice, parsley, and dill. Once you've mixed them all together, spoon the mixture into the pocket in the chicken breast, making sure to keep some back to spread over the top. 

You can also try something more creative with your stuffing. For a cheesy pepperoni stuffing, you'll need pepperoni, mozzarella, Parmesan and some oregano. Layer these ingredients into the pocket in the chicken breast, making sure to keep some back to sprinkle over the top. 

For a Mediterranean flavoured stuffing try using red bell pepper, feta cheese, kalamata olives and basil. Mix these together, then stuff the pocket in the chicken. 

You can also try something a little sweeter with a savory apple filling. For this version, dice an apple into cubes then mix it with cooked bacon, onion, garlic, sage, and thyme. Spoon the mixture into the pocket of the chicken breast. 

Once you've filled the chicken breast with your chosen stuffing, close the opening and secure the sides together. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C), then season the top of the chicken as desired. Bake for 20 minutes or until fully cooked, then enjoy your delicious and impressive stuffed chicken breast.

How to Draft a Recording Contract
Drafting a recording contract for an artist can be a daunting task, especially since contract language can be difficult to understand. However, with enough time and effort it is possible for anyone to write an effective and fair recording contract. Here are a few tips for creating a recording contract for an artist.

Format the document. First, format the contract properly. A recording contract typically includes a heading, title of the contract, opening paragraphs, where the parties in the contract are identified, then a number of sections which are detailed below. 

Add the title. Make sure to add the title of the contract so that the document is set apart from any other legal documents that may have been generated.

Identify the parties to the contract. A recording contract is typically between a label, singer or band, and sometimes the producer.

Insert your recitals. Recitals are introductory statements that explain the intention of the parties in the contract.

Include a definition section. It is important to include definitions of terms that may be used throughout the contract or may be of legal interest. 

Clarify the artist’s recording obligations. The contract should detail, in plain language, the artist’s recording obligations in regard to the label. It should also clarify how long the recording session should last, how many sessions are anticipated, and the expected methods of payment. 

Identify costs which will not be charged back. Any additional expenses such as studio time, equipment rentals, and/or sessions with other musicians that the artist may be responsible for should be clearly stated in the contract.

Include an “overcall album” provision. An overcall album provision is a section in the contract that specifies what happens when the label has more music than can be released on one album.

Add an exclusivity provision. An exclusivity provision specifies whether or not the label has the right to demand a certain amount of exclusive rights to the artist’s music.

Add a non-compete clause. This clause details the label’s rights to prevent the artist from working with any other record labels if the artist decides to terminate the contract for any reason.

Identify any deposit the artist paid. If the artist paid a deposit in advance of signing the contract, this should be identified in the contract.

Explain how the artist will pay the balance of the recording fees. It is important to include information about how the artist will pay the balance owed to the label for the services rendered.

Explain how the artist can cancel a recording date. It is important to include provisions that allow for the artist to cancel a recording date without incurring additional fees or legal liability.

Explain who owns the tracks recorded. The contract should include a section concerning who owns the rights to the finished audio recordings. 

Identify your distribution rights. The contract should explain how the recordings will be distributed and where royalties will be paid.

Identify the royalty rate. This should be clearly stated in the contract so that the artist will understand exactly how much money they will receive from sales, streaming, and other income sources.

Include a covenant that the artist’s work is original. It is important to enforce that the artist’s work is original and that any samples used in the production are also original.

Add an indemnity provision. An indemnity clause provides the label with protection in the case of any copyright infringement.

Insert a dispute resolution clause. This clause should state how any disputes between the parties will be resolved, such as mediation or arbitration.

Include provisions that explain the music industry is risky. It is important to include provisions that detail the risks in the music industry, such as personnel changes, lack of radio play, industry trends, etc., so that the artist is aware of the risks before signing.

Include a termination clause. This clause should explain how the contract can be terminated in a way that is fair to both parties.

Add a merger clause. A merger clause states that this contract supersedes any prior agreements between the parties.

Insert a choice of law provision. This provision states which state will be responsible for any disputes that may arise. 

Include the address of the parties. An address is needed for each party involved in the contract.

Include signature lines. The signature lines should be added to the bottom of the contract.

Add a notary block. This block is typically added to the contract because notarized contracts are usually preferred in complicated business dealings such as a recording contract.

Show the draft contract to your lawyer. As with any legal document, it is a good idea to show the draft to a qualified lawyer before signing.

Give the draft contract to the artist. Make sure the artist has an opportunity to review the contract and, if desired, have a lawyer look it over.

Distribute copies of the signed agreement. Once the contract is signed, it is important to have each party in the agreement have a copy of the signed contract. This ensures that all parties have a copy of the signed contract in case of any future disputes.

Drafting a recording contract is complicated, and it is important to make sure all the details are covered to ensure a fair agreement between both parties. With sufficient time and effort, anyone should be able to learn to draft an effective and fair recording contract.

How to Bring Your Boyfriend Home for the First Time'

Bringing your boyfriend home to meet your parents for the first time can be an exciting yet intimidating experience. Whether you are in a long-term relationship or just starting out, you will most likely want to introduce him to your parents to build trust and respect. Here are some steps you should follow to make the process smoother and more comfortable for all involved.

First, talk to your boyfriend and ask him if he'd like to meet your parents. Make sure that he is willing and comfortable with the idea before you continue any further.

When you have your boyfriend's approval, reach out to your parents and ask them what time works best for them. Make sure that you pick a day that matches both of their schedules.

Once the date and time are set, talk to your parents and let them know when you and your boyfriend will arrive. It's best to arrive at least 15 minutes before you planned on meeting your parents, so that you can chat with your boyfriend and make sure he knows what to expect. 

When it's time to knock on the door, make sure you do even though it's your house, unless you and your parents discussed something different. When you enter, greet your parents and introduce your boyfriend: "Hi, this is _________, and I thought you should meet him."

After the introductions, you'll likely end up sitting down to talk. People might feel more comfortable if you act as the mediator, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to speak and get to know each other.

When it's apparent that the conversation is starting to wind down, don't stay too long - say something like, "Well, we should be going. It was great to meet you." This will let everyone know that it's time to wrap things up. 

Avoid kissing your boyfriend goodbye when he leaves, unless it is a quick peck on the cheek. If you are leaving with your boyfriend, try to keep it short. It might be best to stay at home until you are actually going on a date with him.

Lastly, make sure to talk to both your parents and your boyfriend after the initial meeting. Ask them how they felt, if anyone was left with questions, and if they think your relationship is going in the right direction. Having your parents' blessing and approval of your boyfriend might give you the confidence you need to take the next step with your relationship.

How to Change a Headunit in a Sixth Generation Honda Civic
Installing an aftermarket head unit to your car can be a great way to upgrade your sound system, or switch out an outdated one. Changing a head unit in a sixth generation Honda Civic (1996-1998) is a relatively simple task. With the right tools and a bit of know-how, you can easily change the head unit in your vehicle.

Before you begin, you’ll need to purchase an aftermarket wiring harness and a mounting kit made specifically for Honda Civics 1996-1998. This will ensure that the wiring and installation process is quick, easy, and properly fitted.

To begin, you will need a Philips screwdriver. It’s recommended that you use gloves, as there are many sharp edges and pieces that you don’t want cutting your hands. Begin by removing the center console and the lower dash of the car, beneath the steering wheel. This can be done by opening the glove box and finding the Philips screw in the top left-hand corner as you face the glove box.

Once the center console is off, move on to the driver’s side, where you will need to open the door and remove the center dashboard with the associated screws. Do the same for the passenger’s side as well.

Now that the center dashboard and console are out, you can move on to removing the stock head unit. Take note of the wires attached to the head unit at the rear, so that you know what you’ll need to connect later on. If you’re having trouble, don’t hesitate to consult a local professional for assistance.

When the head unit is removed, take a hold of the clip that was attached to the back of the head unit and connect it to the aftermarket wiring harness wires. Be sure to check which wires are the correct ones, as each head unit manufacturer will have them listed in the manual. Connect all the wires together, plug in the antenna plug to the aftermarket head unit and then insert the head unit in the mounting kit.

Next, reattach all the panels and ground your car on. Turn the car on and test the head unit to make sure everything is working properly. If your sound system works, your project is complete. You can now go ahead and enjoy the new sound system in your Honda Civic.

Setting up a potato bar can be a fun way to feed a crowd, and leaving the decision of what should go on a baked potato to the diner's own preference cuts down on the work for you as the cook. In this guide, we'll show you how to set up a potato bar. 

First, you'll want to prepare as much as you can ahead of time. Figure what items you'd like to include, and make a shopping list for anything you'll need. Salads, meats, vegetables, cheeses, condiments, and anything else that you can think of should be covered in the list. The more prepared you are the day before, the easier it will be to head to the store for last minute items, if needed. 

Choose cheese that pairs nicely with potatoes. Cheddar cheese, American cheese, pepper jack, and Swiss cheese are all staple choices. 

Meats such as bacon, ham, pulled pork, or sausage can be cooked and set aside the day before. If you'd like for there to be hot meats, cook them ahead of time and keep them warm until you are ready to serve and then again until the last diner has served themselves. 

Prepare vegetables for adding as toppings. Broccoli, diced peppers, diced tomatoes, shredded carrots, salsa, mashed avocados, and anything else that your guests may enjoy can be prepped ahead of time or just before you're ready to serve. 

Other items such as cooked beans, chives, butter, sour cream, cream cheese, other types of cheese, olives, and onion are all items for the potato bar. Slice your scallions or green onions and put into your serving dish. If you plan on using soup or stew as a topping, you can prepare that a day or two before. Go ahead and take your butter out of the refrigerator to soften (it won't hurt it to be out at room temperature). 

If you’re entertaining kids, you can consider adding items such as chili with no meat, applesauce, BBQ sauce, or a simple bean chili. 

Next, you’ll want to select your potatoes. Try to find potatoes that appear the same shape and size. It’s best to use cooking potatoes like Russet potatoes. To prepare them for the potato bar, you’ll want to wash the potatoes and lightly brush olive oil around each one. This will help crisp the skin. Insert fork holes in the potatoes so that they’ll cook evenly, and bake them in a 400 degree Fahrenheit oven for about an hour. 

Once the potatoes have finished baking, take them out and let them cool before cutting them in half and setting them in a basket or holder near the other items. Group similar ingredients together in alignment with how the diner would prepare the baked potato. Place the potato basket or holder next to the plates, and let the assemly begin. 

Go from left to right, according to where the potatoes are. This way, guests won’t be confused as to what goes on first. Put plenty of utensils next to each of the items that are to be added to the potatoes so that it’s clear what they are, and offer plastic forks, spoons, and knives for each person at the end of the line. 

Finally, you’re ready to enjoy your baked potato bar. Its important to remind everyone to be patient and take their time as they fill their potatoes up with all the different items. Enjoy your baked potato bar with your friends and family, and explore all the yummy combinations people come up with!

How to Video Chat on Gmail

Video chatting on Gmail is easy and convenient since it's built right into your Gmail account. All you need is a laptop or desktop computer with a webcam, speakers, microphone, and a printer or scanner and you're ready to start video chatting with friends and family. To get started, you'll need to download the Google Hangouts plugin from the official website.

Navigate to the official webpage for the Google Hangouts plugin at https://www.google.com/tools/dlpage/hangoutplugin. Click on “Download Plugin” then select the option to save the installer file to your desktop. Close all open browser sessions, then double-click on the Hangouts plugin installer file located on your desktop. Follow the on-screen instructions to install the plugin to your Internet browser.

Then, launch your Internet browser when installation is complete. Once you’re in the browser, you’ll need to sign in to your Gmail account at https://mail.google.com/. Once you’re signed in, point to the contact with whom you want to video chat in the chat list and click on the video camera icon displayed next to their details.

You and your friend will need to accept the video chat invitation before the chat can commence. If you receive a “1603 error” when trying to install the Hangouts plugin on a Windows-based computer, you can run the “Program Install and Uninstall troubleshooter” tool courtesy of Microsoft to resolve any issues. If you experience problems using video chat in Windows, switch to desktop mode.

You may also experience problems with echoing when using video chat in Gmail. If this is the case, try using headphones to fix the issue. If you cannot see or hear your friend during video chat sessions, make sure that your webcam, speakers, and microphone are enabled, plugged in to your computer, and not being used by other programs. If the webcam fails to work or you are unable to see your friend, try updating or install new drivers for your webcam.

Video chatting on Gmail is easy, convenient, and requires little to no setup. With the Google Hangouts plugin downloaded to your Internet browser, you can connect with friends and family around the world in a snap. So, get connected and start video chatting today!

How to Teach Sustainable Happiness'

It is no secret that happiness is an elusive and often difficult to attain state that most people strive to achieve. However, the idea of sustainable happiness is a concept of lasting fulfillment and contentment that is achievable and is now becoming increasingly popular. As an educator, teaching sustainable happiness to your students can help them develop both personally and professionally, as well as gain a better understanding of the importance of living sustainably.

The first step in teaching sustainable happiness is becoming more familiar with the concept yourself. Take some time to read articles and watch videos about sustainable happiness as well as engage in activities that help you understand the relevance it has to your life. Don’t forget to engage your students too so they can feel more included in the learning process.

With a better understanding of the concept, it is time to create or find existing lesson plans to help your students explore sustainable happiness. Ask yourself questions such as: What does sustainable happiness mean to your students? Who or what has taught them about happiness in their lives? What activities will best capture the idea of sustainable happiness?

You can incorporate activities to help students develop happiness media literacy such as examining how happiness is often associated with material consumption. Or activities that prompt students to express gratitude and appreciation, or complete a Sustainable Happiness Footprint Chart for a week. You can also look at creating an interdependence map with your students so they can better understand the relationships between people, creatures, and nature.

Assign activities such as identifying a sustainable happiness hero, shifting consumption (shopping for sustainable happiness) activities, and brainstorming ideas about how to share sustainable happiness with others as creative ways to promote this concept. You can also have your students identify how sustainable happiness can help resolve a local or global problem.

Once your students have had time to gain a better understanding of how sustainable happiness works, be sure to share your lesson plan with other teachers so that they too can benefit from the experience. Sustainable happiness is something that not only your students, but also the wider community, can benefit from. As an educator, it is important to ensure that your students have the tools to stay healthy and happy, and the knowledge to lead a more sustainable and responsible life.

How to Make a "Draw My Life" Video
Drawing your story to life is an effective way to inform your audience of who you are and where you come from. A “Draw My Life” video, as the name implies, is a mix of artfully drawn scenes that capture key moments in your past, present and future. The drawings can be created either on a physical whiteboard or digitally in a drawing program combined with screen capture software. Once completed, you can build up your script of key points and finish it off by recording yourself talking about the scenes you have drawn.

The key to creating an effective “Draw My Life” video is to ensure that your story flows from beginning to end and that your visuals are coherent with what you are saying. So, here is what you need to do to create a successful “Draw My Life” video.

Start by gathering all the information that you can about your life and your past. Begin your process by creating a document of your key points, both digitally or via physical pieces of paper. Talk to your family, current and past friends. Try to recall all the key moments in your life that particularly stand out. When you feel comfortable with the information, start developing your storyboard and looser script for the video. 

Since your video will include personal moments, make sure that it does not negatively affect any person in your life. Once you have established the scenes you will include in your video, consider how you will draw and portray them. Will you be using a camera and whiteboard, or will you be pairing a drawing program with a screen capture program?  If it is the latter, set up your recording and start drawing each scene. If you are using a whiteboard, turn on your camera and begin recording.

Once you are finished with a scene, remember to erase all the drawings, before continuing. Also, try to make your drawing process engaging, by introducing dynamic styles and colors. When you are happy with your overall video, export the video and upload it to a computer. Mute the video, and begin recording your story over it. Once you are done, sync the audio to the visuals in the video. Upload the completed video to your YouTube channel, and let the world know your story!

Studying for a test without cramming can be an effective way to ensure that you retain the information you've learned in class and on associated readings. There are several steps you can take to ensure your success.

Start by gathering the necessary materials: about ten sheets of 8.5"x5.5" copy paper, a spiral notebook large enough for the class you are attending, and a three-ring binder, either large enough for the class you are attending, or for notes from several classes, whichever you prefer.

When you are in class, use these paper sheets to take notes. Be sure to turn the pages over or start a new page when necessary, and to always number your pages in the top right hand corner. After class, devote some time to any reading associated with the day’s lesson and to taking additional notes.

Once you’re done for the day, take the time to rewrite all the notes you took into the spiral notebook. This will help you commit that information to memory. When a test approaches, rewrite the information from the spiral notebook into the three-ringed binder. This is a necessary step because you will likely need to refer to the information multiple times to ensure that you remember it when it’s time for the test.

On the day before the test, get to bed at a reasonable hour and make sure that you get a full night’s sleep. This will help your brain be better prepared to recall the information during the official test.

The key to success when studying without cramming is to be persistent in following these steps. Stick to this routine and you'll be well-prepared and confident when the test comes around. With these steps to guide you in the right direction, you should find testing stress-free and easy.

Entering your thirties is often a time of reflection and looking ahead when many assess where they are in life and where they want to be. Whether you're married or single, have kids or not, you may be feeling a sense of anxiety about getting older. Nothing is harder than realizing you are no longer in your 20s and may feel like you have many more years ahead of you than you can anticipate. Here are some ways to embrace your 30's and not fear getting older. 

Spend your time wisely. Don’t continue to squander your time and money on people or activities which do not edify or improve your personal or professional life. Stop comparing yourself to other people and try to focus on your own path and what works for you. Boldly accept your age and the reality of getting older and take ownership for your life.

Accept yourself for who you are. In your thirties, you might begin to see gray hair, smile lines, wrinkles, and other indications that, yes, you’re getting older. Don’t feel ashamed or embarrassed of your changing appearance. Embrace your aging features and remember that beauty comes from a combination of qualities -- not just youth.

Learn to be comfortable alone. When you’re facing getting older, its necessary to learn to find time for yourself. Take some time to reflect in solitude and let yourself enjoy the peace that comes with being alone. This is a time to get to know your own thoughts and feelings, so enjoy it.

Express yourself. Don’t worry about what other people think. Speak your mind and express your creativity. Find ways to use your words and express yourself and honor the person you’ve become.

See aging as a positive, normal experience. Understand that aging is a fact of life and that instead of wasting precious time worrying about getting older, embrace the new you that comes with each passing day. Embrace the knowledge and experience that come with getting older and make the most out of every day that you have.

Learn to love uncertainty. Some people think that as they age, things become more clear, choices become easier to make, and the correct path becomes more obvious. The truth is, even in your thirties, life's path is often unclear and unpredictable so learn to enjoy the mystery of it all.

Choose not to let your fear consume you. No matter how difficult it might be, try to focus on the positive aspects of growing older. Try to avoid worrying about the future and live in the now. Take a moment to be thankful for what you have and look ahead with optimism.

Recognize if you are struggling to accept your age. It's natural to feel anxious and worried, but if your anxiety starts to prevent you from making choices and participating in life fully, it might be time to seek help. Consider talking to a therapist or counselor if you are having a particularly hard time getting used to your aging body and mind.

Use a de-stressing technique that work for you. Entering your thirties can be stressful, but there are a variety of stress relief techniques available to help you. Yoga, meditation, or mindfulness can help you center and gain clarity, while journaling or talking to a friend can help you better understand and manage your emotions.

Plan your meals. In your thirties, you’re probably quite busy taking kids to soccer or school, or working hard on your career. Make sure you make proper meals instead of relying on fast food or other unhealthy options. Eating a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and protein will help you keep your energy up and give your body the nutrients it needs.

Eat a healthy diet. Avoiding obesity and its subsequent effects like diabetes and heart disease gets harder in your thirties as your metabolism changes. Several studies have shown that older adults tend to put on weight around their midsections due to aging and a slower metabolism, so watch your portion sizes and stick to healthy, whole foods as much as possible.

Get enough sleep. While in your twenties, you probably pulled a few all-nighters due to late-night college cramming, partying, or just watching TV with your friends. Now, in your thirties, it's important to focus on getting enough sleep and making sure you are well rested. Aim for 8-9 hours of sleep each night and find ways to relax before bed in order to give yourself a better chance of a good night's rest.

Exercise regularly. Consider finding a physical activity that you enjoy and adding it to your routine. Exercise is not only important for physical health but can also benefit your mental health by reducing stress and increasing happiness thanks to the endorphins your body releases when you exercise.

Diversify your savings. Don’t put all your money into a 401(k). Look into other savings vehicles and investments available that provide steady returns rather than stashing all your money into one place. Think about the long-term when it comes to your finances and plan accordingly.

Set your priorities. Be sure to set your priorities in order to be aware of what is the most important thing to focus your energy and resources on. This might mean devoting more attention and dollars to a new business venture, investing in yourself and your education, taking care of your family responsibilities, or a combination of these things.

Get insured. In your thirties, you should look into getting an insurance plan that’s appropriate for your age and your stage in life. Look into life insurance, homeowners insurance, renters insurance, pet insurance, disability insurance, and other policies that you might need and make sure you’re properly covered.

Talk to your partner about money. If you’re married or planning on getting married, have a sober talk from time to time about the state of your joint finances. Discuss ways to cover your essentials and how you can start to plan for retirement or your children’s college funds.

Don’t overspend on any one thing. Some people are tempted to go all-out on their wedding or their first child. But, in your thirties, you’re at a stage in life where you should be setting aside money for your future. Remember to be sensible and practical and think about the long-term when it comes to spending decisions.

Getting older is an inevitable part of life, but it doesn't have to be something you fear. Embrace this time of life by focusing on your physical and mental health, connecting with yourself and others, and creating a life you love.

Selecting a private jet charter company for your travel needs can be a daunting task. Knowing how to determine the best company for your needs will help ensure that your travel experiences are safe, comfortable, and pleasant for everyone involved. To ensure you’re choosing the right charter company, here are some important pieces of advice to consider.

First, it’s important to identify the right charter broker or operator to work with. There are a number of companies who appear to have many aircraft, but in reality are simply serving in a capacity similar to a travel agent. These companies are not FAA authorized and do not have any aircraft under their control. Whenever possible, select a charter company that actually operates aircraft.

The next step is to validate the charter company you’re looking into. Check out their customer reviews to find out if other customers have had good experiences or not. It’s also important to ask the company for references and to contact them directly. Find out what policies they have for pilot experience and customer service.

The next step is to take a look at the charter company in person. While not always possible, you will learn a tremendous amount of information about a company by meeting their people, seeing their facility, and touring a few aircraft. Ask the staff to explain their procedures and policies and familiarize yourself with the type of equipment the company has on hand.

Customer service is also an important factor when choosing a charter company. Ideally, each trip should have a single person responsible for handling all the details. Ask how quickly your queries will be answered and how customer feedback is handled. You’ll also want to familiarize yourself with the staff’s knowledge and expertise in the industry.

Aircraft quality is another important factor you’ll want to consider when selecting a private jet charter company. You should be shown pictures and videos of aircrafts being considered for your trip and you should have an opportunity to ask questions about the condition of these aircraft. Make sure the company has adequate maintenance and the record of the aircraft show compliance with FAA regulations.

Finally, investigate the pilot qualifications of the charter company before making your selection. Look into the pilot’s background, certifications, experience, and look into any safety records or incidents that have occurred on the aircraft. Determine what the provider’s standards are for minimum pilot hours.

Once you’ve done your research and feel comfortable with the company and the aircraft, then you’ll want to get a quote for your flight. As the details of your needs become more specific, you should be able to get a clear quote, not a vague estimate that leaves room for surprises on the final invoice.

Choosing the right private jet charter company can take a bit of work, but the effort you put into researching and selecting the perfect company will be worth it in the end. Make sure you question all the potential charter companies and that you feel comfortable with the answers you receive. You’ll find a lot of satisfaction in knowing that you’ve chosen a safe, reliable, and enjoyable charter experience.

Talking to resistant parents of a gay child can be a difficult and delicate process. It becomes all the more important to handle this type of conversation carefully as the child in question may be the most affected by it. With the above in mind, these tips may help make the conversation go more smoothly: 

1. Talk with them: The first step in this process is simply talking to the parents. This may be the most difficult part, particularly if the parents are not open to discussing the issue. However, it is important to make sure that both sides of the story are heard. It is important to have a level of respect and understanding when talking to the parents and to do all you can to make them feel comfortable with the conversation. 

2. If the parents are willing, then do your best to reassure without being condescending: If the parents are open to discussing their child's sexuality, this is a great opportunity to do your best to educate them and provide information without coming off as condescending. Try to focus on the facts and provide the parents with resources that can help them process the situation.

3. Determine what are the key points that establish the resistance: religion, image in the community, fear for the future of the LGBT child or some/all of the above: It is important to understand what exactly is causing the parents to be resistant to the idea of their child being gay. By determining what the key points are that are leading to the resistance, it can help in understanding how to address them appropriately and provide education on the topic. 

4. After collecting the information, then present factual information informatively: Once you have a better understanding of why the parents are resistant, it is important to provide them with valid information and facts in an informative way. This is key in helping the parents understand and come to terms with the fact that their child is gay. 

5. Get to the solution: It is important to help the parents come to terms with their child's sexuality in a way that does not damage their relationship with the child. How to Perform a Yeast Transformation
When planning to perform a yeast transformation, it’s important to make sure that you’ve gathered the necessary materials including; plasmid DNA, single stranded DNA 2, and buffers (0.1M LiOAc and freshly made PEG3). You’ll also need media such as Yeast Extract-Peptone-Adenine-Dextrose (YPAD) liquid media, as well as plates with selective media for the transformation. To prepare for the procedure, make liquid cultures of the yeast cells the night before the experimentation. Estimated time for the procedure is a minimum of two hours.

To begin your transformation, set up one hot plate to 95°C (which can be anywhere in the range from 90°C to 97°C). Set a second plate to 30°C and ignite your Bunsen burner, making sure to work as close to it as possible. Label clean Eppendorf tubes and pipet 600 μL of the liquid culture into each tube. Centrifuge the tubes for two minutes at 2000 rpm. Vacuum out the supernatant, being careful not to suck up any cells in the pellet. Resuspend the pellet with 300 μL of the 0.1M LiOAc buffer, centrifuge for one minute at 2000 rpm, and carefully vacuum out again. This process is repeated twice more to ensure that all media is washed out of the cells.

Following this, pipet 600 μL of PEG buffer into each tube. Then, pipet 5 μL of the plasmid DNA and 10 μL of the hot single stranded DNA into each tube. Incubate the tubes on the 30° hot plate for anywhere from 30 minutes to overnight. For the next step, drop the tubes into a 42° water bath for precisely 15 minutes to heat shock. Again, centrifuge the tubes for two minutes at 3000 rpm and vacuum out the supernatant. Resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of MQ water. Now, you will be ready to spread the cells onto the designated plates – pipet the cell suspension from the Eppendorf tubes and spread it evenly on the plates by using a sterilized spreader. Cover the plates with your hands or on a rotating platform and then, quickly pass the covers around the flame with a small open space kept nearest to the flame. As soon as they are dry, cover the plates, seal them with parafilm, and incubate them upside down at 30°C for two to three days. After your desired incubation period has been completed, colonies should be visible and ready for isolation.

How to Print on Metal
Printing on metal can open up a new world of creativity for your projects. Whether that be a brand logo on a promotional product, an image on a wall hanging, or a imprinted sign from a craft project, metal printing can give your project that extra flair. 

Before you can print on metal there are a few things you need to do. 

Ensure you have an inkjet printer. Inkjet printing can be done on metal, but laser printers will not work. This is because laser printing uses a process that requires heat to transfer your image, and metal obviously doesn’t take too kindly to heat. 

Fill the printer with a good amount of ink. Don’t skimp on the ink, as without a decent amount it’ll be difficult to get good results. It’s also worth using a brand name ink if you can, these tend to work better and don’t compromise on the quality of your printing. 

Purchase flexible aluminum flashing. You will want to get your metal from a hardware or home improvement store, as they are the most likely to have flexible aluminum with the thinnest gauges. This will make it much easier for you to transport the metal. 

Choose the side you want to print on. You can either go with a plain or pre-finished side, depending on what you want to do with the metal piece afterwards. For example, with a printed plate or sign, you may want to use the unfinished side and set it up with a porch paint or powder-coat.

Sand the surface with an orbital saw to improve the adhesion of your adhesive or pre-coat to the metal. Sanding the metal down with an orbital saw will also make it easier to apply your images. 

Clean the surface with a bleach cleaning product, such as a whitening sponge or Mr. Clean. This will help make sure that your metal is free from any dirt or residue, and make sure your adhesive can stick properly. 

Take the flashing inside. If the metal you purchased is pre-finished, you don’t need to do anything else in terms of preparing it. However, if the metal is plain, you will need to apply an adhesive to it to act as a barrier against the spray of your ink. 

Purchase and use an inkjet pre-coating product, such as Dass pre-coat. This will give your metal an even, good coating to work with. Before you apply the pre-coat, make sure that your surface is free of any dust or other particles, and adhere to the product instructions.

Apply a thick bead of pre-coat above the sheet of metal flashing. Make sure to spread it out evenly and don’t let it form a puddle. You may also need to fill in any grooves or crevices with more pre-coat to make sure everything is covered.

Use a pre-made coating bar or make your own out of a scrap piece of wood. This will be used to evenly apply the pre-coat.

Place the coating bar above the pre-coat and slide it down over the entire metal piece to coat it evenly. Make sure to move it in one direction and don’t let it overlap on itself.

Don’t touch the surface once you apply the pre-coat. You may have to wait up to a day for it to dry before you start printing.

Get your image ready to print. Your image should be in a digital format - usually a JPEG, TIFF, or PNG file are best. The size of your image depends on how large your final print will be, but make sure it’s at a decent resolution. 

Apply double sided tape to a piece of carrier paper the same size as your metal print. This will help hold your image to the flashing when it goes through the printer.

Load the carrier sheet and metal into the feeder tray of your printer. Make sure you follow the instructions provided by the printer’s manufacturer.

Allow the metal to move through the printer. You may have to do this a few times to get your image onto the metal, depending on the size of the piece.

Consider sealing the print in a few hours. Inkjet printing can cause the ink to wear away over time, so it’s important to seal it with a product that’s designed for metal. You can buy clear satin-finish polyurethane or acrylic sealants online or at a hardware store.

Opt to use another method if your printer won’t print on flashing. If your printer isn’t rated for printing on metal, there are a few alternatives. You can use thermal transfers, or if you want to go with a pre-made image, use laser transfers.

Load the transfers into the printer. For this alternative method, you don’t need to worry about pre-coating, as the transfer comes with its own adhesive.

Go through the process of abrading your metal flashing, so that the waterproof surface is removed. This is an important step if you choose the laser transfer, as it will help the adhesive stick to the metal and make sure that your image looks good.

Apply the transfer very carefully to the metal. Try to be as gentle as possible and keep it within the areas you want the image to show.

Allow it to dry and coat it if recommend it. Some transfers will require a coat of sealant so that the image will last longer. If you use polyurethane, be sure to follow the manufacturer’s instructions carefully. 

Once you’ve gone through all the necessary steps, you’re ready to show off your printed metal creations! With a bit of patience and skill, you’ll soon be able to create amazing works of art for yourself and everyone to admire!

How to Teach Self Hypnosis to Autistic People
Self Hypnosis for Autistic People is not something that is widely taught - yet! Research points to the fact that self hypnosis is beneficial to those with autism in helping them relax, improve self-confidence and manage pain. Teaching self hypnosis to autistic people however, can be a challenge. With the right approach and tools though, it can be made easier and more achievable. 

Preparing 
Before teaching self hypnosis to someone with autism, there are some preparatory steps to take. Find out what the young teen likes and finds relaxing such as woods versus water, sounds, colors, and more. If music is a preferred element, choose music that is familiar and calming. It may also be helpful to use props such as a soothing light, tactile items such as a stress ball, or a weighted blanket. 

Do the relaxation and breathing exercises first. Show them, or better yet, have them help you perform the exercises. This lets them practice the techniques and get an idea of what to expect when engaging in self hypnosis.

Begin the Process 
Suggest that the teen lay back in any position that is the most comfortable. It could be sitting with their legs crossed or just laying flat on the floor, whichever way they are the most relaxed. Ask the young man or woman to shut their eyes. If music is to be used, which is often preferable, turn on the music softly in the background and lead them in the relaxation exercises. 

Regress the person. Once the person is in a state of deep relaxation, regression through hypnosis can begin. Ensure that you are consistent. Use a five or ten count. Use what you learned during the preparatory steps. Move deeper into "self" and the vision with each step. Build in a safety assurance. 

Create a Recording 
Make a recording for the individual. If self hypnosis is going to be used, recording works really well. You will need to speak clearly while going through the steps of meditation and relaxation. 

Very clearly use an end of self-hypnosis statement. Add in the recording a clear statement to remain in the highly relaxed state, but also a slightly louder and clear end point when you will begin the return to the present. Make a statement that you will be moving back to the present. 

Returning to the Present 
Use the same five to ten steps you used initially in regression, but in reverse. Use the five or ten count reversed. Complete the steps, bringing the person back to the present. Tell the person to open his/her eyes slowly. Include this, of course, in the recording as well. 

Create a Physical Cue 
Create a physical cue, not otherwise used, as the relaxation response trigger. Decide upon a physical symbol to trigger the response. Create the cue as something that would ordinarily not just happen. Reinforce this embedded response many times during hypnosis. When not regressed, remind the person that this type of touch will help them to feel calm. 

Teaching self hypnosis to autistic people can be a rewarding challenge if approached with patience, understanding, and the right tools. With careful planning, you can introduce this form of mind-body interaction to those with autism and help them enjoy many of the benefits that self hypnosis can bring.

How to Crochet a Sock That Fits'

Creating a comfortable sock that fits perfectly can be a tricky task. In order to crochet an item of clothing that actually fits, the first step is to take measurements of the person’s foot and leg. This ensures that any item created will fit the person tightly, giving a better, more secure fit when worn. Read on to learn how to crochet a sock that fits perfectly. 

Before starting the sock, record all the necessary measurements. Measure the length and width of the foot, such as 9.5 inches (24.1 cm) in length and 3.5 inches (8.9 cm) in width. The length of the heel can be worked out from the width of the foot, so record 3.5 inches (8.9 cm) divided by 2, which gives you 1.75 inches (4.4 cm). To work out the length of the sock, subtract the length of the heel from the length of the foot, which gives you 7.75 inches (19.7 cm).  

Once the measurements are recorded, it’s time to get crocheting. Begin by crocheting in continuous rows around the sock to form a cylinder. This forms the base of the sock, and the height can be changed depending on the amount of rows you crochet.  

Now the toe can be crocheted. This section of the sock should be a slightly more oval shape than the rest of the sections, and should taper in slightly. It is also important to record the measurements of this section, such as 4 rows in length and 28 sc around the oval. 

Continue crocheting the foot, following the measurements you took when measuring the foot. As this is the main body of the sock, it should be worked in a cylindrical shape with the same measurements as the body of the foot. Record the measurements for this section which could be 30 rows in length and 28 sc around the sock. 

Next comes the heel. Crochet 14 sc decreasing down to 10 sc to start shaping the heel. Once the heel is complete, fasten off the yarn. Record the measurements of the heel so that they can be replicated later when completing the other sock. 

Then stitch the sides of the heel, making sure that the stitches are even and the sock fits well. After this, continue to crochet the calf section of the sock. Record the measurements for this section, such as 10 rows in length and 28 sc around the sock. Finally, crochet the cuff section around the top of the sock. As with the other sections, record the measurements of the cuff, such as 5 rows in length and 28 sc around the sock. 

Once the first sock is completed, it is now time to make the second identical sock. Repeat all of the steps that you completed for the first sock and ensure that all measurements are exactly the same. 

By following the above steps, you can confidently create a well-fitting sock that’s comfortable and secure when worn. The key to success lies in taking and accurately recording all of the necessary measurements before beginning to crochet. With those measurements recorded, your socks are guaranteed to fit perfectly.

Filing a report for a stolen Social Security card can seem difficult and intimidating, but it does not have to be. Knowing what steps to take and the resources available can make the process easier. Here are the steps needed to report a stolen Social Security card:

1. Contact the Social Security Administration (SSA). Contact the SSA at 800-772-1213 to report the theft of your Social Security card. An SSA representative will be able to provide you with information about the next steps. You may also be able to file your report online via the Social Security website.

2. File a report with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). The FTC collects information that can lead to an investigation or prosecution of identity thieves, but does not resolve individual cases relating to a stolen Social Security card. You can fill out the FTC’s online complaint form from their website.

3. File a police report with your local police. Make sure to collect your case number and a copy of the report.

4. File a complaint with the Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). If you suspect that your Social Security card was stolen and misused online, contact the IC3.

5. Get an application. To apply for a replacement Social Security card, you must complete an application.

6. Fill out the form. There is a $1 fee to get a replacement card, but you may not have to pay if your card was stolen. Fill out the application completely and be sure to provide accurate information.

7. Collect necessary identity documents. To apply for a replacement Social Security card, you will need to provide certain documents, including: a state or federal government-issued photo identification, proof of U.S. citizenship or immigration status, and proof of Social Security number (if available).

8. Collect the necessary citizenship or immigration documents. If you are an immigrant, you will need to provide documents that prove your immigration status.

9. Apply for a replacement card. Submit the application and documents to the Social Security Administration.

10. Wait to receive the replacement Social Security card by mail. After your application and documents are processed, the Social Security Administration will mail you a new card.

11. Request a fraud alert with Equifax, Trans Union, or Experian. A fraud alert is a form of protection for your identity if you believe someone may be using your information.

12. Consider requesting Extended Fraud Alerts. This type of alert notifies other creditors that someone may be using your identity fraudulently.

13. Request a free copy of your credit report from each of the credit reporting agencies. A copy of your credit report will help you confirm if identity thieves have opened accounts or loans using your name and Social Security number.

14. Have any fraudulent or inaccurate information removed from the credit report. Contact the credit agency and dispute any inaccurate or wrong information that appears on the credit report.

15. Continue to check your credit reports at least every 3 months. Checking your credit reports frequently will help you make sure that no new fraudulent activity has occurred.

By taking these steps, you will be able to successfully report and recover from a stolen Social Security card. With the help and resources available, the process is not as daunting as it seems.

How to Turn On a Cellphone

Most users know how to turn on a cellphone, but sometimes they're faced with unexpected difficulties. Whether you've recently purchased a new phone, can't seem to find the power button, or have a malfunctioning device, we've got the answers to get you back up and running in no time. 

Before you dive into troubleshooting, first locate the power button on your device. Its exact placement can vary depending on the smartphone model and software version, but the button should be positioned somewhere along the sides or top edge of the device. Once you've located the power button, follow the steps for your specific device: 

For iPhones:
1. Locate the Power button. 
2. Press and hold the Power button. 
3. Release the Power button when the Apple logo appears. 
4. Swipe to unlock your screen. 
5. Enter your passcode (if prompted). 

For Androids:
1. Locate the Power button. 
2. Press and hold the Power button. 
3. Release the Power button when you see the logo. 
4. Swipe to unlock your screen. 
5. Enter your passcode (if prompted). 

If you still cannot turn on the device, then try these tips: 
1. Plug your phone into the charger for a few minutes. 
2. Try a different outlet if the phone doesn't charge. 
3. Try a different charger and USB cable. 
4. Check your charging port for lint. 
5. Locate the Power button on your phone. 
6. Press and hold the Power button for 10 seconds. 
7. Press and hold the Power button again for several seconds. 
8. Press and hold the Power and Home buttons for 10 seconds (iPhone). 

If all of these solutions fail, then consider these last steps: 
1. Check if your phone has a removable battery. 
2. Reseat the battery if it is removable. 
3. Consider replacing the battery (if possible). 

If the problem persists, for iPhones: 
1. Connect your iPhone to your computer. 
2. Open iTunes. 
3. Press and hold the Power and Home buttons. 
4. Hold both buttons until the iTunes logo appears. 
5. Click Restore in iTunes. 
6. Click Restore again to confirm. 
7. Swipe to start the setup process. 

For Androids:
1. Connect your Android to a charger. 
2. Press and hold the Power and Volume Down buttons. 
3. Hold both buttons until the recovery menu appears. 
4. Use the Volume Up and Volume Down buttons to navigate the menu. 
5. Highlight recovery mode and press the Power button. 
6. Highlight wipe data/factory reset and press the Power button.
7. Highlight yes and press the Power button.
8. Wait while your device restores. 
9. Start the Android setup process. 

Whether you have an iPhone or an Android, these steps should help you turn on and start using your device. If you still have difficulties, you may need to contact your phone's manufacturer for further assistance.

How to Make a Low Cost Door Knob Extender for People with Hand Pain
These days, more and more people are facing hand pain issues, making even simple tasks difficult to complete. Even something as basic as turning a doorknob can become an excruciating task. Fortunately, there is a simple and low cost fix for this: a door knob extender. With just a few items from around the house, or your local hardware store, you can make your own door knob extender in just a few steps. 

Materials Needed:
- 3⁄4 inch (1.9 cm) Plastic Electrical Conduit or similar plastic tubing
- 2 inch (5.1 cm) drywall screws
- Drill

Instructions:
1. Obtain a length of 3⁄4 inch (1.9 cm) plastic electrical conduit or similar plastic tubing. Mark the tube at the 1.5 and 4.5 inch marks. Cut through the tubing at the 3 and 6 inch marks to make two 3 inch (7.6 cm) pieces, each with one notch.

2. In one piece, drill a small hole all the way through the tubing so that when this hole is parallel to a flat surface behind the tubing, with the notch facing up at about a 45 degree angle. 

3. Place the two 3 inch (7.6 cm) pieces on opposite sides of the Doorknob and run 2 inch (5.1 cm) drywall screws through the pre-drilled holes to connect the tubes together behind the knob.

4. Return to the tube you marked in step one, and cut it off at the 13 inch (33.0 cm) mark, now 7 inches (17.8 cm) from the end after cutting off the two 3 inch (7.6 cm) pieces. Notch the tube to about half the diameter so that the notch will fit over the knob.

5. Drill a small hole all the way through the tube on each side of the notch, so that the line of the holes will be perpendicular to the door when the notch is placed over the knob.

6. Place the 7 inch (17.8 cm) piece you just completed over the knob with the screws run almost as far in as they can go. Screw the 7 inch (17.8 cm) piece to the 3 inch (7.6 cm) pieces.

7. Test your door knob extender to make sure it fits properly and allows you to turn the knob with ease. You may need to make minor adjustments, such as cutting deeper notches, or drilling additional holes in the tubing.

And there you have it! With some basic materials and a bit of time, you can make your own door knob extender. Be sure to test it out and make any necessary adjustments until you get the desired results. Enjoy not having to struggle so much with your door knobs any more!

After a house fire, the chaos and confusion can be overwhelming. To make the situation more manageable, protecting yourself and your valuables should be a priority. Here are some steps you can take to protect yourself after a house fire: 

• Remember to wear face masks, gloves, and clothes that you don’t mind throwing away and to have extras masks/gloves available for others that may need to enter the premises. This is an important step to ensure your safety and health.

• Remove all surviving documents that detail financial information, social security information, tax files, all types of insurance files, medical files, deeds, passports, credit cards, mortgage company information, and contracts with service providers such as utilities, lawn maintenance, etc. These are valuable items and having them out of the fire's reach is essential for security.

• Do not allow anything to be removed by others until you have documented it. It is important that you take accountability for your belongings and inventory them to provide to your insurance company.

• Document your contents and furnishings immediately and then have all furniture removed as soon as possible to be able to retain the contents without the smoke odor. Furniture and belongings need to be removed to a permanent storage where heat/cold, humidity, and environmental factors are controlled.

• If you don’t have call answering, you might want to call your phone company and get this placed on your phone so that your messages may be retrieved. After a fire it is important to stay connected to family and friends.

• If you have pets, try to see if another family can care for them during the crisis. Having a safe place for your pets is important in the immediate aftermath of the fire.

• Your house and contents may not be secure since the electricity will be turned off and the garage may be accessible manually. Make sure to take measures to ensure your home is secure by placing flashlights in your car and home by the entry.

• Remember that the stress can build without you realizing it. It is important to take breaks and find healthy outlets such as singing, talking, drawing, biking, playing games, or anything else that brings you joy.

• Consult information on line -use the local library if you lost your computer. It is important to stay informed of the recovery process and available resources that you may be entitled to.

• Don’t worry about thanking others right away. Showing gratitude is important, but focus on your own wellbeing in the first few days after the fire.

Though the recovery process may seem daunting and overwhelming, it is important to focus on your safety and protectionat this time. Focusing on these steps can help you stay safe and be better prepared as you begin to recover from the fire.

How to Derive Mathematical Expressions for the Heat Capacities at Constant Volume and Pressure for an Ideal Gas of Photons
The concept of heat capacity is derived from the thermodynamic science and is a thermodynamic quantity that is defined as the rate of change of the energy of the given system as a function of temperature. Usually large value of the heat capacity means that the system is able to absorb much heat without significant change in the temperature of the system. We start from the relativistic energy equation of a photon and differentiate it with respect to the temperature T. Thus:

E=p*c
dE/dT=(dp/dT)*c

The first term is nothing but the heat capacity at constant volume Cv. Dr/dt is the expression of the velocity and dT/dr is the rate of change of temperature as a function of the place. Q=k*(dT/dr)

Thus the final expression of Cv looks like this:

Cv=F1*c/{(Q/K)*v}=F1*c*K/(Q*v)

Here Q is the heat that is conducted in the system. Now an expression for Cp or the heat capacity at constant pressure will be derived. At constant pressure we have:

Q=H=E+PV

Cp is by definition the rate of change of the heat at constant pressure as a function of temperature. For an ideal gas of photons we have:

dE/dT=Cv and at constant pressure we have

d(PV)=P*dV/dT

Thus we obtain:

Cp=Cv+PdV/dT

We then get an expression for dV/dT from the equation of the ideal gas: PV=nRT Thus we obtain:

dV/dT=nR/P

Substituting this expression for dV/dT in the above equation for Cp we get:

Cp = Cv + nR

We remember that:

Cv = F1*c*K/(Q*v).

Now we express the numerical values of F1,K,Q and v.,F1=1.5*10-23 J/K,  K=2.4*1011J/K,  Q= 4.3*1012C and v=2.8*108m/s.,

These numerical values can further be used for calculating the Cp and Cv of the ideal gas of photons.,We can also calculate the value of Cp for different temperatures by using the equation:.,Cp = Cv + nR,and the corresponding values of Cv.,This will help us to get the value of Cp for different ideal gases of photons at different temperatures, and will also help us to understand the concept of heat capacity in thermodynamics.

Making a garden mirror is a wonderful way to add a whimsical touch to any outdoor space. It offers a fun and creative way to spruce up the garden, entranceway, patio, or any area you like while creating a unique and eye-catching home decor piece. Here's how to make a garden mirror:

First, find the mirrors you want to transform into garden mirrors. Make sure that the frames you've chosen fit the overall design aesthetic of the garden the mirror will be placed in. Keep in mind the size and shape of the mirrors, the frame thickness, and any additional hardware may be needed.

Using a circular saw, cut a piece of plywood into the exact same size and shape as the mirrors. Make sure the wood is sturdy and durable enough to withstand any outdoor elements. Give it multiple coats of outdoor paint to prevent it from being affected by rain or dampness. 

While you're waiting for the paint to dry, measure the distance between the mirrors and cut equal pieces of fence boards for the outer frame. Glue the frame to the front of the mirror with liquid nails or caulk to hold it in place. Measure the inside of the frame from top to bottom and cut a piece of trim to fit that exact size.

To make your mirror look like it has a window, you'll need two larger pieces of the same trim cut for the top and bottom of the window, and one piece cut to the same length as the distance between the two pieces of frame. Glue these onto the mirror, making sure all the pieces fit together snugly. 

To hang the garden mirror, use hangers like cup hooks, eye screws, or picture wire in the back of the mirror. Make sure they're solidly attached in place. Then, use a unbroken line of waterproof caulk along the outside back of the mirror, and then more all over the back of the mirror to attach the painted plywood in place. And that's it! Your beautiful garden mirror is now ready to be hung.

Putting laminate on a countertop can seem like a daunting task, but by following a few simple steps and taking the time to do some proper prep work, you can ensure a successful project that you will love for years to come.

Before you begin, take some time to plan the project. Consider the space that you want to cover with laminate, the type and finish of the material you will be using, and the materials you will use to glue the laminate to. You should also select the plastic laminate you will use for your project, depending on the appearance you want and the level of wear-and-tear your countertop will face in the future. It is also important to make sure you choose the right contact cement to match the laminate you have chosen. It is recommended to purchase some disposable paint brushes or a paint roller with a close nap, in order to spread the contact cement.

Once you have all your materials, find a work area that is well-ventilated, dust-free, and has good lighting. This is typically done in a workshop or other section of your house that has plenty of workbench space. From here, you will first need to cut your plywood (or other substrate material to the size and shape of your countertop. You should then rip a strip of this plywood that is about two inches wide, which will serve as your edge band. Cut the laminate to fit the top.

Lay the plywood on saw horses, and then put the cut sheet of the laminate, bottom up, onto a work surface. From here, you will need to apply the adhesive. This can be done by either rolling or brushing the contact cement in a thin coat on both the plywood and the back of the laminate. Make sure that there are no runs or thick splatters on either surface, as this can create bumps or dimples on the final product. Allow the glue to dry until it has no wet or glossy appearance.

Using a soft cloth, press the laminate onto the surface, working from the center outwards to the edges. Cut the laminate for the edge band according to the size of the edge, and then apply a thin coat of adhesive onto both the plywood and edge of the laminate. Allow the adhesive to dry as before.

Once the contact cement is completely dry, use a router with a laminate trimming bit to trim any excess edges. Finally, wipe away any glue spots, and fit your countertop into position. With these few simple steps, anyone can successfully install laminate on a countertop and enjoy it for years to come.

Teaching your child how to use 911 is an important step when it comes to safety and preparedness. Teaching your child when, why and how to call 911 can help ensure that they are prepared in the event of an emergency. Here are some tips for teaching your child how to use 911:

Know when the right time is to teach your child about 911. You should start teaching your child at a young age, no matter how uncomfortable it may feel. Explain that 911 is a service that helps people in times of emergency. 

Explain that calling 911 can help in an emergency. Your child should understand that if something bad is happening, or if they are ever in a life-threatening situation, then calling 911 can help them.

Tell your child about the different people that can help when he or she calls 911. Explain that when they call, there will be a dispatcher on the line who will ask questions and provide help. There may be a police officer, an ambulance, or a firefighter sent out depending on the situation.

Talk to your child about the dispatcher who will pick up the phone. Explain that they will ask questions and it is important to answer honestly; it can help them get the help they need.

Help your child to understand what an emergency is. Explain that an emergency is a very serious situation that requires help from 911. Ask them to come up with different scenarios, such as a fire, or a dangerous situation. Teach them to understand that if they are ever in danger or scared, they can call 911.

Help your child to understand when he or she should not call 911. Explain that 911 is not for jokes or running prank calls. It is a serious service that should only be used in cases of emergency.

Make sure that your child understands that calling 911 is serious. Explain that it is okay to be scared when calling 911, but they should stay on the phone until help arrives.

Help your child to understand that they should get away from the situation before calling 911. Explain that if there is a dangerous situation, such as a person threatening them or their family, they should get away to safety before calling.

Make sure your child knows what constitutes an emergency. Explain that an emergency is serious and requires police, fire, or medical assistance. Explain that it can be a life-threatening situation, a crime happening, or a medical emergency.

Make sure your child knows all the pertinent information. Explain to them that they need to know their address and phone number, as well as their parents’ names before calling 911.

Teach your child how to observe the environment around them. Explain that when they call, the dispatcher may need to know what is happening, such as seeing a car or the sound of an alarm going off.

Teach your child to have a calm conversation. Explain that it is important to stay calm and answer the dispatcher’s questions in a clear and loud voice. 

Explain to your child that they should not hang up until the dispatcher says it is okay to do so. This is important because when the dispatcher hangs up, it may take them longer to get help if they have to call back. 

Explain what to do if your child accidentally calls 911. Explain that it is important to stay on the line and explain that it was an accident.

Make sure that your child can reach the phone. Explain that they need to have access to the phone if they ever have to call 911.

Teach your child how to unlock a cellphone. Explain that if they ever have to call 911 from a cellphone, they need to know how to unlock it.

Show your child how to dial on your phone. Explain what buttons they need to press in order to dial 911 from a cellphone or a regular phone.

Make sure your child knows which buttons to press. Explain that they need to press the right buttons in order to call 911 from a cellphone or a regular phone.

Act out calling 911. Make sure your child is comfortable with the process by acting out how they would call 911 in an emergency.

Set up a practice call with your local 911 dispatcher. Some communities have this service available so that you can ensure your child knows what to do when they make the call and what information to provide.

By following these tips, you can help make sure that your child knows what to do in the event of an emergency. It is important to remember that practicing what to do and teaching them about 911 can help reduce the impact of a scary situation in the future.
