Installing a three-way light switch is a relatively easy task that can make a big difference in your home's lighting capabilities. It's important that you get the job done correctly in order to properly light up your home, however, prior to beginning any electrical work it's important to make sure power is off in the room you're working. Another important factor is selecting the appropriate wire size and cable type. 

To begin, you will need a 2-wire non-metallic (NM) cable and a 3-wire NM cable. Start by screwing your two boxes and light fixture into place, then gather your supplies. Slide the 2-wire NM power cable into the first switch box. To make your connections, remove about 9 inches of sheathing from the wire and use cable staples to secure the wires to the wall or stud within 8" of the box. The next step is to run a 3-wire NM cable between the first and second boxes. 

Once this is done, pull another 2-wire NM cable through the second switch box, just like you did in the very beginning with the first box. Now pull the 2-wire cable from the second box up and into the light fixture. From here you'll need to strip 1" off of the individual ends of all the smaller wires and then curve them into small hooks. Use wire nuts to attach the each set of two white wires together and use wire nuts to attach the two pairs of green/orange grounding wires together, adding a 6" piece of copper grounding wire to each pair as well. 

After making all your connections, fold the wires neatly into the box and replace the drywall, coverings, etc. Attach the black power cable (from the wall) to the general screw (black) in the three-way light switch, then attach the remaining black and red cables (from 3-wire NM) to the traveler screws on the switch. Attach the hanging ground wire (the pigtail) to the green grounding screw, then attach the black wire leading to the light to your general screw (black). 

Finally, attach the appropriate wires to your light fixture, turn the power on and test your switch to make sure everything is connected correctly. After that, all you have to do is sit back and bask in the soft light in your newly three-way switched room.

Becoming better friends with someone can take time and effort, but it is well worth it. Developing strong relationships with close friends can be a great source of joy and comfort in life. Taking steps such as planning events together, expressing appreciation, and openly talking can help form a lifelong bond.

Making a scrapbook is a great way to share memories and show appreciation for each other. It can be filled with pictures or memories of different times you have spent together. It can be an amazing reminder of all the fun you have had.

Planning fun and unique activities can be a great way to become better friends with someone. Going to a concert, trying out a new restaurant, or doing something you haven't done before. This will give you something to bond over and also help add excitement to your friendship.

When spending time with friends it is sometimes easy to forget to take the time to listen. Therefore it can be helpful to make an effort to be an active listener, show that you care about their thoughts and opinions. Disagreements are bound to happen when spending time with someone, however it is important to respect each other's opinion and know when to disagree and agree to disagree. It is important to be open and understanding in friendships, especially if your friends have different interests and opinions.

Soothing hurt feelings is a crucial part of friendship. When your friend is feeling upset or down try to listen, offer comfort and understanding. Let your friends know that they can rely on you for emotional support.

Treat others the way you would like to be treated. Showing appreciation and respect to your friends is a major part of friendship as it makes them feel comfortable and close to you. Complimenting your friends on things they have done well or being understanding if they make a mistake shows them that you are genuine and sincere in wanting to become better friends.

An important thing to know about friendship is that talking about someone behind their back to another friend in your group will damage the trust among your group and threaten the security of your friendship. Therefore, it is important to try and talk about good things and stay positive when conversing with your friends. It is also important to respect other people's feelings when introducing new friends into your group.

Jealousy can have a negative effect on a friendship. It is natural to feel a little jealous of your friends sometimes, however it can cause us to behave in unpleasant ways. It is important to be aware of feelings of jealousy and strive to not let it ruin your friendships.

Don’t forget to recognize that even the best friendships inevitably dissipate at times. It is normal for friends to grow apart over time, or to just not talk as often. This doesn’t mean that the friendship is lost forever, it’s still important to respect each other’s privacy. Even though you might spend less time together, respecting each other’s space can help preserve the relationship.

It is essential to apologize when wrong and provide a chance for your friends to do the same. If you do something wrong or have a misunderstanding it is always best to acknowledge it and try to work through it. Apologize sincerely and let your friends know that you value the friendship and are willing to move forward.

Overall, becoming better friends with someone takes effort and time, but it is possible and well worth it. By following these simple steps, such as making a scrapbook, planning events together, listening, being considerate, and respecting privacy, you will be on your way to making a best friend a friend forever.

Choosing the right anti-dandruff shampoo can make a big difference when it comes to banishing dandruff for good. To make the best decision for your needs, you should familiarize yourself with the various active ingredients that combat dandruff, as well as the shampoos and conditioners that contain them.for

When selecting a shampoo, look for one containing zinc pyrithione. This antibacterial and antifungal agent is found in several popular dandruff shampoos, and it is the most common active ingredient. Tar-based shampoos, which contain coal tar, are also effective against dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis, and psoriasis, and popular brands include Neutrogena T/Gel and Denorex. Selenium sulfide shampoos, which also work to slow down the shedding of dead skin cells, are also available. Salicylic acid, a relatively mild acid, can also be effective at loosening the build-up of dead skin cells on the scalp. Based on your lifestyle or chosen shampoo ingredients, you might also want to consider a ketoconazole shampoo, as its antifungal agents can work against a variety of fungi.

Once you've chosen a shampoo, the next step is to commit to trying it out before making a decision. Massage the shampoo into your scalp to work it in. The key is to use the shampoo on a regular basis. To prevent your hair from becoming acclimatized to the same shampoo, try swapping between two anti-dandruff shampoos. This will also help you to get the full benefit of any particular active ingredient. Additionally, it is important to consider your hair type when using certain shampoos. If you have color-treated hair, for example, you may want to use gentler products as some anti-dandruff shampoos can strip away your color. Applying an anti-dandruff conditioner after using shampoo is also a great way to renew and restore your scalp and hair health.

Finally, try to steer clear of any shampoos with harsh ingredients, as these tend to have an even more drying effect on the scalp. If you find that anti-dandruff shampoos aren't working for you, it may be time to visit a dermatologist for a professional diagnosis. They can advise on an appropriate treatment, such as a medicated shampoo. With the right combination of ingredients and a bit of trial and error, you should have no trouble tackling your dandruff issues.

Making an origami diamond is a great way to relax and practice being mindful. It also makes for a great, thoughtful gift. For beginners, it can be a little tricky when it comes to folding the paper in a way that will form a diamond shape. With some patience and a few simple steps, you can create your very own origami diamond.

First, you will need to get out a piece of paper that is six inches by six inches. It can be origami paper in a variety of colors or just a basic piece of paper. Make sure you're working with a flat surface and that the paper is as square as possible. Start by folding the paper from the left to the right and then folding it again from the top to the bottom.

Next, take your folded paper and flip it over (think of it like turning over a book). This will make it easier to form the diamond shape. Make a diagonal fold now, bringing the bottom left corner of the paper to the top right corner of the paper. Once you have done that, you should have a paper that is divided into four triangles.

Now you want to identify the two triangles that make up what will be the diamond. You should see a line going horizontally across the page. It doesn't have to be perfect as long as you have both triangles. Once you have this line, you will find another line going up and down that splits the line in half. On either side of this line, you should see the two triangles that will form the diamond.

Flip the paper over and repeat the above steps to form the diamond shape. Once you have done this, flip the paper back over and find the two parts that form the "diamond" (not including the flaps). To complete the diamond shape, fold the left part of the first part of the diamond to meet the center of the diamond. Flip the paper over and do the same with the right part.

Now take your diamond and flip it upside down so you can find the two pockets on either side of the diamond. Flip it back over and gently blow into the bottom of the diamond to extend the top. This will give your origami diamond more definition, and you are now finished. All it takes is a few simple folds and you have your very own origami diamond.

How to Replace Motor Mounts on the Chrysler New Yorker 1994 Through 1996
Replacing your motor mounts on your Chrysler New Yorker from 1994 through 1996 models can be done in a few easy steps and can save you money on a costly repair bill, if done correctly. You may have difficulty shifting because of motor movement, or you may hear knocking noises. Here are the steps to replacing your mounts:

1. Choose a level, concrete surface (strong 3/4 inch plywood can make softer surfaces or the ground workable). Place a full width piece of 2 by 6, or 2x8 inch wood between a jack and the engine oil pan -- but not extending under the subframe.

2. Loosen, but do not remove the upper nuts that connect the mount to the upper mounting-bracket using a ratchet and socket. Loosen the lower nuts: But, do not remove them from the bolt attaching them to subframe, through holes in the subframe, using your ratchet, an extension and a socket, for both mounts.

3. The transmission mount: Prepare to remove the third mount much in the same manner as the engine mounts (of a different design) at the rear of the transmission This mount may need to be replaced for backward and forward stability.

4. Remove the mount nuts and replace only one mount at a time: Raising the engine far enough with the jack to get either one of the mounts off, then replace it as follows.

5. Slide the studs on the bottom of the new mount into the holes in the subframe -- and lower the jack a little to seat the engine mounting bracket down lightly onto the stud(s) on the top of the mount, maintaining alignment, so not binding, by tightening nuts and bolts little by little.

6. Install the lower nuts and "finger tighten" at the subframe, loosely as before, just by a few threads, to retain the engine positioning. Install the upper nuts and "finger tighten", at the engine bracket, as well. Install the transmission mount by much the same techniques as the engine mounts.

7. Now, lower the engine a little.

8. Finally, torque all the mount attaching nuts and bolts to the manufacturer's recommended number of foot-pounds with a torque wrench and a socket.

9. Remove the jack from under the oil pan.

By following these steps, you can confidently and cost-effectively replace those motor mounts on your Chrysler New Yorker 1994 through 1996. Be sure to watch carefully as you lower and raise the engine, so as not to disturb any other parts, like the brakes, exhaust, or steering components. Always use proper safety equipment and understanding of the working area to ensure a successful repair.

How to Read an Annual Report
When investing in a company, one of the best resources to use is its annual report. This document is a detailed summary of the company's financial performance for the year, as well as other essential information about the company. Reading it can give a clear insight into the business, and how well it is performing. It also reveals how well the company is using its resources, in case you are thinking of investing in it or taking a loan from it. Here are some key steps to read an annual report. 

Decide what type of annual report you want. There are two types of annual reports – the regular shareholder's report and the official government 10-K form. The shareholder's report is more comprehensive and has more analysis, while the 10-K is more accurate. Both contain a similar structure, but there are some differences.

Get a company’s annual report. You can find this on the company’s website, or you can request a copy from its investor relations department.

Get a 10-K. You can get a 10-K from the company's own website or from the Securities and Exchange Commission's EDGAR database.

Read the letter from the chairperson. The letter from the chairperson of the Board of Directors or the CEO of the company is the opening section of an annual report. It gives the reason why the report was written, and summarises the firm's activities, performance, and investors’ involvement in the company.

Read the business description. This is a summary of the company's activities, business situation, products, services, and target markets. It typically covers the company's strengths and weaknesses. 

Look over the list of directors and officers of the company. This section might give short biographies of the individuals sitting on the board and company officers like the President or CEO.

Look over the ten-year summary. This is a summary of the company’s performance over the last 10 years. It is usually expressed in percentages and in dollars and cents. It also lists financial highlights from the year, such as total sales, total net profit, and total assets.

Check out the risk factors. One of the areas in which the regular shareholder’s report and the official government annual report (form 10-K) differ is that the latter requires a risk assessment. This covers potential issues that might affect the future performance of the company, such as legal issues, new laws, or taxes that could affect the firm.

Read the management discussion. This is a summary of the business situation written by the management, highlighting positives and negatives from the year. It will also explain the future strategies of the firm, and how the company's management plans to achieve its goals. 

Review the sales and marketing section. This is a summary of how well the company is performing when it comes to sales and marketing. It details the description and performance of sales, marketing, and how effective the campaigns were. 

Read about the company’s holdings. Subsidiaries, brands, and addresses where the company has offices or plants will be listed here. It will also include information on any legal proceedings in which the company has been involved. 

Read the letter of certified public accountant (CPA) opinion. This letter gives an opinion by an auditor on the accuracy and reliability of the accounts, as well as any issues they deem worth mentioning.

Review the financial statements. The financial statement of an annual report is the most critical part of the document. It includes the company's financial performance statistics, balance sheet, income statements, and cash flow statement. It also contains information about liabilities, assets, equity, and capital expenditures.

Review the stock price history. This shows the company’s share price over time, as well as any shareholder activities.

Look out for companies with changing messages. If a company is devoted to creating healthy customers one year and selling soda and candy the next, something may be wrong with its management and leadership.

Beware of changing accounting practices. If, for instance, a company suddenly tallies up a large impairment charge (a reduction on the balance sheet due to a loss of goodwill), you should be worried why the company’s goodwill has diminished.

Read the proxy statement. The proxy statement, or proxy, is an attachment to the official 10-K form that shows how much the company’s executives are being paid. It also will show how many options they have, and how much money they will be receiving in bonuses. 

Look for actual, not adjusted, earnings. When you are comparing different companies, make sure to compare the actual earnings, rather than the adjusted earnings. This will give you a better indication of the company’s true performance.

These are some steps you need to take to read an annual report and make sure you understand it in order to make an informed investment decision. Make sure to get the official 10-K form, as it gives the most reliable information, and read it thoroughly before investing.

Hosting a weight loss contest can be a great way to help motivate people to reach their fitness goals. Preparing for a contest will help ensure that your participants get the most out of the challenge. Follow these steps to make sure your weight loss contest runs smoothly:

Set the dates for the competition. Give yourself plenty of time to plan the contest and provide ample time for participants to prepare for the start date. You should also decide how long the competition will last. A short-term competition (3 to 4 weeks) or a longer-term competition (2 to 3 months) will depend on the size of your group, and desired outcomes.

Set realistic expectations. Participants should be aware that weight loss will not happen overnight, and that healthy and practical steps should be taken to reach their weight loss goals. Going overboard and focusing solely on short-term results may cause participants to burn out and give up on the challenge.

Determine how to measure success. Will you measure participants on the amount of weight lost, or based on body fat percentage? Will there be any other items you consider such as body measurements, fitness tests, or health tests?

Decide if participants will work as teams or individually. Working together as a team can provide a sense of camaraderie and support that can be very helpful in the weight loss process. However, individuals may feel more motivated to go that extra mile to reach their personal weight loss goals.

Set the entry fee (if you're going to have one). Entry fees can be used to offset the cost of incentives and prizes, but should be fair and reasonable.

Determine what the winner will receive. Will it be a cash prize or a gift card? Create a special prize for the overall winner, and consider also giving out prizes for second and third place finishers.

Obtain authorization before you announce it if you plan to hold the weight loss challenge at work. Make sure you understand the policies at your workplace and what incentives can be given out.

Get others involved. Ask a fitness coach or a nutritionist to contribute their knowledge to the challenge. Ask a local health food store to contribute food or products to help the participants reach their goals.

Emphasize health. Emphasizing health is even more important than weight loss itself. Make sure that participants know to stay within safe parameters and that they are eating nutritious foods and sleeping well to reach their goals.

Motivate with additional incentives. Offering incentives and rewards throughout the challenge will help keep participants motivated and engaged in the contest. It’s a good idea to check in with participants to make sure they are on the right track.

Attract participants with supplementary educational opportunities. If appropriate, consider providing educational opportunities such as workshops, informational videos, or online resources for participants.

Establish clear contest guidelines. Inform your participants of the rules (which should include no cheating!) and any other expectations and protocols you have in place.

Outline the weigh-in and measurement procedures. Consistency is key. Participants should know when, where, and how they’ll be weighed and measured. This could be done at a gym or in a designated area of the workplace.

Provide a firm start date for the competition. Let everyone know in advance when the challenge will begin, and be sure to announce it frequently in the weeks leading up to the start date.

Encourage all participants to schedule a physical with their doctors prior to starting the challenge. This is important so that participants can make sure that they are healthy enough to start the challenge and do not have any underlying health issues that need to be addressed.

Host the initial weigh-in to kick off the competition. If you can, have your participants record their progress in writing or electronically.

Send out regular group emails during the competition. This is a great way to check-in with participants, keep them updated on their progress, and offer any extra advice or support needed along the way.

Organize small events during the competition. Having group goals and activities can help keep participants accountable and assist in team building. This could be a hike, a yoga session, a cooking class, etc.

Create a private Facebook group for the participants. This is an excellent way for people to post their progress, share information, and encourage each other on their journey.

Host the final meeting and weigh-in. Gather support from your group and any special guests. Be sure to make this weigh-in as exciting as possible. Have celebrations and motivational speeches afterwards.

Calculate the final percentages to get your winner. Have a professional measure/weigh the final results and announce the winner.

Announce the winner and award the prize. Make sure that you recognize the winner and their hard work with words of encouragement and gratitude.

Celebrate! Celebrate the success of all of your participants. Offer words of encouragement, gratitude, and thanks. Congratulate the winner and recognize everyone's efforts. Host a party with food and drinks to celebrate all the hard work that everyone has put into the challenge.

Writing a DBQ essay can be a daunting task, especially for those unfamiliar with the format. However, with proper research and preparation, anyone can write a great DBQ essay. Here are some tips to help you when writing a DBQ essay:

1. First, familiarize yourself with the format and the structure of a DBQ essay. You will be given 15 minutes to read the prompt, analyze the documents, and do any pre-writing. Read the prompt and think about what outside information from societies, time periods, or themes come to mind when considering the prompt. Determine your opinion on the prompt and formulate a tentative thesis before looking at the documents.

2. Once you have familiarized yourself with the prompt, start analyzing the documents. Look at and consider the point of view (POV) used by each author in their document. Determine which logical categories the documents can be placed in to best address the prompt question. Furthermore, make sure you include at least one additional historical document in your essay.

3. Solidify your thesis statement. Once you've assessed the documents and determined their content and the point of view, you should have a good idea of what your tentative thesis should look like. Write a sentence or two of historical context about the time period you are discussing. Make sure to include information about the time period and its characteristics in your paper.

4. Write the body paragraphs. Start each paragraph with a topic sentence, explain the connection of that topic sentence to your thesis statement, and then move on to analyze the documents in the context of that topic sentence. Make sure to include in-text citations when necessary.

5. Write the conclusion. Make sure to restate the thesis statement, re-emphasize the arguments, and provide a brief summary of the documents analyzed.

6. After the essay is finished, take a few moments to review it. Make sure that you have the necessary outside information to back up your arguments and that everything is written correctly. Add any additional information you may have forgotten or noticed in the document.

Following these simple guidelines can help anyone write a DBQ essay successfully and on time. The key is to read the prompt fully, understand the question, and give yourself enough time to research the documents and craft a well-written essay. Good luck!

Changing the timing belt on a 2.0L, 4-cylinder Mazda 626 from 1993 to 2003 can be complicated and time-consuming, but when done properly, can save you money in the long run. The following steps will help make this process smoother and safer. 

Before you start, be sure to stock up with the necessary tools. You will need a 10mm and 21mm socket wrench, a flathead screwdriver, a 10mm and 21mm wrench, and a pair of pliers. Additionally, have a rubber stop-block, jack-stand, and a scissor or bottle jack on-hand.

Start by barely loosening each of the 11 bolts connecting the overhead cam (OHC) valve cover to the engine. Once the bolts are in place, you can take off the OHC valve cover. After that, line up the timing marks on the back of the cam sprockets so that they are straight across. Double-check that the cylinder one is at top dead center (TDC) on the compression stroke. Then, securely place a rubber stop-block or stopper from a wine bottle that is not made of cork to put it in place and jam the cam sprockets.

Next, loosely loosen the front wheel lug nuts on the right-hand side of the car. Then, jack up the that side and use a jack-stand to support the car. Make sure to place the jack and stand on solid, flat concrete or stone base. Remove the plastic splash-guard cover beneath the engine and extend it to cover the side of the wheel well. After that, firmly secure the engine with the scissor or bottle jack, paying attention not to exert too much upward pressure. Place a strong piece of wood between the engine and jack for protection.

The next step requires removing the plastic top half timing cover by loosening 4 small bolts near each corner. Then, remove the harmonic pulley bolt you previously loosened and take off the pulley. Put the bolt back in to keep the sprocket on and make sure the sprocket key is kept in its slot. Afterward, take out the retaining screws from the lower half timing cover, and carefully dismantle the lower timing cover. You may need to maneuver it in order to clear the alignment pin-block near the crankshaft sprocket. 

Now, you're ready to get the new timing belt in place. Make sure the belt is properly aligned over the mating sprockets, and then, start by pushing it over the crankshaft sprocket first. Put the belt around the left cam sprocket and ensure it is properly placed. Then, move the belt around the harmonic pulley and double-check it is threaded correctly. Double-check the alignment of the markings on the cam sprockets, and finish off by replacing the lower timing cover and all associated bolts.

Finally, start the engine and double-check the timing marks. If you noticed any issues, you can readjust the belt. Make sure to clean off the OHC valve cover and all associated oil, and replace any bolts you had removed. Following these steps, you should have successfully changed the timing belt on your 2.0L, 4-cylinder Mazda 626 from 1993 to 2003.

Dealing with an abusive friend can be tricky and often difficult to talk about. But it’s important to confront them about their behavior in order to manage the situation and preserve the friendship, if it's possible. 

The first step is to confront your friend about the abuse. Be as specific as possible about the comments, attitudes, or behaviors that you find hurtful or wrong. When doing so, focus on the issue and the behavior, rather than attacking the person. This will help keep the conversation constructive as opposed to accusatory and aggressive.

Try to refocus the conversation on them and identify why they behave in such an abusive way. Think about their motivations and valid feelings. Abusive friends often point out how wrong or inadequate you are, but their comments are likely a reflection of a deeper problem. Offering empathy and understanding may help to break down the barriers that are causing them to become abusive.

Be honest about your feelings. Let your friend know what it is that makes you feel so hurt or uncomfortable. Express your emotions in a calm and composed manner, such as ‘I feel sad when you say those kinds of things to me’. Doing so allows your friend to consider what it is that they’re doing wrong and how it affects you.

Using humor can sometimes help to cope with your friend’s abuse. Making a joke can make you feel better and might draw their attention to the abusive behavior without having to confront them directly. It is important to remember, however, that sometimes abusive friends misinterpret jokes or comments as an attack.

In order to protect yourself from further abuse, it is important to inform your friend of the consequences of any particularly serious or ongoing abuse. Let them know what you intend to do in order to correct their behavior, such as removing yourself from the situation for a while or ending the friendship entirely. This may help them realize the seriousness of their actions and could even help them take control of their own behavior. 

If an abusive friendship has become hard to manage, it might be a good idea to evaluate the quality of your relationship. Are there any positives? Think about the abusive friend’s behavior within a context of your entire friendship. Keeping a sense of perspective can help you decide whether the relationship is worth trying to mend.

When dealing with someone who is verbally or emotionally abusive, it is important to set clear boundaries. You should not have to accept abusive behavior from anyone. Insist on what is healthy for you and allow yourself to distance yourself from the situation.

Reducing the amount of time you spend with your friend can be essential to managing an abusive situation. If possible, try to limit the time you spend together or seek spaces away from them where you can take time to yourself. Don’t be afraid to arrange activities that don’t include them.

In some cases, it may be necessary to end the friendship. If your friend still won’t take responsibility for their actions or if their behavior has become toxic, it can be healthier to break away. It is important to stay calm throughout the process and remember that it is ok to put yourself first at times.

Depersonalizing the situation can also help. By understanding outside influences or drives that might be causing your friend to act in an abusive way, it could make it easier to manage a difficult situation. 

It is important to remember that you don’t deserve abuse from your friend. Being in an abusive friendship can make you feel guilty or like no one understands, but it is important to remember that the fault lies with them and not with you. .

It is also important to consider whether or not you are being abused in other ways in your life. Often, patterns of abuse can occur in multiple places, such as in your home or at work, so it is important that you seek support and advice.

Once you have taken the decision that you no longer wish to stay friends with an abusive friend, don’t feel guilty. Cutting a friend out of your life is never easy, but making healthy choices for yourself means putting what’s right for you ahead of what’s right for your friend.

In order to manage an abusive friendship, it is important to look out for signs of emotional distancing, narcissism, controlling behavior, or shaming behavior. If you can identify any of these traits in your friend, it can help you figure out how best to handle them. 

Dealing with an abusive friend can be difficult, but with courage, honesty, and understanding, you can learn to protect yourself, manage the situation, and even preserve the friendship - if it's possible.

Becoming an insurance broker in California can be an exciting and rewarding opportunity, especially if you're looking to take ownership and control over your financial future. Insurance brokers are licensed professionals, so the process of becoming one isn't nearly as easy as opening up an online brokerage account. It requires a commitment of time and effort, as well as licensing requirements that must be met. But, with perseverance and dedication, you can become a licensed insurance broker.

The first step to becoming an insurance broker in California is to identify opportunities. There are a wide variety of types of insurance for which you can specialize. Take the time to do a thorough research into the different insurance types, as well as the carriers that specialize in each type. Consider the markets for each type of insurance, as this will help to determine where you can find potentials clients.

Before pursuing a license as a California insurance broker, it is important to consider your skill set. Do you have any prior experience or knowledge in the field that could benefit your career as a broker? Knowing your strengths and weaknesses so that you don’t over or under estimate your abilities is a great way to ensure a successful start.

California requires brokers to specialize in a particular type of insurance, such as life insurance or auto insurance. You’ll need to decide what type of insurance you’d like to specialize in before you can proceed. Speaking with an experienced broker is a great way to learn more about the profession and the different types of insurance.

Once you’ve decided what type of insurance you’d like to specialize in, you will need to complete the required prelicensing education. Every type of insurance has its own educational requirements that must be fulfilled before you can sit for the licensing exam. It is important to note that the education requirements not only need to be completed, but they must be completed at an approved provider or school. Once you’ve registered and completed the required coursework, you can take the licensing exam.

Prior to sitting for the exam, you will also need to submit your fingerprints. This is done via an approved ink-less fingerprint provider, which can usually be found at a local sheriff’s office or other approved location. After submitting your fingerprints, you will be able to take the licensing exam for the type of insurance you plan on selling.

Once you’ve received your certificate of completion from the educational provider, you’ll be able to apply for a license online using the Fast Licensing Application Service (FLASH). You’ll need to fill out the requisite paperwork and submit your fingerprints again, and then you’ll be able to print or download your insurance license directly from the licensing website.

Before transacting, soliciting or negotiating the sale of insurance, it is necessary to submit additional documents demonstrating financial security. The documents required depend on the type of insurance you are specializing in, so be sure to check the California Department of Insurance website for the specific requirements. For example, property and personal/casualty specialists will need to submit a financial statement, a trust account statement of satisfactory completion, and a surety bond in the sum of $50,000. Life, accident and health, and auto specialists will need to submit a surety bond in the sum of $100,000. Lastly, bail agents will need to submit a Bond of Bail Agent in the sum of $1,000.

Once you’ve been issued a license, you may need to consider working at a brokerage firm. In some cases, working at an established broker is the only way to gain the requisite experience needed to obtain your own brokerage. You can search online job search sites to find firms that may be hiring or you can apply directly to local insurance brokers in your area.

In addition to working with an established broker, California also requires that its licensed brokers complete continuing-education classes in order to remain licensed for a two year period. The courses must be approved by the CDI and must provide appropriate education in entire lines of insurance in the type of insurance you are selling. Completing the courses is necessary to maintain your license, and will ensure that you are up to date on the latest changes and trends in the insurance world. 

By taking the right steps and doing the necessary research, you can become a licensed insurance broker in California. Once you have the necessary licenses and education, you will be on your way to beginning a rewarding career in insurance.

How to Make a Bee Costume' 

Are you looking for something unique to wear for a costume party? A bee costume might be the perfect solution! It involves a mix of materials you can purchase at hardware stores, craft stores, and online. While the materials needed may be a little unusual, the end result is a cute bee costume that is sure to be a hit. 

Start by picking out a good piece of black clothing as the base for your costume. A dress, an oversized t-shirt, or a black shirt and pants are all good options. Then go to your local hardware store and pick up some yellow duct tape. You’ll need it to create the stripes for the costume. 

You’ll want to mark a point on your black clothing across your armpits and at the bottom of your torso. Then, adhere stripes of duct tape starting at the line just below your armpits and working down the shirt. Turn the shirt or dress over and connect the front strips of tape with strips in the back. 

Once the stripes are finished, pick out your black pants or tights and black shoes. Then, head to the craft store and pick up a yellow headband, black and yellow pipe cleaners, and yellow pom poms. 

For the headpiece, wrap the bottom of a yellow pipe cleaner around the top of the headband. Then, wrap a black pipe cleaner in a spiral around the yellow pipe cleaner. Next, twist the pipe cleaners around your fingers before wearing. 

To make the bee's wings, grab some wire hangers. Stretch out the hook on the top of each hanger and shape it into an oblong shape. Then, pick up some black pantyhose and stretch one leg of the pantyhose over each oblong shape. To make the wings even more durable, you can paint them with Mod Podge. 

Finally, pick up some black elastic straps at your local craft store and sew the straps to the center section of the wings, so that they stay securely in place. 

Each step will help to create a unique and insect-worthy bee costume that will turn heads at any costume party. Just have fun while you make your costume and don’t forget to add any other details you’d like for your perfect bee look. When you’re done, you’ll be the buzz of the party!

Printing only a portion of a document or web page can be necessary for various reasons. Maybe you don’t need all of the information but need a specific section, or you’re short on paper. Either way, it’s important to know how to take control of your printing and save both paper and money.

The most efficient way of printing only a specific section of an email, a web page, or a document is to use the "Selection" and "Current Page" options provided in most print menu dialog boxes.

Try Printing Selected Text and/or Images

The first step is to select the text and/or images you would like to print. This can be done by highlighting the section using your cursor. Once selected, head to the file menu and choose “Print”. The print menu dialog box should appear. Under the Print Range, select “Selection”. This will tell your printer to only print the selected portion. Finally, click “Print” and the selection should print.

Now Print Only the Current Page

If you just need the page that you’re on, you can still do that, without having to select anything. Instead of selecting Selection in the Print Range, select “Current Page” and proceed to “Print”. This will print only what’s visible on the screen.

Print Nonconsecutive Pages in a Document

When printing a document, such as a PDF or a word document, you might be looking to print only a few scattered pages, or a range of pages that aren’t consecutive. To do this, select “File” then “Print”. If you’re using Microsoft Word, choose “Page Range” (for Macs) or “Pages” (for Windows). On the bottom, you’ll see a text box, type in the pages you would like to print, separating them by comma. Once you’re sure it’s the right selection, click “Print”.

Print a Series of Consecutive Pages

Finally, if you would like to print a certain range of pages consecutively, you can use the same method. Select “File” then “Print”. Again, if you’re using Microsoft Word, choose “Pages" or “Page Range”. Type in the starting page number and ending page number in the text box, separating them by a hyphen (e.g. 3-5). Check through the preview to make sure the pages you would like are included. Once you’re done, select “Print”.

In conclusion, printing only a specific section of an email, a web page, or a document can be done with a few simple steps. Utilize the options available in the print menu dialog box to ensure you are only printing what’s necessary. If done correctly, this can help save both money and time.

Becoming a podiatrist is a long and arduous process, but if you are passionate about helping people with their feet, the rewards are great. The path to becoming a qualified and practiced podiatrist generally requires four to five years of serious study, including undergraduate study, medical school and a specialized residency. Here's what you need to do to become a podiatrist.

Step 1: Take advanced placement classes before college. A successful career as a podiatrist starts with a good foundation in the sciences, and taking advanced placement classes can be a great way to get ahead. Taking advanced placement classes in high school not only primes you for college, but also frees up more time in college to focus on your studies instead of catching up on material.

Step 2: Complete a bachelor's degree in premed. Earning a premed degree from an accredited college or university is a must before taking the Podiatry Medical College Admission Test. Studying premed should include physics, chemistry, anatomy, biochemistry and math, although there are other courses you may take to prepare for the test.

Step 3: Pass the Medical College Admission Test, also known as the MCAT. The MCAT is a comprehensive examination in the biological and physical sciences, and is required for admission to podiatric medical school. It can be difficult and time consuming, but thorough preparation can be the difference between success and failure.

Step 4: Find a college of pediatric medicine. There are nine accredited colleges of podiatric medicine in the US. While you may have to move to a college, they offer specialized education and experiences that are necessary to become a successful podiatrist.

Step 5: Apply to pediatric college. After completing your undergraduate course work, it is time to apply to pediatric colleges. Each college has its own application process, but they all require: MCAT scores, official transcripts from all schools attended, letters of recommendations and a personal statement.

Step 6: Complete the requirements for your Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (DPM) degree. Typically, these courses will include credits in anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pharmacology, radiology, pathology, and dermatology. Most colleges also require students to complete general courses like business, politics and ethics.

Step 7: Pass the first two parts of the National Board exams. These exams are taken in two parts, with the first one covering basic science and is usually taken at the end of the second year of podiatry school, and the second part covering a wide range of topics from medical history to clinical competency.

Step 8: Complete a residency in podiatry. After passing the first two parts of the National Board exams, you can begin your podiatry residency. This is a two-year program that will give you the experience and skills you need to practice podiatry effectively and safely.

Step 9: Consider specialized training. During your residency training, you may want to consider specializing in a certain area of podiatry – such as orthopaedics, dermatology or advanced foot surgery – to gain more experience and credibility.

Step 10: Pass the final part of the American Podiatric Medical Licensing Exam after completing your residency. After completing an accredited residency in podiatry, graduates must pass the written podiatry state board exam to obtain a license. Passing this national exam is the final step to becoming a practicing podiatrist.

Making your own Jello mold is a fun and simple way to enjoy a sweet treat. With just a few inexpensive ingredients, you can make a colorful Jello mold that will impress your family and friends.

First, purchase your mold shape. You can find specialty Jello molds in silicone, metal, or plastic in shapes ranging from stars to skulls. Opt for a silicone mold as this will create an easier release than a metal or plastic one.

Next, purchase as many boxes of Jello as colors you would like to be layered in your mold. To make a multi-colored Jello mold, you will need one box of Jello for each color. Bring a pot of water to a boil and add one of the packages of Jello to the boiling liquid. Whisk the Jello powder until it dissolves. Repeat with remaining colors of Jello in separate bowls. Then, allow the Jello mixtures to cool to room temperature.

Once at room temperature, add two tablespoons of unflavored gelatin to each bowl of Jello. You can also add a can of crushed pineapple or other canned fruit to the Jello mixture for additional flavor.

Pour your cooled Jello into the mold if you want it to be a single color, or if you have several colors you want to layer, then take the colors one at a time. Spray the metal or silicone mold with cooking spray and pour one mixed bowl of gelatin into the bottom of your pan or mold. Let this layer solidify in the refrigerator for an hour or two. Then, spoon the second color onto the top of the last color. Continue this layering process until all of your Jello is in the mold. Place this in the refrigerator to set overnight.

When you are ready to release your Jello from the mold, make sure to wash your hands to avoid staining the Jello. Then, loosen the edges of the Jello against the pan by pressing your finger lightly against the edges. Place a platter that is flat on the top of the Jello pan or mold, and flip the mold so that the platter is face up. Fill a large bowl with warm water, and immerse the gelatin mold in the bowl of warm water to loosen the edges. Then, remove it after 15 seconds and serve the Jello by cutting it into slices. Enjoy!

Tipping can be an intimidating, but important, part of many cultures around the world. Showing gratitude for a great service or experience through a gratuity is an essential part of overall etiquette. Knowing when, and how, to tip can be a bit of a challenge, but understanding the proper protocol of your destination ahead of time can give you the confidence to properly acknowledge great service when you encounter it. 

When tipping waiters or waitresses, 15% is usually the expected amount for a service that is considered average. Under no circumstances should you leave less than 10%; and if your service was above and beyond your expectations, you should definitely leave them a bit extra. If you’re ever unsure, simply ask the staff what their policy is when it comes to tipping.

If you receive exceptional help from a sommelier, wine steward or a bartender, be sure to show your appreciation with a little something extra. In the US, for wine stewards, the general rule of thumb is to think about leaving a few dollars (around $5) for each bottle of wine that is opened, but this is truly up to you and your budget. If you are offered help or advisement from a bartender, you can typically leave 10 or 15% of the tab; however, you can also just leave a few dollars in a tip jar to show your gratitude.

When you order food delivery, don’t forget to factor in the tip. About 10% of the tab is appropriate, but again, it’s up to you to decide how generous you’d like to be if the service was exceptional.

Generally, if you’re getting any sort of type of service, you should factor in a tip. If you’re getting your hair cut, styled or nails done, you should account for the gratuity when you pay. It’s usually expected that you give 10-15% of the total price of the service.

If you’re staying at a hotel, leaving a tip for the porters, bellhops, and housekeeping is commonplace. For porters, $2-$5 per bag is the standard amount; and for housekeeping, $2-$5 per night is often sufficient.

When you take a taxi, Uber or Lyft, it’s typical to tip the driver. 10-15% is ideal; however, if you’re running short on cash, you can offer a few dollars. At the airport, the skycap who helps you out with your luggage should also be tipped. Again, $2-$5 per bag is an adequate amount.

If you’re heading out on a cruise, you’ll want to be sure to have some money for gratuities. While the tip amounts are usually assessed as part of your overall package, additional tipping for exceptional service may be expected.

When it comes to tipping for specific services, such as those people who help you with your personal grooming, let your conscience be your guide. Most people who provide such services appreciate being acknowledged for a job well done.

In most places, such as the US, it’s customary to tip anywhere from $1 to $5 for any services you get outside of traditional tipping establishments. For example, if you have someone helping you to load groceries at the store, you can leave a few dollars in the tip jar if it is available. For furniture delivery services, $5 to $15 per delivery worker is usually the expected gratuity.

At times, tips are not necessary. be aware if tips are included in your tab; for example, included tips may be included in your cruise, dinner, cab ride, hotel stay, etc.

For special occasions such as the holiday season, planning for extra gratuities for those who deserve a bit of acknowledgment for their efforts is an excellent way to show appreciation. If you have a housekeeper, maid or nanny, it might be appropriate to offer extra pay for that week for their extra assistance.

If you're traveling abroad, be sure to look into the customs of the country regarding tipping. Here are a few tips for some foreign countries. For Mexico, pesos are preferred for tips, but you can also tip in dollars. For Canada, 10-15% is a good rule of thumb, while Costa Rica is around 10% or up to 25%. In the United Kingdom, 10-15% is appropriate, while France also typically has a gratuity of 10-15%. The same goes for Italy, Spain and Australia/New Zealand. For China, tipping is not expected, while Japan typically skips the tip all together. In South Korea, 10-15% is often expected, while in India, 10-15% is a good tip for any service provider. For Egypt, 10-15% tips are expected for wait staff and hotel employees, while in Israel it’s common to tip about 10%. Saudi Arabia also expects around 10-15%, while any tip in Morocco should be no more than 10%. For South Africa, tips are typically expected for services rendered.

Wise travelers will be sure to look into the tipping customs for their destination before arriving. Knowing what is expected can help you show proper respect for the culture and appreciate their tradition of tipping when appropriate.

How to Clean Ugg Boots

Uggs boast coziness and fashionable appeal that you don't want to compromise. To keep Ugg boots looking great, it’s important to know how to clean them. Over time, dirt and grime can accumulate on the exterior surface of the boots, leaving them looking dull and shabby. Whether your Uggs are made from suede, leather, or sheepskin wool, the steps included in this article will help to bring them back to life.

Use a suede brush to comb the outside of the boots. To brush the Uggs, start by taking a dry suede brush and run it in one direction over the entire surface of the boots. This will help remove the dirt and grime that can accumulate and build up over time.

Wet the outside surface of the boots. Once you have used the suede brush to remove the dirt and debris, you can then wet the outside of the boots. Use lukewarm water to dampen the exterior surface. Avoid getting the boots too wet as this can cause damage and warping to the material.

Squeeze a small amount of cleaning product onto a damp sponge. There are many cleaning products available that are specifically designed for use on Ugg boots. These products can be found in stores specializing in footwear care or online. Choose a product that is gentle yet effective so that you can keep your Ugg boots looking their best.

Use the sponge to work the cleaning product into the surface of the boots. Gently use circular motions to spread the cleaning solution across the entire surface of the boots. Make sure to get into the crevices and hard to reach areas. Focus on one area at a time and move on to the next section once it is finished.

Rinse the boots off. Once the cleaning solution has been thoroughly worked into the surface of the boots, use lukewarm water and a damp cloth to rinse off the cleaning product. Do this until all of the residue has been removed and the Uggs are left looking clean.

Stuff the boots with newspaper or paper towel. Once the boots have been rinsed off, you can then stuff them with newspaper or paper towel. This will help to absorb any excess water and will also help to maintain the shape of the boots.

Wait 24 to 48 hours for the Uggs to dry. Do not put the Uggs in a warm or sunny spot to speed up the drying process. Instead, let them dry naturally at room temperature for the best results.

Add the finishing touches. Once the Uggs are completely dried, you can add the finishing touches to bring them back to life. A suede brush, and a protector spray or waterproofing spray, can be used to clean, protect and restore the look of the Uggs. For leather Uggs a leather conditioner or cream may be especially helpful in restoring the appearance.

Realize that this method is not recommended by the manufacturers, as there is a potential for damaging the boots. Leather and suede Uggs should never be placed in a washing machine or dryer. Putting them in either could cause irreparable damage, so it is best to avoid this step.

Place the Ugg boots into a pillowcase. For sheepskin wool Uggs, another cleaning option is to place the boots into a pillowcase and tie the top. Use a cold water wash setting and a mild detergent on a gentle cycle in the washing machine.

Put the washing machine onto the wool cycle. This is a gentle cycle that helps prevent damage to the delicate wool. Set the machine to use cold water and a mild detergent.

Remove from the washing machine. When the cleaning cycle has finished, carefully remove the Uggs from the washing machine. Do not use a dryer for Uggs.

Brush into top shape again. Once the Uggs have been removed from the washing machine, use a suede brush to comb through the wool. This will help to restore the boots to their original shape.

Be very careful with other types of Ugg boot. While the method of cleaning sheepskin Uggs is relatively simple, other types of Uggs may require more attention. Some some Uggs are made with leather, velvet, or other delicate materials.

Clean such Uggs by simply wiping them gently, in one direction. Use a clean, damp cloth and gentle circular motions until all of the dirt and grime has been removed.

Add protectant, if desired. After wiping the Uggs, you may want to add a protectant such as a waterproofing spray or a leather conditioner. This will help to keep the Uggs in good condition for longer.

Use chalk to remove oil and grease stains. If you find a patch of oil or grease on the exterior of the Uggs, use a piece of chalk to remove the staining. Rub it on the affected area and then wipe off with a clean cloth.

Use an eraser to remove dirt and salt stains. Another option for removing dirt and salt stains is to use an eraser. Gently rub the area until the stains have been removed.

Remove water spots. If water spots are visible on the exterior of the Uggs, take a clean cloth and dampen it with lukewarm water. Gently rub the spots until they are no longer visible.

Comb the wooly part to remove debris. For the wool (inner) lining, use a wide-toothed comb to remove any pieces of debris or dirt. Take care not to pull or tug on the wool too hard.

Remove odors with baking soda. To remove odors from the Uggs, pour some baking soda into the shoes and leave it overnight. The baking soda will absorb any unpleasant odors that may have accumulated.

Limit your Ugg use. To keep your Ugg boots looking their best, it may be best to limit the amount of wear and tear they receive. When they are not in use, store them in a cool and dry place to help keep them in top condition.

Clean the boots by hand. This is the most traditional way to clean Ugg boots and is still the simplest method. It is easy to do and doesn't require any special ingredients. All you need is a clean cloth, black shampoo, and cold water.

Invest in a care kit. If you would like to give your Ugg boots the best care, you can invest in a Ugg care kit. These specialized kits usually include a cleansing solution and many other products to help keep the Uggs in top condition.

Test for color fastness. After cleaning your Uggs, it is important to double check that your chosen cleaning product will not damage the color of your boots. Do a spot test on a discreet area with a small amount of the cleaning product before you start.

Never dry using direct heat. Heat can be very damaging to your Ugg boots, and the drying process should always be done at room temperature. Never put them in a dryer or leave them in direct sunlight as this could cause warping of the material and discoloration.

How to Fix a LCD Monitor Power Problem' is a problem many of us have faced when our LCD monitors no longer seem to turn on, or their display is fuzzy and distorted. Fortunately, this is a rather straightforward problem that just requires a few simple steps to do the fix. With a few basic tools and a bit of know-how, you can get your LCD monitor up and running again in no time.

First, it is important to make sure that the monitor is not completely dead by plugging it in to another outlet. If another outlet does not work, then it is time to take a closer look at the problem. To do this, the back cover of the monitor must be taken off, revealing the main inner components of the monitor.

First, remove the stand from the back of the LCD monitor. Lay the monitor down carefully and ensure that it is laid backside up to prevent any accidental damage. The next part can be quite difficult, as it requires removing the back panel of the monitor.

To do this, you will need to find the side with the small space at the top and bottom. Using a small Philips screwdriver, insert it into this space and turn the screwdriver so as to cause the locks to come undone. Do this all around the panel, using whichever space you can find. They can be quite tight to open, so be careful not to damage the edges of the panel in the process.

Once the cover is off, you will see the main power board component and several other smaller components placed around the board. Now it is time to remove the side panels. Do so by standing up, unplugging the cables, and lifting off the sides.

Now you can remove the tape at the top and bottom of the power board, followed by unplugging the two cables on either side of the board. With that unhooked, flip over the metal casing to reveal the driver board and can now access the power board.

There should be four screws placed along the sides of the power board - remove these with a pair of pliers. Now it is possible to take out the power board and identify the issue with the capacitors, which are usually located at the bottom right in clusters of two or four.

Using a soldering iron, remove the bad capacitors and replace them with new ones, fitting them into the power board in the same way as the previous capacitors. Now all that is left to do is reverse the guide - reassemble all the pieces of the monitor and place it back in its original position. Plug it in and enjoy your fixed LCD monitor!

Look up in the Online Etymology Dictionary at http://www.etymonline.com/ the root of the word "think", and see below:

think (v.) Old English þencan "imagine, conceive in the mind; consider, meditate, remember; intend, wish, desire" (past tense þohte, past participle geþoht), probably originally "cause to appear to oneself," from Proto-Germanic *thankjan (cognates: Old Frisian thinka, Old Saxon thenkian, Old High German denchen, German denken, Old Norse þekkja, Gothic þagkjan).,
Think along the root of the sentence, "Think along the root":

"tong- + ant-lang + so + wyrt"

Try to comprehend the meanings behind these words. Tongue means "spoken language"; ant-lang refers to a language or logic which moves from a known or agreed beginning state (the ant) to a known or agreed ending state; so stands for "in such a way"; and wyrt means "root".

The phrase "think along the root" can then be interpreted as "traverse from a known state to a known end-state in the pursuit of an idea, taking into account the basic underlying structure or root of the discussion". It is an expression that encourages the practice of deeper thought and the application of analytical skills.

To think from root to fruit, one must first of all identify the root. This could mean understanding the fundamental concepts and meaning that underlie a subject rather than focusing exclusively on the surface details. It could also mean delving beyond what the overt discussion states to the source from which the knowledge was gained and the framework upon which it is based.

Making a storm trooper helmet from a milk jug is a great way to save some money and create something that looks great. With a few simple steps you can create the helmet of your dreams! To create your own storm trooper helmet, here is what you need: two plastic milk jugs, a pair of scissors or an Exacto knife, masking tape, an electric drill, hot glue gun, white spray paint, and black paper.

To get started, cut the first milk jug into two pieces: the bottom half for the helmet’s main body and the top portion for details. With the second milk jug, cut off the top third of the jug with either the scissors or Exacto knife. Flip that portion over and use the electric drill to cut a hole in the front and back of the same jug.

Once the two jugs are separated, connect them together using a masking tape. For a permanent seal, use the hot glue gun to fill the gaps and permanently fuse the mugs together. Let the glue dry before moving ahead to the next step.

Spray paint your helmet white and let it dry before adding details. Here you can get creative and use a Star Wars photo or clip as a reference. Cut black paper to form the eyes, cheekbones, and mouthpiece, and then drill small holes on the eyes portion. To spice it up a bit, use some recycled parts such as bottle caps or plastic pieces you may have lying around the house to add details near the mouth area. 

And there you go! You now have your own storm trooper helmet made solely out of milk jugs. You can also customize it by adding more details or painting it with different colors. What are you waiting for? Get to work and create your own unique storm trooper helmet.

How to Carve a Hair Stick from a Twig'
Finding the perfect hair stick is often hard to do; it needs to be the right length and shape, and must be tough enough to hold up to all kinds of weather and still feel nice to the touch. But why not try making your own? Here's how you can carve a hair stick from a twig.

The first step to creating the perfect hair stick is to figure out how long it needs to be. This depends on the hairstyle you want to use it for; for a bun, for example, a stick around six inches long is a good size.

Once you know how long your stick needs to be, take a walk in your garden or the park and look for a twig that looks good and has some of the right characteristics. Make sure the twig is fairly straight and uniform, without any signs of rot or imperfections, branching or splitting. Any twig that snaps easily when bent should be discarded.

Now you have your twig, you can begin to carve. Use a sharp knife to remove any bark, and cut off any prominent protrusions. Then, grab a hacksaw and cut the stick to the desired length, making sure to remove both ends to give the stick a uniform look.

To shape the stick, you can use a file or sandpaper to make one end tapered into a blunt point, and work the other side to get the desired shape. Sand the whole stick coarsely with sandpaper, then switch to a medium grade and continue sanding until the entire stick is smooth and shaped correctly.

For the finishing touches, draw your desired design onto the stick with a pencil or ballpoint pen, then use a knife to cut into the stick at a 45 degree angle just below the lines you have drawn, and at a 45 degree angle from the top to cut out a V shaped piece of wood. Once you've done this, work smoothly to carve out the design, and sand with the finest sandpaper you have access to. To finish off, use a nail buffer (or progressively finer sandpaper, if that's what you have) to get an even smoother finish.

Finally, oil the stick and leave it to soak for a few hours, then remove any excess oil with tissue. Your handmade hair stick is now ready to use - all you need is the perfect hairstyle to go with it!

Making a duct tape pencil case is a simple and fun crafting project. All you need is two colors of duct tape, a ruler, and the pens and pencils you would like to store in the case. Follow these steps to make your own pencil case.

First, gather the items you would like to put in the case and get the measurements for the length when they are all lined up. Decide on two colors of duct tape that you would like to use for the exterior and liner of the case.

Then use a ruler to measure the length of the pen and pencils. Cut a piece of duct tape that is two to three times longer than the length of the pen. Cut two other strips and attach all three strips together to form a duct tape fabric that is slightly wider than the pens.

Next, cut two strips of the liner color tape. The strips should be the same width as the finished case you want. Put the cover and bottom pieces of tape together. Then tape the edge of the bottom of the duct tape fabric. Secure them without stretching the tape and make sure that both sides of the fabric are even.

Fold the bottom part up and crease it without sticking the edges yet. Then trim the sides of the folded portion. At this point you can stick the edges together. Make sure that the liner color tape is underneath and that it is not visible.

Using the pen as a reference, make an upper strap or loop where your pens and pencils will fit in. This can either be circles, X-shape designs, parallel lines, or any other shape you can think of. Fold the sides inward and stick them down over both the bottom and the loop, making sure that the colors don't overlap.

Now put your pens in the pocket and check if they fit. If they fit snugly, you can fold the top flap down and trim the end so that it will stick into the bottom pocket. Once that is done, fold short pieces of tape over the sides and end of the flap and any exposed edges to reinforce the entire pocket.

Finally, reinforce the bottom of the pocket with another piece of tape, if you want. Put your pens and pencils in the case, fold the flap over, tuck it in, and enjoy! You now have your own homemade duct tape pencil case.

Creating a character for 4th Edition Dungeons and Dragons can be a fun and involved process, but it also requires a bit of preparation. In order to bring a character to life in the world of 4th edition D&D, you will need to familiarize yourself with the rules and obtain the necessary resources. 

The first step is to obtain the necessary 4th edition Dungeons and Dragons books - these include the Player's Handbook, Dungeon Master's Guide, and Monster Manual. Each of these books include helpful information to help you create your character. It is important to understand the details and look up any in-depth rules as you go along. The books can be bought from bookstores, online retailers, and game stores and usually range from 20-30 USD. 

Once the books are acquired, you can begin creating the character. The general steps are as follows: 

1. Choose a race such as human, dwarf, or elf.
2. Determine the general role your character will play in the party or campaign. Options include tank, striker, controller, and leader.
3. Select a class that best fits your character's role, such as fighter, cleric, rogue, or wizard.
4. Assign ability scores, which will typically require a dice roll. Races often have bonuses to certain abilities.
5. Select skills. Your class will naturally have skills it is proficient in, but you must select others. Consider the role of your character in the adventure.
6. Choose powers associated with your class. Determine if any come from third-party sources. 
7. Select feats. Consider the prerequisites for the feat, as well as what it grants. 
8. Equip your character with suitable weaponry and armor.
9. Finally, fill in the rest of the character sheet. This includes Initiative, speed, senses, attacks, and more.

Creating a character for 4th edition D&D isn't as simple as it used to be, but with practice the process becomes simple. With the right tools and knowledge, anyone can be an expert and create powerfully crafted characters that will last the duration of their D&D adventures.

How to Write an Email
Having the capability to send an email is a great way to stay connected with people both near and far. Writing an email is an essential skill to learn when it comes to using electronic communication, and there are a few steps you will need to take before your message is sent.

Set up an email address. Before you can send any emails, you will need to establish an email account with a provider, such as Microsoft, AOL, Yahoo, or Google. When setting up the account, you will need to provide some information such as your name, contact information, and possibly even your physical address.

Click on "Compose" or "New." When you log into your email account, you should see a button or link to start a new message. Click on it, and a new window or box will open where you will type and format your message.

List the recipients' email addresses. To add the email addresses of people you are sending the message to, you will either type them in a space provided or click on addresses in your address book. If you are using a list of more than one address, be sure to separate them with commas if necessary.

Include an informative subject. It is important to include a meaningful subject line so that the recipient knows immediately what your message is about. This also helps them to locate the message more easily among all of the other emails they may have in their account.

Write the body of your email. This is the area where you actually write your message. Make sure to choose words carefully and use appropriate grammar, depending on the type of email you are writing.

Hit the "Send" button. When you are finished writing your message, you can send it by clicking on the "Send" button. Depending on your email settings, you may see a message asking you if you are sure you want to send it.

Know when a friendly email is appropriate. When writing non-business emails to friends and family, it is usually okay to use informal language and keep the tone of the message light.

Keep the subject line casual. You should also keep the subject line casual as well. This can be a brief comment about what the email is about, or a funny joke related to the topic.

Consider addressing the recipient by name. Even when writing to someone you do not know, addressing them by name adds a personal touch that can be appreciated.

Write your message clearly, but keep your language casual. Remember that not all emails need to have a professional tone, so you don't need to use unnecessary language.

Consider signing your name. It is courteous to include your name at the end of an email so the recipient knows who it is from.

Understand when formal emails are necessary. When communicating in a business setting or when applying for a job, it is important to remain professional and courteous in your emails.

Include an informative subject. Just like with friendly emails, make sure to include a recognizable subject line for professional emails.

Type a formal salutation. A formal salutation, such as "Dear [Name]," is a proper way to begin an email.

Make sure that the body of your email is concise and accurate. Write concisely and provide all necessary information, such as contact information or job details.

Include an appropriate closing. Classic closings such as "Thank you" or "Sincerely" are always appropriate in formal emails.

Provide contact information in your signature, when appropriate. If it is a professional email, it may be advisable to include your contact information, such as a phone number or physical address, at the end of your message.

Write an email to a friend who moved away. Send a friendly message just to stay in touch and let them know you are thinking of them.

Send a friendly email to a friend who never gave you an email address. If they do not have email, then consider sending them a letter instead.

Learn how to write an email to a guy. Whether it is for a business or personal purpose, make sure to use appropriate language and avoid being overly romantic.

Understand how to write an email to a girl. Do not assume that because someone is female that they will appreciate receiving romantic messages, or conversely that they will appreciate overly professional emails.

Compose a flirty email. When writing a flirty email, use light, casual language and consider ending your message with an affectionate closing such as "Love" or "XOXO".

Write a love email. To really capture someone's heart, make sure to express your feelings clearly and choose your words carefully.

Apply for a job via email. When writing a job application email, make sure to include all of the relevant skills and experiences, as well as contact information.

Know how to write an email to your professor. When writing to a professor, include an informative subject and use formal language.

Write a query letter via email. Introduce yourself and make sure to include contact information and an accurate synopsis of your project.

Use email to contact human resources. When contacting human resources, make sure to include the department in the subject line and address the message as formally as possible.

When up against a tank, be sure to have the right kind of weapons. If you do not, then it is best to split up, one group of two people on either side of the zombie, and the second group staying far away to provide backup ammunition. Have the first people focus on attacking the zombie and the second group on supplying cover fire should the zombie begin to move closer. Try to keep out of reach at all times as the tank can and will take chunks out of you if it gets close enough.

Special Infected

These zombies normally travel in packs and usually comprise of a Boomer, Hunter, Smoker and Witch. It is important to remember that the Boomer will create a distraction and call for help from its zombie friends, the Hunter will stalk its prey, the Smoker will snatch someone away from the group and the Witch will sit and wait to be disturbed.

Beware of the Boomer as when it vomits, it will create an infection area leading any competing zombies to your location. The Hunter will focus on the nearest human target and the Smoker will try and keep its snatched victims away from the group. Be wary of the Witch as she can take you down in a single hit, and if she is aware of someone in her vicinity, she will haunt them continuously.

Do not forget as well the items that you will find scattered across the maps, such as the Molotovs for burning and killing large numbers of Zombies and Pipes bombs which create an explosion that kill any zombies in its radius.
