Your Impala's auto headlights should now be fixed and running smoothly. If you noticed any improvements, or if there are any issues, you'll need to take your car to a professional and have it inspected. With just a few basic tools and the right knowledge, you'll have your 2003 Impala running in no time.

How to Make a Duct Tape iPhone Case
Making an iPhone case out of duct tape is quick, easy, and looks great! With just a few items like duct tape, plastic sheeting, and a few strips of Velcro, you can make a stylish case that will protect your phone from scratches and dings. Here's how to do it.

First, measure your phone and add 1 inch (2.5 centimeters) to each side. This will be the measurements for the two duct tape sheets you'll be making. Cut four strips of duct tape for the trim, then overlay the strips over the edges of the duct tape sheets.

Next, cut a rectangle out of a heavy-duty Ziploc bag. This will be your phone's plastic protector. Layer one of the duct tape sheets, the plastic rectangle, and your phone in a stack on top of one another. Tape the sides down with the duct tape to keep everything in place.

Cut two slits in the bottom edge of the plastic sheet. This will create tabs that you can fold over and then tape down. Fold and tape the tabs, then fold and tape the bottom tab over. Add another trim to the top edge of the plastic cover. Cut a strip of duct tape the same length as your sheets and place it on top of your sheets. 

Then, cut a second, longer strip for the back of the binding. Cover the back with the second strip of duct tape, then fold down the excess. Cut two strips of duct tape for the strap. Overlap the strips by 1½ inches (4 centimeters) and fold the excess tape along the top and bottom edges down. Now tape the end of the strap to the back of your phone case, and cut and stick a piece of self-adhesive Velcro to the front of the strap. Peel off the backing from the remaining Velcro half and stick it to the front of the case.

Now your duct tape iPhone case is ready to go and will provide your phone with optimal protection! Although the design is simple, adding a few colors of duct tape can really spice it up and add a fun look to your phone. So grab your duct tape, plastic sheeting, and Velcro and make a super cool duct tape iPhone case today!

Making beautiful tassels from leather or suede can be an enjoyable craft project and the end result can be a unique accessory or decoration. With a few basic tools and a bit of patience you can easily create your own leather or suede tassels. Here are the steps necessary to make an attractive tassel:

First, you will need to cut a piece of leather or suede that is 10 by 3½ inches (25.4 by 8.89 centimeters). This will be the body of your tassel. Then, you will need to cut a smaller piece that is 3 by ¼ inches (7.62 by 0.64 centimeters) which will be used to make the loop for hanging the tassel later on.

Once you have the two pieces of leather/suede cut, you will need to fold the smaller strip in half and to secure the ends together with glue. To ensure a secure bond, hold the ends together with a binder clip or clothespin until the glue dries.

Next, draw a horizontal line across the rectangle that is ¾ inch (1.9 centimeters) from the top/long side. This horizontal line will serve as a guideline. After that, draw a series of vertical lines that are spaced ¼ inch (0.64 centimeters) apart, starting from the bottom of the rectangle and ending up on the horizontal line.

With your vertical lines marked, you can proceed to cut them out carefully using either a sharp pair of scissors or a craft blade. With the fringe cut, use a bit of glue to adhere the small loop to the left side of the fringe.

Start rolling the fringe around the loop from left to right. When you reach the end of your fringe, secure it with some more glue. Wrap a rubber band around the tassel to hold it together until it properly dries.

Once the glue has completely dried, you can consider adding a splash of color to your tassel by wrapping a piece of ribbon or colored thread around the top of the tassel to hide the seam and for a more eye-catching look. Your newly-made tassel is now ready to be used and enjoyed.

How to Build a Fence' is a job that may seem daunting at first, but if taken one step at a time, it’s surprisingly simple. Before you begin building a fence, it's important to share the lingo with anyone who will be helping you in the process. Nodes, posts, rails, boards, caps, and other components make up the structure of a fence and solid understanding of their purpose will go a long way in ensuring a successful outcome. 

The next step is to consider the function of the fence you’re building. Is it going to be used for privacy, protection, or aesthetics? Knowing the answer to this question before you start will help you pick the right material for the job. The material and design you choose should be aimed at achieving your desired result.

Once the functionality has been determined, you should decide on the desired height of the fence. Some materials may require different heights for optimum stability. Do your best to approximate the amount of height needed for the job.

Next, determine the length and angles of the fence’s sides. Knowing these measurements will help you accurately plan the distance between each fence post and will result in a more visually appealing end product. 

When it comes to figuring out the spacing between posts, the post size and type of material you’re using will be primary factors in your decision. Generally, wider posts need more space to stay steady, whereas thinner posts, such as wooden pickets, can be a bit closer together. 

Once you’ve got your measurements down, the next step is to mark the spots with stakes so you can easily start digging post holes. You’ll want to make sure the holes and posts are measured correctly as any mistakes at this stage could derail the entire project. If needed, use a tape measure to double-check the distances.

Before posting each post, it’s a good idea to treat the bottom third of it with a protective seal to help protect it from underground moisture. From there, you’ll want to drop a few shovelfuls of dirt or gravel into each post hole followed by the post itself. Make sure the post forms a sharp 90-degree angle with the ground before proceeding. You can check this with a level before you move on to brace the post in position with stakes. Finally, deep the dirt or concrete into the post hole to get it firmly into position. 

After that, you’ll want to build a small mound of dirt or concrete around the post base to deter standing water and minimize the risk of soil erosion. With the posts set in place comes the task of adding the rails that will connect them. Start off by nailing a top and bottom rail to each post, running them horizontally. Then, depending on the style of fence you’ve selected, you may need to add center rails. Be sure to use strong nails to attach the boards to posts or rails. 

If you plan to include a gate in your fence, decide where it should be placed and the size it should be. The process for this requires digging holes for the reinforced posts on either side of the appropriate spot and and constructing a frame to fit the opening. Cut 2"x4" pieces to form a frame and bolt them together before attaching hinge/support brackets to the bottom piece. If planning a side gate, consider adding corner brackets the fence posts for added reinforcement.

When placing the gate in the opening, attach the hinges that will hold it in place and ensure it fits properly. Finally, it’s important to add several coats of wood sealer to protect the new fence from the elements and a stain or color of your choosing to finish off the look. With these simple steps, you’ll be on your way to having a sturdy fence for your home or business.

How to Write a Settlement Agreement
Writing a settlement agreement is a critical step in resolving disputes and avoiding or settling a lawsuit. The agreement allows both parties to reach a mutually beneficial resolution without the need to go to court. A settlement agreement should include all of the components required for a legally enforceable contract, including the provisions of the settlement, the names and addresses of both parties, and, ideally, a provision requiring confidentiality. 

Before you begin writing your settlement agreement, it is important to consider a number of factors, including: 

Decide whether you have the need for a settlement agreement: A settlement agreement is an important tool for resolving disputes. If it seems likely that the dispute can be resolved without going to court, a settlement agreement is a good option.

Determine whether you have the ability to enter into a settlement agreement: Before entering into a settlement agreement, it is important to be sure that both parties are legally allowed to do so. Generally, all parties must be 21 years of age or older, of sound mind, and have the capacity to enter into a legal contract. 

Ensure the terms and provisions you want to put in your contract comply with your state's laws: Before drafting a settlement agreement, you should familiarize yourself with the applicable laws in your state. Knowing the laws in your area will help you to ensure that the terms and provisions you put in your agreement are valid.

Agree on a statement of the dispute: Before you draft your settlement agreement, it is important to have a clear understanding of the dispute between the parties. The parties should agree on a statement describing the dispute. This statement should include a description of the facts related to the dispute.

Negotiate consideration: Consideration is the value exchanged between two parties in a contract. Generally, one party agrees to do something they would not otherwise do, such as pay money, in exchange for the other party's promise to do something they would not otherwise do. It is important to make sure that the consideration offered is legally binding.

Determine whether one party will have to admit liability: Sometimes a party will agree to admit liability as part of a settlement agreement. This decision should not be made lightly, as it could come back to haunt the party in the future. Before you agree to this provision, you should really consider whether it is in the best interests of both parties. 

Negotiate any conditions: Before you enter into a settlement agreement, you should agree on any conditions that need to be included in the agreement. For example, you may need to agree on a timeline for payments or a timeframe for completion of certain tasks. 

Negotiate the scope of the release: A release is a statement that binds one party to releasing another party from any and all legal liability. It is important to negotiate the scope of the release carefully to ensure that it covers all of the potential legal liabilities that may arise from the dispute. 

Title the document: The title of the settlement agreement should make clear what the document is intended for. This title should be as specific as possible - for example, you might entitle the document "Settlement Agreement for Dispute Between [Party 1] and [Party 2]" or something similar. 

Identify the parties: Be sure to include the full names and addresses of both parties to the settlement agreement. This will help to ensure that each party is properly identified in the agreement.

Provide a description of the dispute: Your settlement agreement should include a description of the dispute between the parties, including all relevant facts and circumstances. This information will help the parties to understand why the dispute is being settled in this manner.

Include a statement about what one party is going to receive in return for the release of the other party from any and all legal liability: Your settlement agreement should include a statement about what one party will receive in exchange for releasing the other party from any and all legal liability. This compensation should be agreed upon and included in the agreement.

Include a statement regarding the scope of the claims to be settled: Your settlement agreement should include a statement outlining the scope of the claims being settled by the agreement. This statement should make clear the extent to which the claims are being released.

State the conditions clearly: The conditions of the settlement agreement should be clearly stated in the document. These conditions should include whatever details the parties have negotiated, such as deadlines for payment, provision of services, etc. 

Spell out whether the release will include any admissions of fault or liability: You should consider whether you want to include a provision stating that the release includes any admissions of fault or liability. This is an important decision that should be carefully discussed and negotiated between the parties. 

State whether the settlement agreement will be confidential: Your settlement agreement should state whether the parties agree to keeping the details of the agreement confidential. If so, you should include a clause requiring both parties to keep the contents of the agreement confidential.

Include a provision about the dismissal of any ongoing litigation: If there is any ongoing litigation, your settlement agreement should include a provision about the dismissal of the litigation. This provision should be negotiated between the parties before it is included in the agreement.

Ensure the settlement agreement includes your basic boilerplate provisions: Your settlement agreement should include your basic boilerplate provisions, such as definitions of terms, dispute resolution, governing law, and severability.

Provide an area for signatures: Your settlement agreement should include provision for both parties to sign and date the document. This is important for ensuring that the agreement is legally binding.

Offer your contract to the other party: Once you have finished writing your settlement agreement, you should offer it to the other party for review and acceptance. 

Present your settlement agreement to a judge: If the parties are unable to resolve the dispute themselves, you may need to present your settlement agreement to a judge for approval.

Sign your contract and begin performing: Once the settlement agreement has been reviewed, accepted and signed by both parties, it is legally binding. The parties should then begin to perform the obligations outlined in the agreement. 

Writing a settlement agreement can be a complicated process, but it is an important step in resolving disputes without the need to go to court. If you take the time to consider these factors and ensure that all of the necessary components are included, you should be able to create a legally binding agreement that will help the parties reach a resolution.

Teaching participial phrases can be a great way to spice up your classroom writing lessons, and help your students write more concisely. Before you can begin to work on these complex grammar structures, though, it is important to first explain what a participle is. A participle is a form of a verb, usually ending in “ing” or “ed.” It can be used to connect two words or clauses together. For example, “running quickly,” is a participle used to create a participial phrase.

Participial phrases can also use verbs ending in “ed”. One example of this is “intrigued by the possibilities,” in which “intrigued” is a past participle. Present participles usually describe something that is going on. For example “tapping his foot” describes an action that is occurring.

Now that you've explained what participial phrases are, it's time to move on to some examples of how they can be used in a sentence. A more complicated example might look something like this: “Interested in the history of his hometown, Joe attended the lecture.” In this sentence, “interested” is a participle used to combine the two independent clauses into one sentence.

When introducing participial phrases, it is important to explain why they are important. Participial phrases can be used to add description to a sentence and use fewer words than would be necessary with independent clauses. For example, instead of writing “Beth reads a lot of books about Mexico because she is interested in the ancient Mayans,” you could write “Interested in the ancient Mayans, Beth reads a lot of books about Mexico.” Explaining this concept to your students can help them better understand the usefulness of these phrases. 

One way to practice this skill is to write examples of participial phrases on the board and encourage the students to identify them. You can also create a worksheet with examples of participial phrases and ask your students to identify the ones that use participles. To further reinforce the concept, you can also have students create sentences that use participial phrases.

Practicing this skill throughout the school year is important so your students get used to using participial phrases correctly. Assign exercises that identify participial phrases and have students come up with their own examples. You can even create a writing assignment in which students must use more than one participial phrase. Going over the concept regularly will ensure that your students understand why participles and participial phrases are useful.

How to Add Text to a Movie in Windows Movie Maker
Adding titles, captions, and credits to videos can be an effective way to capture the attention of viewers and can help to convey the message you’re delivering with the video. Luckily, Windows Movie Maker makes it easy to add titles, captions, and credits to your videos. With a few simple steps, you can easily add text to your movie project.

Open your project in Windows Movie Maker.
Before you can start adding text to your movie, you need to open your project in Windows Movie Maker. To do this, launch the program, select the project you want to add text to, and click Open.

Click the Home tab.
On the top left of your screen, there will be a few tabs labeled Home, Edit Movie, and Commence. You want to click on the Home tab.

Click the clip you want to place the title in front of.
Next, select the clip you would like to place the title in front of. This clip could be a video you’ve already taken or one you’ve downloaded from the Internet. You can select the clip by right-clicking on it and then selecting the Select option.

Click the Title button in the Home tab.
Once you’ve selected the clip, you want to click on the Title button in the Home tab. This will bring up a text box in which you can type in your text.

Type in the text that you want to appear.
Once you’re in the text box, you can start typing the text that you want to appear. You can also copy and paste text from other documents if you’d like.

Use the Font and Paragraph tools to format your text.
When you’ve finished typing the text, you can make use of the Font and Paragraph tools to make adjustments such as font size, font color, and text alignment.

Adjust the Start time and Text duration values.
The Start time and Text duration values will determine how long the text will be displayed on the screen. The Start time is the amount of time the text will appear before the clip starts playing. The Text duration is the amount of time the text will be on the screen before it goes away.

Click an effect to change how the text appears.
If you would like to change the way the text appears or disappears, you can click an effect from the drop-down menu. This will allow you to choose from various fade and transition effects to make the text more interesting.

Insert multiple title cards for multiple pieces of text.
If you would like to add multiple pieces of text to the clip, you can insert multiple title cards. All you need to do is click the Title button again and type in the text for the next title.

Split a clip to put a title card in the middle.
If you want to insert a title card in the middle of a clip, you will need to first split the clip in two. To do this, move your mouse over the clip and click the scissors icon to split the clip. Then, click the Title button, type in your text, and adjust the start time as needed.

Click the clip you want to add a caption to.
Captions are text that appear at the bottom of the screen. To add a caption to a clip, click on the clip you want to add the caption to and then click the Home tab.

Drag the black bar to the exact point you want the caption to appear.
Once you’ve selected the clip, you can then drag the black bar to the exact point where you want the caption to appear.

Click the Home tab.
Once you’ve found the exact point you want the caption to appear, click the Home tab.

Click the Caption button.
After clicking the Home tab, click the Caption button to bring up the caption text box.

Type the text that you want to appear in the caption.
Once the text box appears, type in the text that you want to appear in the caption.

Use the Font and Paragraph tools to format the caption text.
Once you’ve finished typing your text, you can format it with the Font and Paragraph tools. You can make changes to the font size, font color, and text alignment.

Click and drag the caption around the screen to change position.
You can also drag the caption around your screen to change its position. This is useful if you want to place it above or below a part of your clip.

Adjust the Text duration value.
If you want the caption to stay on the screen for a longer or shorter period of time, you can adjust the Text duration value.

Click an effect to change how the caption appears.
If you want to change how the caption appears, such as making it fade in or out, you can select from various effects from the drop-down menu.

Continue adding captions.
If you want to add additional captions to the clip, just repeat the same steps and adjust the Start time value accordingly.

Click the Home tab.
When you’re finished adding captions to the clip, head back to the Home tab.

Click the Credits button.
From the Home tab, click the Credits button. This will bring up a text box where you can type in the names of those involved with the video as well as a few other details.

Type in the names for your credits.
Once the text box appears, type in the names of those who were involved with the video. You can also type in various production details if you’d like.

Adjust the Text duration value.
If you want the credits card to appear on the screen for a longer or shorter period of time, you can adjust the Text duration value.

Double-click the credits card.
After you’ve finished typing the credits, you can double-click the credits card to make further adjustments.

Adjust the Duration value.
From this menu, you can adjust the Duration value to determine how long the credits card will stay on the screen.

By following these steps, you now know how to add titles, captions, and credits to your videos in Windows Movie Maker. Adding text to your videos can be an effective way to engage viewers and add more meaning to your videos. With the help of Windows Movie Maker, you can quickly and easily add titles, captions, and credits to your videos.

Making a paper crane is a simple and fun way to make something unique for decoration or as a gift. With just a few easy steps, you can create something beautiful from a single sheet of paper. Here's how to do it:

Find a blank square sheet of paper. You can use origami paper or just a standard sheet of printer paper cut into a square, it's up to you!

Fold the paper in half into a rectangle. Crease it and then unfold.

Fold the top of the paper down so the top edge aligns with the bottom edge of the paper and then crease. Unfold and then fold it in half the other way. Crease and then unfold again.

Fold the paper vertically from right to left. Crease and then unfold.

Fold the top right corner down to the bottom left corner. Crease and then unfold. Next, fold the top left corner down to the bottom right corner. Again, crease and then unfold.

Bring the lower right side of the top flap to the middle line. Then, bring the right corner of the top flap to the middle crease. Fold the top corner down so that the crease lies along the horizontal line created by the previous steps. Unfold the last three folds.

Fold the bottom corner of the square up along the horizontal crease from the previous steps all the way up to the top corner.

Reverse the two creases on the upper flap by folding it in the opposite direction that it naturally folds. Bring the two outer edges of the paper to the middle and flatten it.

Turn the paper over and repeat steps 6-9 on this side.

Fold the outer edges of the diamond to the middle crease. Then, fold the right flap over to the left. Turn over the shape and fold the bottom tip of the top flap up to the top corner.

Fold the right flap over to the left. Turn over and repeat on the back.

Fold the wings down so that they are perpendicular to the body, head, and tail. Fold the tip of the head down. Pull the head and tail out so that they line up with the outer edges of the body.

The free market is an economic approach in which the prices, production, and distribution of goods and services are guided solely by the free play of supply and demand, rather than by government intervention. Supporters of free market morality argue that it is the best way to allow individuals to make their own economic decisions and flourish. But there are a few key points to keep in mind when discussing the morality of free markets.

First, allow the free market to call for voluntary actions between individuals and yourself. This means that you should only take part in actions, both in buying and selling, that are consensually agreed upon. Think of money that you’ve earned as a “certificate of performance” - you earned it through the result of a voluntary exchange where both parties have agreed to the terms.

Second, understand that the free market is not necessarily devoid of morality. Decide whether the free market is lacking morality because people say “It’s a zero-sum game, like poker where if you win, it means that I lose.” Realize that it’s the government, not the free market that can cause a zero-sum game in our economy. Government intervention can make it so that one side loses and one side gains, for instance, when there are subsidies or regulations that create artificial monopolies.

Third, do not try and paint big businesses as inherently bad in a free market. Consider the example of the American automobile industry where positive action was undone by politicians/government. Government bailouts of the auto industry said to car-makers: “You don’t have to be accountable to customers and stockholders.” The result is a distorted version of the free market where money is put into an already failing system instead of allowing entrepreneurs to come in and turn it around on their own.

Fourth, consider if there is a more solvent system than the free market. For instance, you could pursue a different approach like social responsibility where money is not the core of business decisions but rather doing things that benefit people and society at large.

And fifth, make sure that the transactions in the free market are in good faith. Give and insist upon receiving just treatment. Make sure that each one is not seeking only their own benefit but to measure things honestly, working to ensure a fair and balanced win-win outcome together. Remember that the morality of free markets should not be about someone losing while another gains, but rather mutually beneficial decisions that result in a win-win situation for all. Free market morality should be about free exchange that works for everyone.

How to Fill Out a W-4
Filling out your W-4 form correctly is important, as it ensures that your employer has the correct information to withhold the right amount of tax from your paycheck. To make sure you have done it correctly, follow these steps: 

First, read the basic instructions provided by the IRS at the top of the form. This will provide you with an overview of the form and instructions regarding how to determine the number of allowances you should claim. 

Next, you will want to determine whether or not someone is claiming you as a dependent. If your parents, another relative, or any other individuals are claiming you as a dependent on their tax return, you should select the exemption box. 

Third, enter an allowance for yourself in the appropriate box. This number will represent the number of exemptions you are eligible to receive. It will also affect the amount of tax withheld from your paycheck. 

Fourth, if you are married, you can include an allowance for your spouse. This will help you save money on taxes. 

Fifth, if you have dependents who are living with you, add allowances for each of them. You will also need to determine whether you qualify as the "head of household" and, if so, add another allowance. 

Sixth, calculate your child or dependent care expenses. This could include any money you paid someone for childcare while you worked or looked for employment. If you paid more than $2,000 for this care and intend to take this credit, enter a "1" in the box on line F of your W-4 form. 

Seventh, decide whether you want to take the Child Tax Credit. This credit will only be available to those who qualify, and you will need to fill out a separate worksheet to figure out how much you can claim. 

Eighth, add up the total number of allowances you have claimed and enter it in line H. This number should also be reflected in Line 5 of your W-4 form. 

Ninth, read the statement under line H to determine whether there are other worksheets you need to complete. For example, if you are married and have multiple children or dependents, you may need to fill out the Deductions and Adjustments worksheet to make sure your allowances are properly reflected. 

Tenth, fill out the personal information that is required on the form. This includes your name, address, Social Security Number, and marital status. 

Eleventh, record your total personal allowances. This is the total number of allowances you are able to claim. 

Twelfth, consider whether you want any additional money withheld from your paycheck. This could be done for such things as a student loan or charitable contributions. 

Thirteenth, read the exemption claim. This statement is meant for those who do not qualify to claim the exemption or are claiming fewer than 1 allowance. 

Fourteenth, sign and date your W-4 form. 

Fifteenth, it is important to review your W-4 form every year, to make sure it reflects any changes in your circumstances such as the number of dependents you are claiming. 

Sixteenth, figure out if you need to complete the Deductions and Adjustments worksheet. This will help you determine what to enter on line 5 of your W-4 form. 

Seventeenth, determine your estimated itemized deductions for the year. This should include the amount of your mortgage interest, state and/or local taxes, and charity deductions. 

Eighteenth, enter the appropriate standard deduction in the blank on line 2. This amount will depend on whether you are filing as an individual, jointly as a married couple, or under another filing status. 

Nineteenth, subtract the standard deduction from your estimated itemized deductions. This amount should then be written on line 4. 

Twentieth, calculate an estimate of any adjustments to income. These can include deductible contributions to retirement plans, self-employment expenses, and alimony payments. 

Twenty-first, add lines 3 and 4 and write the result on line 5. This amount will be used to calculate step 21. 

Twenty-second, write your estimated non-wage income in the blank on line 6. This typically includes income such as interest earned from investments, as well as income earned from rental properties. 

Twenty-third, subtract the amount on line 6 from the amount on line 5 and enter the result on line 7. This will give you the amount of taxes you owe for the year. 

Finally, divide the amount on line 7 by $4,000 and write the result in the provided box on line 8. This is the amount you should enter in line 6 of your W-4 form. You should also keep a copy of your completed form for your records. 

Filling out your W-4 correctly is the best way to ensure you are accurately paying tax on your income. It takes just a few moments to complete, and following these simple steps can save you both time and money when tax season comes around.

How to Cost Effectively Take Care of African Hair and Get Better Results
Getting and maintaining healthy African hair can be an expensive task. But it doesn't have to be. With the right techniques, products, and procedures, you can care for your African hair in a cost-effective way that will produce amazing results. Here are some tips on how to cost effectively take care of African hair and get better results: 

Don't use any chemical treatment: Any chemical treatment that changes your hair will also at best weaken it and possibly kill it. Instead, look into all-natural, organic hair treatments or treatments perhaps created from herbs and other natural ingredients. 

Make simple hair styling: styling that tugs at your hair and on glued-in extensions, tight braids, tight cornrows, and hard gel hairstyles can all cause breakage and damage to the hair. Instead, stick to looser hairstyles and avoid continued use of potentially damaging products like heat protectants, relaxers, and bonding glues. 

Minimize or better still, eliminate heat exposure: If you regularly use a blow dryer, curling or flat iron, try to reduce or avoid using them altogether. Instead, use an all-natural alternative like air-drying, roller-setting, or twist-outs. 

Shampoo only to clean your hair from dirt and old skin cells: Over-shampooing can leave your hair dry and brittle, and could potentially strip it of its natural oils. Try shampooing no more than once or twice a week. 

Keep hair moisturized: Moisture is key, so use products that keep your hair moisturized. A great way to do this is to use natural oils like jojoba or almond oil, or use a leave-in conditioner or daily moisturizer. 

Wet your hair thoroughly and apply a palm's sized amount of shampoo (Paul Mitchell, Matrix or Motions suggested) on the each side of the head and lather well: This will help to ensure a thorough cleansing of your hair, without causing it any unnecessary dryness or brittleness. 

Gently comb out your hair with a wide tooth comb or what most people know as afro comb: A wide tooth comb helps to avoid snagging and pulling of the hair, creating breakage. 

'Co-wash': A co-wash is essentially a cleansing of the hair using only conditioner. This helps to keep the hair moisturized, while also helping to remove dirt and build-up. 

For best results, simply rinse the hair well with warm water, and apply conditioner to the hair: Start about 2 inches (5.1 cm) away from the scalp, and smooth it through to the ends. Use a quarter-sized amount and work it through the hair evenly, gently detangling it as you apply. 

For after-wash care, begin with towel drying: Pat your hair dry, don't rub as this causes it to frizz. Use a wide-tooth comb to gently detangle any remaining knots. 

Maintenance: Every night, before bed, oil your scalp, brush you hair and wrap it: A great choice for oils is jojoba, almond, or olive oils as they all have beneficial properties for the hair and scalp. This will ensure your scalp and hair are well-nourished and protected while you sleep. 

These are just a few of the ways you can cost effectively take care of African hair and get better results. With the right products and techniques, you can keep your hair healthy and beautiful in a very affordable way. By using simple methods and all-natural products, you'll be sure to get the results you're looking for.

Making a butterfly costume can be a fun and easy project that's perfect for a Halloween costume, school play, or just a general dress-up day. Whether you choose to make your costume from felt or polyurethane foam, it can be achievable for all ages and skill levels. Here's how to make a butterfly costume:

1. First, you should look for types of butterflies in a book at the library or an Internet search engine. Choose a type of butterfly with colors that you want to emulate. Assess what the weather will be like when you wear the costume.

2. Purchase one yard (0.9m) of polyurethane foam along with additional colors of felt in the colors you would like to use for wing accents. Print out the wing template or hand draw your wings onto your main felt color with a fabric pen or chalk.

3. Trace two wing shapes into the polyurethane foam. Cut out the wing shapes in both the felt and the foam.

4. Cut out smaller butterfly markings from the template. Pin one set of markings on one large piece of felt.

5. Stack the wings as follows: whole polyurethane wing, whole decorated felt wing (face up), cut decorated felt wing, face down, cut polyurethane wing. Sew around the perimeter with needle and thread or a sewing machine.

6. Attach elastic straps vertically near the center section of the wing.

7. Buy a headband and pipe cleaners in colors matching your costume. Wrap pipe cleaners around the top of the headband, then attach pom poms to the ends of the pipe cleaners with craft glue.

8. Finally, attach the wings to the shoulder straps with craft glue and secure with safety pins. Be sure to attach the headband and pipe cleaners securely. Then your costume is finished and ready to wear! 

Making your own butterfly costume can be a fun and easy project that you can be proud of. With a few items from the craft store and some creativity, you can have a unique, handmade costume. Preparing for a hospital discharge is an important step in ensuring a successful recovery and home transition. It is essential that you and your family understand the diagnosis and why you were admitted to the hospital in the first place, and that you are prepared for any lifestyle changes that may be necessary for a successful transition. Here are some steps you can take to help you prepare for a hospital discharge:

1. Understand your diagnosis and why you were admitted to the hospital in the first place. Make sure you participate in any discussions with your doctor(s) so you are well aware of what a successful recovery looks like.

2. If your doctor has prescribed you medication, make sure you know what it's for, when to take it, the dosage, and how to take it. This information is essential for a successful recovery.

3. If you're given any medical equipment to use at home, make sure you and your family know how to use them and ensure that any wounds or scars you may have are properly taken care of and clean.

4. Be prepared to make some lifestyle changes such as giving up certain activities or food items, drinking more fluids, and limiting your alcohol consumption.

5. Prepare your transportation for that day. You can arrange for a family member or friend to drive you or book a taxi if necessary.

6. Once you've been given the go-ahead from your doctor or nurse, you can begin to pack and gather your personal belongings and change into your street clothes (if wearing a hospital gown).

7. Make sure to have all the necessary medications with you, and have the right medical equipment ready to take home. Also, don't forget to return anything you might have borrowed from the ward.

8. Before you leave the hospital, go through your room one last time to make sure you've got everything you need.

9. Say your final goodbyes to your doctors and nurses and make sure to thank them for their care.

Following these steps will make your transition and recovery much smoother and successful. Preparing for a hospital discharge requires dedication and effort, but it will be well worth it and you will be thankful for the time and energy you put into getting ready. Good luck and stay healthy.

Building Plantation Shutters is a great way to add a unique style to a window or door in your home. Not only do they provide an interesting decorative addition to a room, but they also offer adjustable light and privacy control. Plantation shutters are constructed from four pieces of wood, two horizontal planks and two vertical planks, and several louvers which fit into the shutter frame.

The first step in constructing a plantation shutter is to measure your window or door frame for the dimensions of the shutter. You will need to determine the length of the two horizontal planks, as well as the length of the two vertical planks. Once the frame measurements are complete, you will need to cut the four planks of wood to size.

Once the planks are cut, the next step is to assemble the shutter frame by gluing the two vertical planks to the two horizontal planks. The goal is to fit them tightly and securely together.

Most plantation shutter louvers are sold in flat sheets. Measure the length of the louvers you need to fit into the shutters and consider purchasing already fitted pieces for the most accurate fit. If the ones you are buying are not already fitted, you will need to cut them down to size using a miter saw or any other cutting tool of your choice.

When the louvers are cut to the correct size, you can mark along the inside face of the vertical stiles on the shutter frame the spots where the louvers will go in. Drill holes for the pins of the louvers on these markings all the way through the shutter frame. Next, insert the louvers by placing the pins into the holes in the shutter frame. Make sure the louvers are flush with the inside of the frame.

To turn the shutters into functioning ones, measure and cut the tilt bar to stretch from the top horizontal plank to the bottom horizontal plank of the shutter frame. Drill holes in the top and bottom horizontal planks to accommodate the tilt bar, then insert the tilt bar into the holes. Secure the tilt bar to the louvers by shutter staples or threaded eyelets to ensure a strong bond.

Once all the components are attached to the shutter frame, test it out. Move the tilt bar up and down and observe the movement of the louvers. Make sure everything is working as it should.

Finally, mount the shutter frame onto the window frame and secure it by screws or another method that meets your needs. For extra security, you may want to install weather stripping or caulk the frame to prevent air from entering.

Once all of the steps have been completed, you have successfully installed plantation shutters. Enjoy the unique decorative addition and adjustable light and privacy control which they offer.

Gutting a turkey is a surprisingly simple process that allows you to prepare the bird for cooking or storing. Whether the turkey is for a big holiday feast or for simply roasting for dinner, it is important that you gut your turkey properly and safely. Follow these steps to successfully gut a turkey. 

First, you should purchase the turkey at the grocery store or from a local farmer. The size of the turkey you buy should depend on how many people you are planning to feed. 

Once you have your turkey, it is important to clean the surface that you are preparing it on. Anything left on the surface can contaminate the turkey and make people sick. Wipe down the surface with a warm cloth or clean cloth and then use an antibacterial cleaner to clean the area. 

Lay the turkey on its stomach on your work surface or countertop. Assemble all of the tools and materials needed to gut the turkey. It is important to make sure you have everything you need in order to keep contamination from spreading. These can include paper towels, a knife, a bowl, and a pair of gloves. 

The next step is to cut along the back of the neck to free the trachea and esophagus. This requires a sharp knife and cutting away the skin so that these body parts can easily be removed later. Be sure to keep the knife away from your hands at all times.

Once you have cut away the back of the neck, flip the turkey onto its back. Make sure that both its wings and legs are in the correct positions. Use your knife to make a horizontal slit in the skin between the point of the breastbone and the anus of the turkey. Make sure that the slit is large enough so that your hand can fit inside.

Reach in and feel around until you can remove all of the organs, including the heart and lungs. Set these aside in a bowl for later disposal. When all of the organs have been removed, you can then clean and rinse the turkey in the sink. Once the turkey is clean, it is important to pat it dry with paper towels. 

Store the turkey in the refrigerator or freezer if you are not cooking it right away. Be sure to wash your hands, work surface, and tools you used after gutting the turkey. You can also save the innards that can be cooked, which are known as the giblets. These can be stored in the refrigerator or freezer for later use. 

Finally, it is important to dispose of the unused parts of the turkey in the appropriate manner. Be sure to contact your local municipality to find the best way to dispose of the remains. Following these steps will help to ensure that you gut and prepare the turkey safely and effectively.

How to Make Habanero Pepper Mash
If you love spicy food and are looking to create a unique flavor to enhance the dishes you create, a habanero pepper mash might be just the thing. Making a pepper mash is relatively easy and can be used to make salsa, hot sauce, and many other delicious dishes. Read on to find out how to make a habanero pepper mash.

Materials needed:
- Chemical-resistant gloves
- Gallon-sized glass jar or pottery crock
- Large, ripe peppers
- Blender
- Measuring cups and spoons
- Calculator
- Clean spoon

Instructions:
1. Go to a home improvement store and buy a pair of the snug-fitting, chemical-resistant gloves. These gloves are essential for handling the habanero peppers, which are extremely hot and can cause skin to burn.

2. Select a gallon-size (or larger) glass jar or pottery crock for fermenting the pepper mash. This should be sterilized prior to use and should be able to hold at least one gallon of mash.

3. Get the largest, plumpest, ripe peppers from the garden or market. Choose either red or yellow habanero peppers, depending on your preference. Ripe peppers will be slightly soft and will have a vibrant color.

4. Decide whether to leave the seeds in or remove them. Leaving the seeds in will make the mash spicier, while removing them will make the mash milder.

5. Wash the peppers and dry them with a towel or paper towel before processing them.

6. Remove and discard the stems.

7. Survey the seed extraction methods. If you are going to leave the seeds in, you can use a spoon to scoop them out; if you are removing the seeds, you can chop them up and then use a spoon to scoop them out.

8. Weigh the remaining peppers. Use a kitchen scale until you have two pounds or more.

9. Get out the calculator and calculate 3.3% of the remaining weight. This is the amount of salt that you will need to add during the fermentation process.

10. Process the peppers in a blender two pounds at a time. The total mixture should have a consistent texture.

11. Add other vegetables, herbs, and spices to the blender if you desire and puree them along with the pepper mash. This will add flavor and complexity to the mash.

12. Pour the mash into the fermentation jar or crock. Be sure to leave at least two inches at the top of the jar.

13. Set the jar out of direct sunlight and extreme temperatures and wait for it to ferment. This can take anywhere from six to eight weeks.

14. Stir the mash down each day with a clean spoon once the bubbling starts.

15. Screw the lid down tightly onto the jar one month after making the mash and put the jar in a refrigerator.

16. Use the mash as soon as fermentation has ceased. It will last in the refrigerator for up to six months, although the flavor is best enjoyed fresh.

Using habanero pepper mash will add a pleasantly spicy kick to all of your dishes! Follow the steps above to enjoy the unique and delectable flavor of pepper mash in your home cooking.

How to Cook With Your Kids

Introduction

Cooking together with your kids is an excellent way to bring the whole family together in the kitchen! Not only is it an entertaining and educational experience, but food made with love tastes better! Plus, it's a chance to teach your kids some important skills that will help them for a lifetime. Here are a few fun and simple recipes you can make together with your kids!

Mini-Pizzas

What you need:

A cookie sheet
4 English muffins
4 teaspoons salad or olive oil
8-ounce can tomato sauce or tomatoes, mashed
2 teaspoons dried oregano
1 teaspoon dried basil
8 slices mozzarella cheese
8 teaspoons grated Parmesan cheese
Any toppings (pepperoni, cooked sausage, raw mushrooms, etc.)

Instructions:

Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.

Cut English muffins in half and place on the cookie sheet.

Mix the oil, tomato sauce, dried oregano, and dried basil together in a bowl and spread the mixture on the English muffins.

Top with the mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese and any desired toppings.

Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and ultra gooey.

Early-Bird Cereal

What you need:

1 1/2 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup quick barely or another 1/2 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup of dried fruit, such as apricots, apples, blueberries, cranberries, or raisins.

Instructions:

Toast the oats in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.

Empty the toasted oats into a bowl and add the quick barely and dried fruit.

Mix the cereal together.

Bear Paw Cookies

What you need:

1 cup sugar
1/4 cup butter
1/2 cup milk
1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa
1/2 teaspoon vanilla
1 1/2 cups uncooked rolled oats
Slivered almonds
Wax paper

Instructions:

Mix the sugar, butter, milk, and cocoa together in a saucepan and bring to the rolling boil over medium heat.

Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla.

Mix in the oats and almonds.

Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of the mixture onto the waxed paper.

Let cool and enjoy!

Apple Volcanoes

What you need:

1 apple per child
Apple corer
Creamy peanut butter
Sunflower seeds and/or M&M's

Instructions:

Use the apple corer to take out the core of the apple.

Fill the center of the apple with creamy peanut butter, then sprinkle the sunflower seeds and/or M&M's around the peanut butter.

Put a few drops of water in the hole left by the apple corer.

Bake your apple volcanoes in a 350 degree Fahrenheit oven for about 10 minutes, or until the apples are tender and the peanut butter is melted.

Nectar Smoothies

What you need (per one drink):

1 cup washed strawberries (capped)
1 ripe banana
4 ice cubes
1 cup milk
Blender

Instructions:

Put all ingredients in the blender until ice is completely crushed.

Blend at medium to high speed until you reach a smooth texture.

Serve your smoothies in glasses and enjoy!

Conclusion

Cooking together with your kids is a great way to bond and have fun as a family. With these three simple recipes, you and your kids will have a fun day of cooking and eating great food. Plus, you'll have memories to last a lifetime. So grab your sous chefs, and let's get cooking!

How to Dress for a Human Resources Job

Having the right wardrobe for a human resources job is important for building a professional and polished look. Whether you are representing your company in dress code meetings, running employee orientation sessions, or managing relationship issues, your clothing should portray the level of professionalism that your job requires. Here are some tips for dressing the part in human resources.

Buy working basics

Your wardrobe should contain basics that you can mix and match and still look professional. For a human resources job, a basic look should include solid-colored skirts or clean-cut pants, tailored dress shirts or blouses, and sweater or cardigans. Some basic items to consider adding to your wardrobe are pencil skirts or straight-legged pants, crisp-collared white or colored shirts, and a well-fit blazer. Investing in substantial, neutral pieces that you can wear in different combinations is a great way to pull together an appropriate look for a human resources job.

Cover piercings and tattoos

Tattoos and body piercings often represent the individual's personality and style; however, for a role in human resources it can be more appropriate to go understated. Depending on your company, executives and clients may find visible tattoos or piercings unprofessional or offensive. As such, it is best for those with piercings or tattoos to cover up any visible parts for their job. Some options for tattoo and piercing concealers are foundation, tinted concealers, flesh-toned makeup, or clothing to conceal the piercing or tattoo.

Make your makeup simple

Working in human resources requires a level of thoughtfulness and professionalism, so it is best to keep your makeup simple and natural. Avoid trying to recreate the latest trends or wearing dramatic makeup that doesn't fit in with a conservative professional work environment. Try to opt for natural colors like pinks, peach, beiges, or browns. It may be best to avoid overly heavy foundation or bright eyeshadows as they can easily become distracting. 

Check clothing lengths

When selecting clothing for a human resources job, choose pieces that are both appropriate and comfortable for the office environment. Shirts and sweaters should be long enough to cover your stomach and midriff without exposing any cleavage, and skirts should reach at least to your fingertips when your hands are at your sides. For men, dress pants should be at the natural waist and fit comfortably in the seat and thighs without being baggy.

Dress for your clientele

The level of formality for a human resources job is typically dictated by the type of clientele you have. If you are meeting with executives or potential hires, it is important to maintain a professional and polished look. More casual dress is acceptable when dealing with fellow employees or customer service representatives, but it is important to take cues from your employer as to what is appropriate for the work environment.

Read your company handbook

Creating the proper look for a human resources job starts by understanding the formal and informal dress code for your company. Most companies have a detailed dress code in their handbook, so familiarize yourself with the guidelines to ensure that you are in line with what is expected of you. Ask your employer or human resources department for more clarity if there are any areas of confusion.

Overdress when in doubt

Sometimes it can be hard to judge what is too casual of a look in a workplace. When in doubt, opt for more formal attire. For a human resources job, a good rule of thumb is to wear more formal clothing than you would wear for day-to-day activities outside of the office. When dressing up your outfit, try subtle yet polished details like a scarf, a timeless watch, or subtle jewelry. By following these tips you will be sure to create the perfect wardrobe for your human resources job.

How to Deal With Losing Your Wallet

Losing your wallet can be a huge disappointment and can leave you feeling helpless. It may contain important documents and personal items that would be a huge trouble to replace. Here is a list of steps to take when your wallet goes missing to hopefully make the process a little easier. 

First and foremost, search for 24 hours before taking any further action. Look everywhere your wallet could possibly be and retrace your steps. Check places where it would normally be and think of places it could not normally be. Look carefully and even if it doesn’t seem likely, check anyway.

If after 24 hours it still has not appeared, it’s time to start taking action. The first thing to do is to go online and check for any fraudulent charges. Then call your bank to inform them of the missing card and start the process of canceling any credit or debit cards. To further protect your credit, call the major credit bureaus and request a fraud alert on your credit line.

The next step is to apply for a replacement ID. Contact your insurance company and request a new account number if necessary. Make sure you report any hassles and suspicious calls you get along the way to the police. 

Now is also a good time to photocopy all of your cards and IDs for future reference. This can save you a lot of hassle if you ever lose them again. 

Take a few moments to relax and focus. Try not to worry too much - just think and maybe it might come to you. Look again in places it would normally be and retrace your steps. Don’t forget to call places you visited recently and look carefully for your wallet. 

Assume your wallet is stolen if you still can’t locate it within a day or so. Call your bank(s) immediately and report your debit cards as missing. Don’t forget to also report your credit cards as missing. To make sure your credit rating is not affected, file a police report for a lost or stolen wallet, and call the major credit bureaus to protect your credit.

Lastly, replace your lost identity cards and make a list of everything that was in your wallet. This will make the process of replacing them easier. Losing your wallet is not the end of the world, but it can be a hassle. Taking the right steps can help make the process less stressful and help make sure your money and possessions are protected.

Making your hair wavy can be a fast and easy way to change up your look without using too many products. The key to getting great waves is starting with well-maintained, healthy hair. The best place to start is to detangle any knots with a wide-tooth comb. Once your hair is smooth and all the knots are out, it's time to section your hair off for easier working. This is especially important when using heat.

Make sure you are using a curling iron with a ceramic barrel so it distributes the heat evenly across the strand of hair. Then, start by taking small, one-inch sections of your hair and wrapping them around the barrel of your curling wand in the opposite direction of your face. The closer you wind the hair around the wand, the tighter the curls. You can also change the angle of your curling wand to get more voluminous waves or smaller curls. Once you have curled all of your hair, run your hands lightly through your curls or even brush them out for a more beachy, wavy look.

To keep your waves lasting longer, a light spritz of hairspray can help hold them in place. To add body and volume to your waves, try using a teasing brush and lightly spray with hairspray. Move the brush back and forth in small strands of your hair. Once finished, spray a little more hairspray all over for maximum hold.

For extra voluminous curls and waves, consider using a diffuser attachment for the barrel of your blow dryer. Always make sure you wash all the product out of your hair first before adding heat. Towel or air-dry your hair until it is damp. Then, work product through your hair from root to tip. Now, you can scrunch your hair in sections. Blast your hair with cool air and enjoy your bombshell waves. To finish, apply a lightweight hairspray all over to hold your look in place.

Another great way to get those lasting beachy waves is the overnight method with braids. Wash and condition your hair and make sure it is not completely dry, just damp. Part your hair in 2 or 3 inch (5.1 or 7.6 cm) wide sections and clip your hair. Then, start braiding your damp hair. Move the braids around your head and complete the look by applying a light hold hairspray to your hair after braiding.

Tiny buns can also help keep your waves in place. Make sure your hair is damp, not soaking wet. Separate your hair into 3–4 inch (7.6–10 cm) sections for your tiny buns. Then, twist each section of hair into a coil and pin it in a pile on top of your head. Go around your head repeating Steps 5 through 7 until all of your hair is pinned up. To finish, sleep on the buns and take them out in the morning. To fix up the style, use your fingers to arrange your waves in any way you like—you can let it flow free or even tie it up in a bun.

The classic look of ballerina buns is also super easy and can lend really nice, relaxed waves. Before styling, make sure to wash and condition your hair. Blow dry your hair at the roots, but leave the ends and midsection of your hair damp. Part your hair down the back of your head and twist the two big sections of your hair. Make one long twisted strand down your back and wrap that one twisted strand into a ballerina bun on the back of your head. Keep your hair in the bun like this until your hair is dry. Then, take it out of your hair and tousle your hair to arrange it however you want. Add a lightweight hairspray to make sure your waves last all day.

How to Avoid Online Work at Home Scams
Working from home can be both an incredibly rewarding and stress-free experience. However it is important to remember that there are plenty of internet scams to be aware of. Luckily with caution and common sense, you can easily avoid them. Here are some ways to make sure you don't get taken in.

Avoid business opportunity sites that claim unrealistic income possibilities. There is no "secret formula" to make money working from home. Don't believe anyone claiming otherwise.

Do your research. Carefully look into any company advertising work-at-home opportunities. Check for credentials, licensing, and reliable customer service options. Make sure a company provides a secure website and clear terms of use before committing to any online job or business.

Look for logos on the site indicating endorsements from the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, the Better Business Bureau or Truste.org. These indicate that the company is trustworthy.

Check that the site has contact information from independent sites. If not, it could be a scam.

Research any company you're interested in. Read customer reviews, look at feedback from other customers. Check the company's website for any complaints, and check the Better Business Bureau online before signing up for anything.

Search for work-at-home jobs using legitimate sources. Try using an online job search engine, such as Indeed, Monster or Careerbuilder. These sites have legitimate postings, and are a good source for finding good reliable jobs.

Educate yourself. Learn about the company before signing up. Research their background, their goals, and their products or services. Make sure you understand the work they are offering before agreeing to anything.

Avoid "start up fees": Real work at home jobs are like any other jobs, except they are performed in home offices. You don't need to pay for any training or courses to get the job.

Don't expect a money-back guarantee to protect you. No company is going to offer you a money-back guarantee. Even if they do, it won't mean anything if the job doesn't turn out to be what you expected.

Understand that working at home does not require a "program" or a "system" that you have to pay to learn. Many companies, such as U-Haul, offer work-at-home positions without a fee.

Use your head. Do not trust any sites that require you to pay in advance. If you're ever unsure about a legitimate business opportunity, take the time to check them out and make sure they have a good reputation before signing up.

Look up Domain name on Domain Tools. This can help you identify the owner of a website and make sure it is a legitimate site.

Look for guarantees on the site. Many companies offer a 30-day money-back guarantee, which gives you plenty of time to find out if the job or company is legit.

Type in the company name in Google. Don't just do a general online search – look specifically for the company name, and see what comes up.

Scrutinize carefully any testimonials. Don't be fooled by glowing reviews. Verify them with an honest, independent source, such as an online testimonial service.

Avoid pyramid schemes and lotteries. These are illegal and will likely result in you losing money.

Tell your family and friends about any opportunities you're considering and ask what they think. It's good to get a second opinion on any work-at-home opportunity.

Take your time before signing up for anything. Remember, if something sounds too good to be true, it probably is. Do your research properly and make sure a company is legitimate before committing to any work-at-home opportunity. With caution and common sense, you can easily avoid online work-at-home scams and find rewarding work in the comfort of your own home.

Sharpening a knife to scrape oboe reeds can be a tricky task, but with the right steps and a few items from your toolbox, it can be achieved with relative ease.

First, you'll need to gather the right materials. This includes a sharpening stone, India Sharpening Stones being the preferred option as they have a much finer grit than traditional whetstone versions. Make sure you also have a rag for cleaning any loose knife particles and a cloth for wiping down the blade afterwards.

Second, make sure your stone is placed on a flat, even surface. Place the stone vertical to your body, one short side closest to you, one short side furthest from you. The stone should also be disposed of and replaced if it is excessively worn.

Now, it’s time to sharpen the blade. Take your knife in your sharpening hand (right-handers in your right hand, lefties in your left) and lay the knife flat on the stone with the edge facing towards you. Tilt the back of the knife up until the front-most part of the edge makes contact with the stone. With the knife in the position, rub the knife back and forth across the stone until a slight burr begins to form. Turn the knife over so the edge faces away from you and grind exactly the same as in the previous step.

Repeat step four but continue grinding until a visible and significant burr is formed along the entire edge of the knife. After the burr is formed, repeat step four but this time use a fine honing stone. Repeat step five until the burr is completely flipped over to the scraping side.

Now position the blade perpendicular to and flat on the stone with the tip of the blade hanging over the side of the stone and the edge of the knife closest to you. Turn the knife over and repeat the previous step, this time with the edge of the knife away from you; the stroke also going away from you. You may need to repeat steps nine and ten one or more times to get just the right edge.

Once you’ve honed the blade to the desired degree, it’s important to test the edge using your thumbnail. It should be sharp enough that the edge bites in when dragged across the nail. If it’s dull, return to the sharpening stone and repeat the process until the knife edge is sharp enough to scrape oboe reeds.

Finally, after all of the hard work is done, you should always remember to clean and store the knife properly. Wipe down the blade with a clean cloth and store it securely away from children and other people. It is recommended to apply oil to the knife to ensure it stays in its best condition and to prevent moisture from air damage.

With these steps, you can now sharpen a knife to scrape oboe reeds with relative ease. The sharpened blade should last you many years or at least until the blade goes dull and is in need of sharpering once again.

Incorporating a business in Georgia is a complex process that requires time and money. However, the benefits of incorporation, such as increased credibility, asset protection, and tax advantages, are great. To complete this process, you’ll need to select the best legal structure for your business, determine the business name, pick three officers for the corporation, create the Articles of Incorporation, and contact the IRS for an Employer Identification Number (EIN). Here’s what you’ll need to do to incorporate in the state of Georgia.

Choose the best legal structure for your business. Before incorporation, the best first step is to decide what type of business structure to pursue. When incorporating in Georgia, the available entities are C-corporations and S-corporations. A C-corporation is suitable for larger businesses with more than two owners, while an S-corporation may benefit smaller businesses with fewer owners. Consider the type of business you plan to run and talk to a business lawyer or CPA to determine the right structure for you.

Determine your business name. The name you choose for your business should be unique, memorable, and in line with your business goals. Research the availability of this name by performing an online search. You’ll also need to check for registered trademarks, and any potential issues with copyright or domain name registrations. To make sure your business name remains legal and secure, fill out an application for a Certificate of Existence with the Georgia Corporations Division. 

Identify three officers for your corporation. Officers are responsible for the daily operations of the corporation, and help to establish internal policies and procedures. The board of directors can be made up of up to three shareholders, officers, or insiders and should be carefully chosen to represent the best interests of the corporation.

Publish your notice of intent to incorporate. Before you can incorporate your business in Georgia, you must publish a notice of intent to incorporate in a local newspaper for three weeks. This notice should include the corporation’s name, the time and place of its first organizational meeting, and the names of the initial board of directors.

Contact the IRS about an Employer Identification Number (EIN). You’ll also need to obtain an EIN from the IRS. This number identifies your business to the IRS for tax-related reasons and is free to obtain.

Understand the required elements of the Articles of Incorporation. To complete the Articles of Incorporation, you’ll need to include the name of the corporation, the location of the registered office, the number of the shares to be issued, whether the business will be a non-profit corporation or not, the name and address of each incorporator, and the principal office mailing address.

Visit the Georgia Corporations Division website. To file the Articles of Incorporation, you’ll need to go to the Georgia Corporations Division website and select the “Online Services” option. Log in with your information and select “Create or Register a Business”. Then, choose whether you’re creating a new business or registering an out-of-state business. Provide all the necessary information and submit your filing fee.

Receive your certificate of incorporation. After you’ve submitted the Articles of Incorporation and the filing fee, you’ll receive a certificate of incorporation. This serves as official proof that your business is legally incorporated in the state of Georgia.

Take advantage of the benefits of incorporation. Incorporating in the state of Georgia can provide you with asset protection, increase credibility, and offer you tax advantages. Take the necessary steps and start enjoying the benefits of incorporating your business.

Prom season is here and if you’re looking for a unique dress option, why not try one made out of duct tape? A duct tape prom dress looks chic, regardless of what kind of material it's made out of. It’s also a great way to make sure you have a dress that nobody else will have. Here’s how to make your own.

Find a dress pattern you like. Start by finding a dress pattern in a style you like. You don’t want to end up with a dress you don’t like, or that doesn’t fit properly. Look for a pattern in a fabric store or on the internet.

Buy rolls of duct tape. You’ll need a lot of duct tape in a variety of colors. Make sure the rolls you buy are marked as “non-stick”.

Get non-stick scissors. Non-stick scissors are a must for cutting duct tape. You could end up with sticky scissors if you try to use regular ones.

Get some light-weight cotton fabric, old t-shirt or old dress. You can use these to give your dress a lining. It will help the dress keep its shape and you won’t have to worry about the duct tape sticking to your skin.

Clear a large work surface. You’ll need a lot of room to work on your project. Move furniture and clear off a table or floor space so you have room.

Find a stapler. You’ll need a stapler to attach the lining fabric to the duct tape. Make sure you only use staples, not pins.

Ask a friend to help you. It’s much easier with an extra set of hands. Having a friend to help you make sure you cut in straight lines and keep the fabric and tape in the right order.

Overlap 4-6 strips of tape approximately 18-24 inches long. Start by placing strips of tape on your work surface, overlapping them by about 2 inches. Make sure the strips are long enough to cover the dress you’re making.

Turn these strips vertically. Flip the strips you just put down so they are now vertical.

Cover these strips with another 4-6 strips. Place another 4-6 strips of tape on top of the first ones, overlapping them in the same way.

Trim off any sticky edges. If you have long strips of tape that are hanging off the edge of the table, make sure to trim them off.

Make enough panels for your project. You’ll need enough pieces to cover the entire dress. Determine how many you will need based on the pattern you’ve chosen.

Cut out the pattern pieces from your dress pattern. Trace the pattern pieces onto the duct tape fabric and then cut them out.

Tape the pattern pieces together in the correct order to form your dress. Once you’ve cut out all the pieces, you’ll need to assemble them into the dress. This will be made easier if you have a friend helping you.

Get a cheap thrift store dress. You can use this as a form to help shape the dress you are making.

Get a friend to help you. Again, this step will be a lot easier with another person’s help.

Wrap tape around your ribs just under the chest. This will help give your dress a good shape and structure.

Place strips of tape in a V shape across the chest. This will give the dress a nice neckline.

Make a V shape across your back. Place more strips of tape around the back to make a V shape or just for added coverage.

Place more strips to cover the back. Place these strips going down the sides of your back as well.

Begin placing strips of tape around the sides of the ribcage. Place the strips around your ribcage, going up and down the sides.

Place strips over the sleeves and shoulders. Place strips over the shoulder and sleeve area, attaching them to the chest.

Cover the rest of the chest with strips of tape. Keep going until the entire top of the dress is covered with strips.

Start taping the waist and hip area. Place strips of tape along the waist and hip area, attaching them to the chest.

Make a cut down the back center of the form. This cut should be enough to let the duct tape fit around your body.

Use this form as the base for your own design. You can use this form to make changes or add extra details to your own dress.

Cut the dress form to your preferred shape. Change the shape of the dress form to get the skirt the way you want it.

Use different colors of duct tape to create a pattern. Use various colors to create a unique pattern or design for your dress.

Cut out tape in different shapes and layer these on your form. You can add extra detail to your dress by using different shapes and sizes of tape.

Add embellishments such as rosettes or bows. You can easily make these out of duct tape. Just make sure they are securely attached to the dress.

Once you’ve finished making it, you now have your own one-of-a-kind duct tape prom dress. Enjoy wearing it on your big night!
