Want to build your own custom longboard? You don’t have to be a professional carpenter or spend a lot of money just to get your own unique deck. You can make a board that’s customized to your exact specifications. Building your own longboard does require careful planning and a few specialized tools, but the process can be sure to reward you with a custom ride tailored to your needs.

Gather your materials for the deck. You will need either 1/4-inch plywood or hardwood, a drill, epoxy, a roller, cork, sandpaper, and polyurethane varnish or fiberglass resin.

Choose your wood. Choose something that is both strong and lightweight. You can find wood veneer or lightweight plywood at your local hardware store. Depending on how much weight you'll be carrying, you may opt for a thicker hardwood.

Choose your adhesive. Epoxy is the best choice for outdoor projects. You can also opt for a construction grade adhesive, such as Liquid Nails, but it won’t be as durable or waterproof.

Choose your trucks. The trucks on your board will determine how well your board turns and how fast you can get up to speed. You have many different options to choose from, but you should opt for larger ones if you’re going to be riding downhill or doing tricks.

Choose the wheels. You want to choose wheels that have a diameter of at least 65mm and a durometer of 80a or above. You can also choose between different colors and designs.

Choose your bearings. The bearings will determine how smoothly you can ride. Look for ABEC rated bearings, which are the most popular type.

Cut your plywood (or hardwood) to size. Use a jigsaw or band saw to cut the wood into two identical pieces. The wood should be long enough to accommodate your trucks and wheels, and it should be wide enough to make the deck sufficiently strong and stiff.

Draw out the shape of your board. Use a pencil or marker to draw the shape you want your board to be on a piece of paper. You can use templates if you like, or you can design your own.

Use a pencil to trace the shape of your board onto the top piece wood. This will give you the outline you need to cut out the shape of your board.

Drill holes around the outside of the board outline. This will allow you to attach the trucks and wheels to the board.

Stick the pieces of wood together. Use the epoxy to bond the two pieces of wood together. Allow it to dry completely before moving on to the next step.

Shape the board. Use a belt sander and/or planer to shape the board into the shape you drew out earlier.

Place weights onto the board. This will help the board retain its shape. Put weights on top of the board and leave them on for at least 3 hours.

Put a screw through a hole near the nose of your board. This will help the board keep its shape even when you’re not using weights.

Check the curve again to make sure you are satisfied. It’s important that you make sure the board looks exactly how you want it to before you move on.

Take out the screws. Once the shape is set, take out the screw and remove the weights from the board.

Consider using a board press to mold your deck. A board press is a specialized tool that is designed to help you shape the board precisely and efficiently.

Carve the shape into the board. Use a router or a spindle sander to carve the shape into the board.

Sand everything down. Use a belt sander and a variety of grits of sandpaper to sand down the board. Make sure that all surfaces are perfectly smooth before moving on.

Cover the board with a layer of polyurethane varnish or fiberglass resin. This will make the board water resistant and give it a professional finish.

Sand the board down one final time using a very fine-grained sandpaper. This will give the board a glossy finish.

Consider painting your board. If you’d like to add some color to your board, you can paint it. Make sure you use a paint that is designed for outdoor use.

Add a final layer of polyurethane varnish or fiberglass resin. This will protect your paint and make your board extra durable.

Cover the top of the board with grip tape. This will make the surface of the board skid resistant and provide extra grip.

Consider using board wax instead of grip tape for barefoot riding. Board wax is applied directly to the board and provides more grip than grip tape.

Place the bearings inside the wheels. Make sure the bearings are securely attached to the wheels before you ride.

Attach the wheels to the trucks. Place the wheels onto the trucks and tighten the mounting nuts.

Drill the holes for the trucks. Make sure the holes match the shape of the trucks.

Attach the trucks and wheels to the deck. Use the screws to attach the trucks and wheels to the board.

Test out your new board. Make sure you wear a helmet and protective gear before taking your board out on its maiden voyage. And remember to always be careful when you're riding.

Now that you know how to build a longboard, you're ready to get out there and design your own customized ride. Have fun!

Updating your router's firmware is an important and often overlooked step to ensuring the security and stability of your home network. Not to mention, a firmware update can also unlock the newest features and bug fixes for your router.

But, before you take the plunge, it's important to understand how to update your router's firmware safely and correctly. Follow these steps to ensure the process goes smoothly:

1. Check the physical router for the address. In most cases, this should be printed on the back of the router casing. This will be the add-on where you'll access the router's firmware.

2. Open the Start menu or screen and type “network status.” This should rest you on your active network connection.

3. Click the name of your current connection in the top-right corner. This will open a new window with your connection information.

4. Click the “Details” button in the new window that appears. This will show your IP address information.

5. Find the IPv4 Default Gateway entry. This is the IP address of your router.

6. Connect to the router via Ethernet. This will provide a faster, and more stable connection to the router.

7. Enter your router's IP address into a web browser's address bar. In most cases, this will be the IP you wrote down from step 5.

8. Enter your login information. This should have been included in the documentation that came with your router.

9. Open the “Firmware,” “Router Upgrade,” or “Update” page. This will vary depending on your router model.

10. Click the “Check” button to see if updates are available. If no updates are available, you may have to check the manufacturer's website for updates.

11. Download the latest firmware files if presented with a link. The specific instructions will vary depending on your router brand.

12. Visit the manufacturer's support site if no link is given. Many router manufacturers, like Linksys, have online support sites with manuals and firmware downloads.

13. Enter your router's model into the support site's search. This should bring up the official page for your router and its corresponding firmware updates.

14. Find the latest firmware files. This will vary depending on your router model and the download page it brings up.

15. Extract the ZIP file. This will be necessary to upload the firmware files to the router.

16. Upload the file to your router. Again, this process will vary depending on your router model.

17. Wait while the update is applied. This will usually take a few minutes.

18. Reset your router if the update fails. This may be necessary if the router won't allow you to upload the new files.

19. Open the AirPort Utility program in your Utilities folder. This will only be necessary for Apple AirPort base stations.

20. Click your base station and enter your password.

21. Click the “Update” button to download and install the update. This should bring up the latest firmware files needed for the update.

22. Wait for the router to update. This will take a few minutes.

Once the update is complete, the router should restart automatically and begin working normally. Congratulations! You've successfully updated your router's firmware. Enjoy the improved security, stability, and features that come with a firmware update.

How to Become an ASCAP Writer
If you are a songwriter or composer and you want to receive royalties for your work, one of the best ways to do this is to join the American Society of Composers, Authors, and Publishers, or ASCAP. Becoming a member of ASCAP is a straightforward process but there are a few requirements that you must meet. Furthermore, you must also provide some critical information and documentation as part of the application process. With the right information and a few simple steps, you can join ASCAP and begin to receive royalties for your work. 

Verify that you meet the requirements to become an ASCAP writer.
Becoming an ASCAP writer has two main requirements. First, you must be a songwriter or composer of either original works, lyricist, publisher, or similar type of professional within the music industry. Furthermore, you must provide proof of copyright or have control over your musical work. ASCAP could require documentation supporting your claim, so make sure you are prepared with this type of paperwork.

Collect the information you need to apply for a membership.
In order to apply for a membership with ASCAP, you will need to have all the necessary information, documents, and fees ready. This includes your personal information, such as full name, address, and social security number, as well as contact information for a previously published work, payment methods, and the $75 application fee. Additionally, you will need to prepare an example of an original work and the W-9 tax form with all of your pertinent tax information.

Visit the ASCAP website listed in the Sources section of this article to fill out an application online.
After gathering all of your relevant information, you can begin the process of joining ASCAP. First, go to the ASCAP website and proceed to the “Eligibility for Writer Online Application” questionnaire by clicking on the “Writer Apply Now” button on the home page. This questionnaire will allow ASCAP to further determine your eligibility for the program and to then begin the application process.

Click on the “Next” button to have the website determine your eligibility and proceed to the application.
Once you have completed the eligibility questionnaire, you will be directed to an application page. This page will give you the option to either download an application form and mail-in, or to fill out the application online.

Download a copy of the ASCAP application by visiting the website found in the Sources section of this article.
If you prefer to download an application, you can do so by going to the “Writer Applicants” page on the ASCAP website. This will open an extra window with the PDF of the application form, which you can then print out.

Scroll down on the website and click on the link for the print and mail option.
On the same page, there is a link for the “Print and Mail” option. Clicking on this link will provide you with the address and form you need to mail your application to.

Print, complete, and mail the application with your $75 application fee to the address in New York printed on the application.
Once you have printed out your application, complete the form with all of the necessary information. Make sure all of your information is accurate. Then, attach a check or money order for $75 made out to “ASCAP” and mail the form and fee to the address listed on the application.

Provide your personal information.
Your application requires some key personal information, including your name, address, phone number, and social security number. Make sure that this information is accurate and up to date.

Select your membership preference.
The application will also require you to select your membership preference. This is to signify the type of membership you are applying for, such as being a Writer or a Publisher. Make sure that you select the option that matches your profession.

Provide information about the song you wrote.
Your application also requires you to provide some information about a song you wrote, such as the title, any writers you worked with, and the year it was released. Again, make sure this information is accurate.

Review and sign or accept the terms and conditions of the ASCAP membership agreement.
The agreement outlines the rights and responsibilities of the ASCAP member. Make sure you read through these terms and conditions carefully before signing or accepting them.

Complete the W-9 tax form, which is required for you to receive royalty payments.
The W-9 form is another important document that you must complete in order to join ASCAP. This form is necessary for when you begin to receive royalties from ASCAP. Make sure all the information is accurate and up to date.

Receive the notification of acceptance from ASCAP.
Once you have successfully sent your application, you will receive a notification of your acceptance into the ASCAP membership program. You are now officially an ASCAP writer and can start receiving royalties for your work. Congratulations!

How to Celebrate Fall Through Mini Watercolors

The crisp fall air offers a wealth of inspiration to create mini works of art in watercolor. Here are steps to capture the spirit of fall in miniature:

Make a list of words that represent the season. Words such as pumpkin, leaves, apples, wind, cider, and scarecrow will help keep you focused as you capture autumn in miniature.

Look in magazines, online and in newspapers to see how others depict autumn. This will help fire up your creative muscles.

Cut a long strip, approximately 6" X 14" or use a piece of 11" X 14" watercolor paper from a pad. This will be used to create your mini works of art.

Draw freehand squares and rectangles, as many as you wish, any size you like, to use for your miniature "snapshots" or paintings of autumn. Try mixing the sizes, so there is variety within the piece.

Fill each space with something that represents fall. Really take time to consider the elements that make up the season, and decide which of those elements you would like to depict in your artwork.

Start by filling a shape with a fat pumpkin, if you are having difficulty facing those blank canvases. This will give you a starting point and give you a chance to explore color.

Set up a palette of primary and secondary tube watercolors. The yellows, oranges and reds of fall will come in handy in the overall composition. 

Keep the hues of fall in mind as you begin to color your design. Pure colors will be the best choice for this project.

Get started by working on the main elements of each scene. Think of the elements, such as trees, buildings, birds, etc. that are staples of an autumn landscape and experiment with how you depict them.

Keep on painting until all miniature scenes are complete. It is a good idea to work on one canvas at a time and to allow it to dry before moving onto the next.

To do smaller details, consider outlining them with markers. Remember, the details of a piece are what brings it to life and can add a subtle yet striking effect.

Stand up your paper. Back up and take a look at your project to see how the individual pieces fit together as a whole.

Keep in mind that any background you pick can be altered, even drastically changed. Work with different palettes and see what you can come up with.

Allow the piece to dry overnight and evaluate it again. A craft project such as this one can often be made even better after it has had time to sit and be evaluated.

Enjoy your foray into fall. Spend time celebrating the season through the art of miniature watercolors, and have fun doing it.  Allow yourself to get creative, take risks and create something unique and beautiful.

Setting up a preschool classroom is a great way to foster an environment of learning and excitement for young students. To set up a successful preschool classroom, it is important to be prepared, but it can also be a fun and creative journey. Here is how to set up a preschool classroom. 

First, you must designate a space for the classroom. An ideal area for a preschool classroom would be a low-traffic area within a building or other area with access to bathrooms, kitchen or common areas, as well as good light, space to move around, and natural materials such as plants and nature. Once you have chosen a space, it is important to set up guidelines to ensure the safety of the students and teachers.

You will also need to acquire materials for the classroom. Start out with a simple task by gathering basic classroom supplies like pencils, paper, markers, crayons, and scissors, as well as desks, chairs, and shelves. 

Circle Time: This is the central component of any preschool classroom, and as such, you should take a lot of time and effort into making it engaging not only for the students, but for the parents as well. Setting aside an area for circle time and introducing a variety of activities can keep everyone in the room engaged and entertained. Additionally, it can be beneficial to provide parents with music CDs or books for the circle time activities, as well as an assigned area for parents to gather during circle time. 

Cubbies: Coat hooks, milk crates, or box shelves can all serve as cubby areas for children. It is important for each child to have their own personal cubby where they can hang their coats, store extra clothes and toys, and keep their backpacks. This area should also have a separate container for naptime supplies, such as blankets or mats. 

Teacher supplies: In addition to basic supplies that should be offered by your center, there are several items you may need to request or buy yourself. These include toys and supplies for gross motor activities, math and science activities, fine motor activities, reading, art, and dramatic play centers. 

Understand that creating centers can be a bit of a challenge. Centers offer the students an opportunity to explore and can keep them engaged when the teacher needs to step away for other tasks.

Math & Science: These toys and activities can take many forms, but many are fine motor toys. Plastic interlocking gears, tiles, puzzles, and number games are all great ways to get students involved in math and science activities.

For general centers, there needs to be plenty of manipulatives. Examples of manipulatives include items such as pattern blocks, building blocks, colors, sizes, and shapes. 

Reading center: This is usually treated as a quiet area. If possible, set up bookcases along the walls to store books and periodicals that are related to the curriculum throughout the year. Having plenty of books available can give children the chance to explore new stories and expand their knowledge.

Blocks: Blocks are not only great for fine motors, but are easily one of the most popular centers in any preschool classroom. Building blocks and alphabet blocks can provide hours of benefits for the students, allowing them to work on creativity and problem-solving skills. Whether you choose traditional wooden blocks, foam blocks, or magnetic tiles, make sure sure that the blocks are free of chipping and small pieces that can be a choking hazard.

Ideally, you can go outside every day. Outdoor play encourages children to be more active, express their creativity, and be independent. Outdoor toys could easily be placed in the playground or a designated outdoor centers. Gross motor examples include: bowling with paper towel rolls and a large ball, CDs with dance music, and obstacle courses. 

Dramatic Play: This is a center that should change at least monthly and should be based on the monthly or weekly theme. Examples of this could be a doctor’s office, a grocery store, or a house for play. It is important to provide realistic props for the students, such as phones, textiles, costumes, and pans. 

Free art: Some teachers overlook this area because most classes have a daily art project. However, free art can be a great way to encourage children to explore texture, color, and shape. Many teachers will provide paper, markers, crayons, and scissors, but you can also use recycled materials, such as egg cartons and tops of cereal boxes.

Art displays: Children are, and should be, proud of their work. Baby Hangers, taped to the wall, are great for displaying every student’s work. If there are some finished pieces that can be used in dramatic play or rotated around the classroom, make sure to switch them out on a regular basis. 

Sensory: This can seem like an easy center to work on, but many teachers aren't creative enough. When thinking of sensory centers, a tray of rice, beans, or macaroni may come to mind, but they can become easily boring. Some teachers may need to look beyond the obvious to spark curiosity. Examples of sensory activities could include:

a "garden" with dirt, shovels, watering buckets, and beads for seeds
sand with dinosaurs, brushes, and magnifying glasses
an aquarium with rocks, toy houses, toy fish, and plants
finger painting with paint and shaving cream.

Puzzles and Games: Educational games and puzzles are crucial for not only fine motor skills, but also the specific skill each puzzle focuses on. Examples of puzzles and games include memory games, animal puzzles, counting games, and alphabet puzzles. 

With these ideas, you should be well on your way to setting up a successful and engaging preschool classroom. The key is to be organized and understand that while setting up a classroom can seem like a large task, it doesn't have to be one. With a bit of creativity and time, you can create an educational and fun environment for students of all ages.

Dealing with your period at school can be overwhelming, but luckily, there are several ways to make it easier. Being prepared is the best way to handle any type of situation and in this case, it couldn’t be any more true. Here are some tips to help you deal with your period during school.

First, make sure you always have pads or tampons with you at all times. It is best to bring extra just in case, or if you are planning on using a menstrual cup or other product, know the basics and make sure you are prepared with whatever you need. This way you can avoid any embarrassing moments or surprises.

Once you have your supplies, it's important to find the best spots to store them, when not in use. You can use your locker, your backpack, or even a big purse. If you are embarrassed to openly store your menstrual supplies, make sure to use an opaque bag or something that no one else can see through.

Along with your supplies, it is always a good idea to pack an extra pair of underwear and pants to school, just in case you have an unexpected accident. Likewise, pack a chocolate candy bar in case your emotional state takes a turn. Finally, having some form of medicine or pain relievers on hand might help alleviate any menstrual cramps or headaches you may experience.

It’s also important to be aware of your menstrual cycle so you can anticipate when you will be having your period. Pay attention to any warning signs your body is telling you. If you feel any cramping, bladder discomfort, nausea, or anything else, immediately head to the restroom and take care of it. A good rule of thumb is to take a bathroom break every 2-3 hours.

If you are having an emergency situation and don’t have access to menstrual supplies, you can also make an emergency pad. Take a few layers of toilet paper, fold it up, and tape it together. This should help keep you covered until you can get to a supply store. You can also wrap a jacket or shirt around your waist as a makeshift pad holder.

Drinking plenty of fluids and eating healthy foods that won’t make you feel bloated can also help alleviate any period-related problems. While everyone’s experience with their period is different, skipping out on gym class is usually not a good idea as it can help reduce cramps and menstrual pain.

Once you have taken care of yourself, remember to dispose of your menstrual supplies properly. Always double check to make sure you have disposed of them correctly, so there’s no chance of someone seeing them and getting embarrassed. Wearing darker colored clothing may also help you feel more confident and comfortable.

Finally, if someone makes an insensitive remark about your period, stay calm and confident. Respond and let them know what you are going though in a polite manner. If you need to be excused to deal with menstruation-related problems, don’t be embarrassed to tell your teacher, and if need be, don’t be afraid to ask the nurse, a friend, or your parents for help. Above all else, make sure your parents know about it, so they can help you if necessary. 

Dealing with your period while at school can be an uncomfortable experience, but having the right supplies and attitude can make all the difference. Being prepared for any unexpected moments and knowing how to handle them is the best way to make sure you get through it without any problems. With all these tips in mind, no matter what comes your way, you can feel confident knowing that you can handle your period at school.

How to Make a Wigwam
Making your own wigwam is an exciting and rewarding experience. Whether you’ve chosen to build one as a living space or simply for the creative challenge, you’ll find this project an enjoyable way to pass the time. With patience and attention to detail, you’ll have a beautiful dome-shaped structure in no time. Here, we will discuss the necessary steps of building a wigwam, beginning with gathering the material for your frame and ending with placing the finishing touches.

Gather some ash and basswood saplings. As the main structural elements of the wigwam, saplings play a vital role in the overall strength and durability of your structure. Look for trees with straight and tall trunks. Cut the saplings to the desired length, making sure to thin the branches and remove any excess twigs.

Prepare the saplings for the frame’s poles. Use a chisel and machete to pare the saplings down to roughly an inch thick and straighten them as much as possible.

Prepare cattail leaves for the thatching. Cut the leaves from the cattail leaves and then separate the leaves from the stalk. Comb through the remaining pile to separate the long fibers for later use.

Prepare the birch bark sheets for the covering. Bark can be found in abundant quantities and will protect the wigwam from the elements. Peel off the bark from thin strips of birch tree and cut into rectangles, large enough to cover the entire surface area of the wigwam.

Choose the right location. Look for an area with plenty of direct sunlight and flat solid ground. Keeping these factors in mind can ensure a comfortable and functional space.

Draw a 14-foot (4.2-meter) circle on the ground. Use a chalk line or wooden stake and hammer to mark out a 14-foot radius circle on the ground- the shape of your doorway will reference this mark.

Use a wooden stake and hammer to make 16 holes around the circle. These holes should be spaced evenly, and be deep enough to insert the first set of poles.

Insert eight of your prepared ash poles into the holes in the ground. The poles should be evenly spaced, and should form an inner ring of the frame.

Lash the poles together to form a dome shape. Carefully lace and tie the ends of the poles together at the top, to ensure the strongest foundation for your wigwam.

Tie the poles together at the joints. To make sure your frame is stable and secure, use twine to tie the poles together at the joints between each pole.

Add the remaining poles and lash them together using the same method. When the completed frame is built, it should look like a dome structure, with the poles forming a circle at the base.

Mark out a space between two poles for the doorway. The doorway should be large enough for easy access, but ensure the doorway is not near the base of the wigwam, as this will reduce the insulation capabilities of the structure.

Add the first horizontal hoop over the frame and fasten it in place. This hoop will form the base of the thatching layers, so it should be as securely fastened as possible.

Add two more rows of hoops. Space out the additional hoops evenly, and secure them using the same method as the first hoop. These hoops will hold the thatching materials in place.

Lash the bundles of cattail thatching to the frame. Begin with the first layer of thatching by attaching the bundles to the frame using twine. Be sure to go around the entire base, leaving plenty of overlapping space between each bundle. Then, repeat the same steps on top of the first layer.

Add a large, woven cattail mat for the doorway. Cut and shape a mat from the cattail leaves and secure it with twine to the frame of the wigwam. This will serve not only as an aesthetic feature, but also help to insulate the wigwam.

Tie the birch bark sheets to the top two hoops of your wigwam. Starting from the bottom hoop, secure each sheet of bark to the frame using sturdy twine. Overlap each sheet with the other, making sure the entire surface is covered.

Consider adding additional layers of protection. To make the wigwam even more secure from the elements, add additional mats of cattail leaves or apply generous and thick layers of mud to the birch bark.

Build a hearth or fire pit in the center. This is a great way to make the wigwam more aesthetically appealing and can double as a source of warmth.

Consider building benches or sleeping platforms halfway around the wigwam. To further enhance the cabin-like atmosphere, consider creating benches around the outside of the wigwam, or making mats or cots inside the space for a cozy sleeping area.

Building your own wigwam can be an exciting and rewarding experience. With some patience and a few basic tools, you can create a unique living space for yourself or your family, or simply create a creative and impressive structure. Regardless of the reasons, keep in mind the steps outlined here and your wigwam should be secure and ready to use in no time.

How to Enhance Your Learning Ability
Learning ability is shaped by many things and can be improved over time. Whether you are looking to get ahead in the workplace or in school, honing your learning ability is a great way to stay ahead of the competition. It’s also a great way of preparing yourself for any challenges that life may have in store for you. Follow these steps and you’ll be on your way to becoming the smartest person on your block in no time. 

Acknowledge your surroundings. 
When it comes to learning, one of the best things you can do is assess your learning environment. Find out what methods of studying you’ll be able to use in this particular setting - whether at home, in the library, or even in an online environment. Then, it’s time to prepare yourself. 

PREPARATION PHASE: To begin focusing in on these snapshots, you must remove all distractions from your area of study. Put away your phone, laptop, and anything else which may disturb you. You need to blank out your mind and body of concerns. If you find yourself feeling anxious or overwhelmed with the given material, take a few deep breaths to clear your mind. 

Now onto the learning. 
LEARNING PHASE: Now, gather your learning materials in front of you, and begin reading/learning. Focus intently on the given material and read carefully. Don’t rush yourself or try to speed read. Take your time and process the information. 

RE-ITERATION PHASE: Every 15 minutes, stop and practice what you’ve just learned (or if this is impossible, go back and re-read only the most important parts of the article/topic). Highlight or write down key topics on a blank sheet of paper. Use this to refer back to. Repeat to yourself the main points of the material to imprint them into your brain.

RETAINMENT PHASE: Then, once you have done the re-iteration step, get up and take a quick jog or a fast walk, or anything that will make your mind remember the information. Exercise can also help you refocus and clear your mind of any distractions, which can help you concentrate better. After that, relax and take a few moments to collect your thoughts. 

RE-DO PHASE: Once you have finished the “retainment” phase, relax yourself and repeat the processes starting at the “LEARNING PHASE”. Confidence should start to build because you’re already familiar with the material. Also, don’t forget to take breaks when needed and stay hydrated throughout the process. 

As you can see, learning ability is shaped by many elements. By following the steps outlined in this article and trusting your judgment, you’ll be able to enhance your learning ability over time and optimize your success. Practice makes perfect and you need to take the necessary time to allow yourself to understand the material, no matter how tedious it may seem. With this knowledge and these techniques, you will find success.

How to File for Divorce Online

Filing for divorce online is increasingly becoming an alternative to visiting a court and completing paperwork by hand. Here’s a step-by-step guide that can help you file for an online divorce.

Step 1: Decide whether you and your spouse agree on the divorce terms

The first step to filing for divorce online is to understand whether you and your spouse agree on the terms of the divorce. If both partners agree on the division of property and assets, and are willing to accept the terms laid out in the settlement agreement, the divorce process can be relatively quick and hassle-free.

Step 2: Discuss distribution of property

Once you and your spouse have agreed to the divorce terms, the next step is to discuss the distribution of property and assets. Take a look at the marital property agreement and make sure you’re both on the same page. In some cases, it may be beneficial to hire a divorce lawyer to help you discuss and settle financial matters related to the division of property.

Step 3: Agree on custody and child support

If you and your spouse have children, it’s important to agree on the terms of custody and child support. With online divorce, you and your spouse can work together to develop a parenting plan that outlines a clear division of parental responsibility, including a schedule of when the children will spend time with each parent.

Step 4: Consider alimony and spousal support

While not all divorces involve spousal support, it can be beneficial for certain spouses to receive financial support from the other following a divorce. If you and your spouse would like to consider alimony or spousal support, it’s best to discuss this matter beforehand so that you can determine a plan that is beneficial for both of you.

Step 5: Determine where you should file

The location in which you file for divorce often depends on several factors, such as the residency of the spouses, the length of time the couple has lived in the state where they intend to file, and the assets that need to be divided. Once you and your spouse decide where to file for divorce, you’ll need to research the specific court requirements that you must meet.

Step 6: Gather the forms you need to file for divorce

If you and your spouse agree with the divorce agreement, you’ll need to gather the forms you need to file for divorce. Every state has different forms, and the ones you need will depend on whether or not you have children, whether you are seeking spousal support, and other factors. 

Step 7: Fill out the required forms online

Once you’ve gathered the necessary forms, you can complete the paperwork online. Most states offer programs that allow individuals to fill out their divorce paperwork online, which can save time and eliminate mistakes.

Step 8: Call your jurisdiction’s court clerk’s office

Before you submit your divorce paperwork, it’s important to contact your jurisdiction’s court clerk’s office and inquire about how to file for divorce online. The staff at the court clerk’s office can provide you with helpful information about the process and any rules you must follow.

Step 9: Review your State Court’s website for information about electronic filing

Some states allow individuals to file for divorce online using an electronic filing system, also known as e-filing. Before you e-file, it’s important to check your state court’s website for information about the process and to determine whether e-filing is an option.

Step 10: Determine whether you must pay a fee to use e-file

If you decide to use the e-filing system, it’s important to determine whether you must pay a fee to use it. Many states charge a small fee for e-filing services, and the fees can vary by county or court district.

Step 11: Use a privately owned online divorce document preparation service if you cannot use e-file

If you cannot use the e-filing system, another option is to use a privately owned online divorce document preparation service. With these services, you can complete the necessary forms online, and then they will be sent to the court for processing.

Step 12: Give your spouse legal notice that you’re filing for divorce

Once you’ve filled out the necessary forms and submitted them to the court, it’s important to give your spouse legal notice that you’re filing for divorce. In most states, this notice must be served in-person or by certified mail.

Step 13: Comply with the rules for an “uncontested divorce”

If you and your spouse agree on all of the issues surrounding your divorce, you will most likely have an uncontested divorce. To complete an uncontested divorce, you must comply with the filing requirements in your state. Generally, most states require the couple to file a Joint Petition with the court, as well as a Separation Agreement that outlines how the couple plans to divide their assets and responsibilities.

Step 14: Comply with the rules for a “contested divorce”

If you and your spouse do not agree on the divorce terms, you will have a contested divorce. Unfortunately, the process of filing for a contested divorce is typically more complicated, as you may need to take matters to court in order to reach an agreement.

Step 15: Use mediation to come to an agreement

If you and your spouse cannot come up with an agreement, it’s often beneficial to schedule a mediation session with a neutral or third-party mediator. Working with a mediator can help both partners stay open-minded and find a resolution that works for them both.

Step 16: Stay on top of the progress of your divorce

Once your divorce has been filed, it’s important to stay on top of its progress. Most courts will provide updates on you and your spouse’s case, but you may also need to follow up with the court to ensure everything is moving along smoothly.

Step 17: Find out whether you must attend a hearing or trial

Depending on the type of divorce you’ve chosen, you may need to attend a hearing or trial. Make sure you know the rules of the court and check ahead to find out if any additional documents are required for your case.

Step 18: Prepare for your hearing

If your divorce requires a hearing or trial, it can be beneficial to prepare in advance. Consider the questions you may be asked in court and review any documents that may be relevant to your case. Additionally, make sure to wear proper attire and bring any necessary forms, paperwork, and evidence your attorney may need.

Step 19: Finalize your divorce

Once all of the paperwork and evidence has been submitted and all the parties have reached an agreement, you’ll need to finalize your divorce. This can be done through the court system or, if you and your spouse have agreed to an alternative method of dispute resolution, you can arrange to finalize your divorce via mediation or another method.

How to Replace a Bicycle Tire' is a simple, yet essential part of bike maintenance. If you're a cyclist, it's important to know how to replace a tire when it gets punctured. Although it may seem intimidating at first, the process is actually quite easy once you understand the steps. 

To get started, make sure that you have all of the necessary tools available: two tire levers, a new tube, and an appropriate pump. 

First, you'll need to get the wheel out of the frame. This is done by loosening the nuts that hold the axle to the frame, followed by disconnecting the brakes if they get in the way. When this is done, you should be able to take the tire out from the frame with ease. The next step is to deflate the tube completely by pressing down the inner part of the valve. 

With the tube deflated, you'll want to use a couple of tire levers to loosen the tire beads from the rim by squeezing the tire together all the way around the rim. This process could take time depending on the configuration of the tire and its size.

After the tire is detached from the rim, you'll need to remove the tube completely. Inspect the punctured tube for leaks and determine the cause of the puncture. If the puncture is too large, the tube can be tossed out and you'll need to buy a new one. If necessary, you can purchase a patch kit and fix the punctured tube.

Once the new tube is in the tire, make sure that it's not twisted and use a few pumps of air to fill it half way. Taking your time, slowly and correctly work the tire onto the rim, making sure that the tube isn't pinched in the process.

Once the tire is completely on the rim, it's time to re-inflate it up to the appropriate PSI. Make sure to tighten the presta screw and lock ring, followed by hand tightening them. 

The last step is to put the wheel back on the bike. Re-connect and tension all the necessary parts before taking it for a spin.

In conclusion, anyone can learn how to replace a bicycle tire, given that the right tools are available and instructions are followed. As long as you take your time and work carefully, the task is a straightforward one that makes bike maintenance much easier. Follow these tips and you'll have a new tire in no time.

How to Make a Carnation Corsage' is a great way to make a stunning and unique accessory that will last you for years. A carnation corsage is not only beautiful, but also relatively easy to make. With the right supplies and know-how, you can create a personal and stylish corsage for any occasion.

To begin, you will need some carnations, ribbon, wire, shears, and florist's tape. Make sure to choose carnations in different colors for more variety. Start by snipping off the heads of each of the carnations with a pair of sharp shears. Then, prepare your fillers such as ferns, leaves, or flowers, before cutting 6 inch (15.2 cm) pieces of 22-gauge wire with a wire cutter. For each carnation stem, thread the wire through the upper part of the stem, just below the base, and secure it with a 6 inch (15.2 cm) piece of green florist's tape. Continue this process for each of the initial spray carnations. 

Next, place the spray carnations in the order you would like them to appear. Then, cut off a very long piece of wired silk ribbon and form it into 4 to 5 figure 8 loops. Once the loops are completed, cut a 6 inch (15.2 cm) piece of wire and thread it through the center of the loops. Align the ribbon at the base of the carnations and wrap a long piece of florist's tape around the bow wire and the larger corsage stem. 

To finish, place a pencil or pen near the bottom of the corsage stem and insert two pins in the top of the spiral for pinning onto a lapel or dress. Finally, trim any parts of the spray that extend too far from the sides of the corsage. To keep your corsage looking beautiful and fresh, store it in a plastic container in the refrigerator until you are ready to present it or wear it. With these easy steps, you can make a stunning and unique carnation corsage that will make a statement at any event.

Creating an Autoblog with WordPress can be a great way to share content with your audience. If you've never heard of an autoblog, it's a type of blog where content is automatically generated from feeds from other websites or blogs. The advantage of using an autoblog is that it takes away some of the time involved in creating content. Here's how to get started with an autoblog using WordPress.

First, you'll need to install the WP-O-Matic plugin for WordPress. Go to the Plugins section and click 'Install Plugins' in the top right hand of the page. Type in 'WP-O-Matic' in the search box, and click Install on the right hand side of the description. After the installation you should receive a message stating the installation was successful.

Now head further down the Settings list on the left hand side of the navigation menu to WP-O-Matic. Once you are on the dashboard menu click on 'Add Campaign'. Under the basic tab you are asked to include a title and, most importantly, add a number of Feed URLs. This is where you will add the web address of the websites or blogs that you wish to syndicate content from.

Next, you need to set the frequency of the content from the Feed URLs. On the Feed URLs page in Wordpress you can also change the Frequency from 1d 5h 0 to 0d 0h 5m and then click Submit. This will allow your autoblog to check the URLs you added for new content to syndicate every five minutes.

While still on the WP-O-Matic dashboard click the Options link on the left hand side. Scroll down until you see the Auto-Activate Campaign & Generate Posts, and copy the code at the end of this section. With this address copied you need to go back to your websites control panel. Scroll right to the bottom and under the Advanced Box is the Cron jobs option, and click this.

A window will open up asking you to set up cron job. On this page, you are asked your experience level. Set the timing of Entry 1 to those that you see above. This will allow your WordPress autoblog to post new content every five minutes. Once you have set your cron job interval, click Update and you are finished. You have now successfully set up an autoblog. The WP-O-Matic plugin on your WordPress blog will now automatically syndicate content from the provided feed URLs and add this to your blog.

Dealing with long distance relationships can be difficult, but there are ways to make them work. Many couples have successful long distance relationships, so it’s possible to make them work. To make sure things go smoothly and that both parties are feeling secure and taken care of in the relationship, it is important to initiate a discussion with your partner about how you will handle this new long distance relationship.

One of the most important things to establish in a long distance relationship is figuring out your end game. What both people expect out of the relationship should be discussed and established. Do both of you want to eventually live near each other, or keep the relationship going whether a face to face reunion isn’t feasible? Establishing a goal will help keep both parties oriented towards what they both want out of the relationship and make sure that everyone is on the same page.

Another important aspect of making long distance relationships work is having clear and frequent communication. Figure out what methods you will use to communicate: phone, Skype, email, and text are common methods. Make agreements with each other about how much and how often you will keep in contact. Commit to checking in with each other at least once a day. You don’t need to be constantly in touch with your partner; too much contact can be overwhelming and too little contact can be damaging.

Also important in making a long distance relationship work is ensuring that both people have a good support network, including family and friends. This is a great way to keep from getting too overwhelmed by the distance, as well as to stay grounded in reality. Try joining a long-distance-relationship discussion forum. These can be great places to get advice from people who have been in similar relationships and provide a space for venting and understanding.

Another set of important points to consider in a long distance relationship is being able to trust your partner and feel secure in the relationship. Both partners should feel safe enough to take risks in the relationship, like sharing deeper feelings. Without a feeling of safety and security, it’s going to be hard to make any real progress towards a lasting relationship. Avoid power games or manipulation. Oftentimes your partner won’t be around to verify something for you and slight discrepancies may arise, so it’s important to take other’s word with a grain of salt.

It is also important to stay independent in a long distance relationship. Find ways to fill your time and stay engaged with your own life. Seek out activities and hobbies that will bring happiness and satisfaction within yourself, so that you don’t rely on your partner to be your sole source of happiness. Mutual activities, no matter the distance, should remain a part of the relationship. Go out and do fun things, set up weekly date nights using Skype, or something similar, to make sure that both of you have something to look forward to. Find games to play together, create things together, or send each other trouble-free presents or love letters to make the connection more tangible.

As with all relationships, a long distance relationship comes with its ups and downs, and it is crucial to stay positive. Accept that it is a different kind of relationship, so focus on what you do have: trust, honesty, and the ability to be together. However, it is also important to be realistic about the hardships that come with living far apart. Make sure to take the time to talk about how you are both feeling. Emotions are fragile and it’s important to express them. Finally, understanding your own attachment style can also help you figure out what’s real and what’s not when you’re having doubts about the relationship.

All in all, it is possible for a long distance relationship to be successful. Although it demands effort, communication, and some commitment, it can also be a very rewarding kind of relationship. To make sure that your long distance relationships works, it is important to have a discussion with your partner to figure out what you both expect out of the relationship. Establish clear communication methods, commit to checking in with each other daily, and figure out ways to stay engaged with one another. Don’t forget that both partners should have a support network and stay independent. Keep positive and realistic, and trust that you are both doing the best that you can.

How to Speed Up a Slow Windows Computer for Free
Do you feel like your Windows computer is running slow? You can significantly speed up your Windows machine without needing to spend any money. This article will take you through the steps you need to take to make your computer run faster.

For starters, you'll need to get rid of any programs or processes that aren't necessary for your computer to run. To do this, hold down Alt and Control and tap Delete. This will bring up the Task Manager. In the Task Manager, click on the “Startup” tab. This will show you all the programs and processes running when your computer starts up.

From this list, you can decide which programs you want to disable. Just click on the program you want to disable and then click the “Disable” button. Repeat this disabling process for all programs that you don’t need running. Once you’re done, close the Task Manager.

Next, you’ll want to open up the “Hidden Icons” menu. This menu will show you all the programs that are running in the background. Review this list and then right-click on any process that you don’t need running. Click “Exit” at the bottom of the context menu to close the program.

Now you’ll want to head to the Start menu and open the “Control Panel” app. In the Control Panel type “Adjust the appearance” into the search bar. This will open the “Adjust the appearance and performance of Windows” window. Here you can review your computer’s visual effects and click the option that best pertains to your PC’s needs. Once you’ve done this, exit the Performance Options window.

Next, open the Start menu and type in “disk cleanup.” This will open the Disk Cleanup app. Check every box under the “Files to Delete” heading and then click “OK.” Confirm your choice by clicking “Delete Files.” This will free up some space on your computer.

To further improve your computer’s speed, open the Start menu and type “defrag” into the search bar. This will allow you to open the “Defragment and Optimize Drives” window. Select your main drive in this window and then click “Optimize.”

You can also improve your computer’s speed by moving your files to external storage. This will free up some space on your computer, which will then allow it to run faster.

Finally, you should consider uninstalling any programs that you don’t use. Right-click on any program in the Start menu and then click “Uninstall.” Confirm your choice and then uninstall any additional apps you don’t use. You can then replace these apps with other programs that are more lightweight and faster.

Once you’ve taken all of the steps above, restart your computer for best results. This will allow all the changes to take effect and you should be able to enjoy a faster computer experience from now on.

How to Rate the Presidents
The election of the President of the United States is an important event in the country’s history which is watched and documented worldwide. The individuals who take up the seat as the leader of the most powerful nation on earth are usually rated based on their performance in office.  So how does one accurately rate a president? To best measure a president’s performance and legacy, it is important to keep an open mind and evaluate their overall performance based on a variety of factors. 

Analyze and assess the president's overall achievements. There are several indicators that can be used to measure a president’s performance. For starters, it would be wise to evaluate the president’s ability to make decisions and arrive at practical solutions. Were the president’s decisions beneficial to the people of the United States? Did they bring the country into a more prosperous period? Did they uphold the principles of justice that the United States stands for? It is also important to assess the president’s short-term and long-term legacy. Has the president continued to make a lasting impression on the nation even after leaving office? Do their achievements still remain relevant to this day?

Look at precedents set by the president. When assessing the president’s performance, it is key to look at precedents and decisions that have been set during the president’s term which have been followed by his/her successors. Some presidents have set precedents that have been maintained for generations. For example, Washington established the two-term tradition that was later adopted by many of his successors, including Obama, Johnson, Reagan, and Eisenhower. Similarly, President Obama has retained Bush’s Secretary of Defense, and Johnson continued Kennedy’s fight for civil rights. Franklin Roosevelt also established America as the leader of the free world and worked hard to re-establish a world organization dedicated to the pursuit of world peace and non-aggression. Moreover, Reagan is credited with ending the Cold War which seven of his predecessors were unable to do. And Monroe’s Richard Rush negotiated the Bagot-Rush Treaty with Great Britain as both acting secretary of state and attorney general, while Jefferson managed to establish his own program as leader of the Republican Party during the Revolution of 1800. There are also cases in which a president orchestrated a successful outcome out of a difficult situation, like when Nixon called up the reserves, put the nuclear forces on alert, and sent the Sixth Fleet into the Mediterranean Sea when the Soviet Union tried to impose a unilateral peace settlement on the Middle East.

Beware of snap judgments. While looking at and analyzing a president’s historical achievements and setting precedents for future f presidents are important considerations for measuring the impact of a president’s performance, one should not make snap judgments when determining the rating for the president in question. It is important to understand that the rating assigned may not be the same as what every other person believes. Therefore, it is important to be unbiased and take all factors into consideration when rating a president of the United States.

Spotting a liar can be a difficult task, but with the right knowledge and keen observation, it's possible to recognize and call out lying. By relying on your intuition, common sense, and past experiences, as well as asking the right questions, listening closely, and studying body language and facial expressions, you'll be able to spot cognitive clues that could give away lies. 

Using your intuition and common sense is the first step to being able to spot a liar. Your subconscious mind might pick up on more subtle cues inlies than you wouldpick up consciously. Pay attention to if you have any unusual feelings or thoughts when a person you’re speaking to is being evasive. 

In addition to relying on your intuition, it helps to use the knowledge and experiences you have gained in the past when talking with someone and attempting to spot a liar. Have you had trouble with this person in the past? Have you noticed them doing anything shady or suspicious in the past? Is there a difference between the stories they tell you now compared to stories they told you before?

When a person lies, one way you can tell is if they have something to gain or lose. How will they benefit from telling you this lie? What will they gain from it? Why would they risk getting caught in a lie, when telling the truth usually gives them nothing to worry about? Asking yourself questions like these can help you see if the person you're talking to is indeed lying. 

Once you notice something off about their story, start asking for specifics. Ask questions to get more information and details from their story. Ask them to repeat certain parts of their story back to you, and ask questions about their story in different variations. If they contradict themselves in any way, that might be a clue that they're lying. This may require you to keep pressing them with questions until they start getting flustered or slip up. 

In this situation, it’s also a good idea to ask if the person is lying in a non-accusatory way. This might help give way to a more honest conversation, where the person is more likely to come clean about any lies they’ve told.

Pay attention to how the person sounds when they talk to you. Most of the time, if someone is lying they will talk differently from the tone and cadence of their regular speaking pattern. They may speak faster or slower, or there may be a change in the pitch of their voice, or they may even stutter or stammer. 

In addition, if someone changes the subject abruptly when you ask them a certain question, this could be a sign that they are pulling away from the truth. 

It’s also important to pay attention to any body language that a person may give away when lying. Nervous habits such as fidgeting, wringing their hands, or avoiding eye contact can all be clues that someone is lying. Additionally, look to their eyes and face for any subtle movements that may show they are being dishonest. A fake expression, open mouth gestures, or excessive blinking can point to a lie. 

When it comes to spotting liars, it’s important to pay attention to all the details and clues that your intuition and experience provide, as well as nonverbal cues from the person you’re speaking to. By using your common sense, listening to what your mind and heart tells you, and asking questions, you’ll be able to identify if someone is telling the truth or trying to hide something.

How to Make Pumpkin Bars
Making pumpkin bars is a delicious way to enjoy fall flavors. Plus, they’re relatively easy to make, so you can whip them up in no time at all. Here’s how to make pumpkin bars in eight simple steps!

Step 1: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
Start by preheating the oven to 350°F (175°C). This will ensure that the pumpkin bars cook evenly.

Step 2: Beat the eggs until they turn pale and foamy.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs until they turn pale and foamy. This will lighten the pumpkin bar batter and make it fluffier.

Step 3: Mix in the sugar, oil, and pumpkin purée.
Add the sugar, oil, and pumpkin purée to the eggs and mix them together until everything is completely blended. 

Step 4: Add the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.
Now you can add the dry ingredients, such as the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt. Mix everything together until combined.

Step 5: Spread the batter in a lightly-greased baking pan.
Lightly grease a baking pan with cooking spray or butter. Then, pour the pumpkin bar batter into the pan and spread it out evenly.

Step 6: Bake the pumpkin bars for 25 to 30 minutes.
Insert the baking pan into the preheated oven. Bake the pumpkin bars for 25 to 30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Step 7: Cool the pumpkin bars on a wire cooling rack for 2 hours.
Once the pumpkin bars are finished baking, transfer them to a wire cooling rack and let them cool for at least 2 hours. This will give them time to set.

Step 8: Make the cream cheese icing.
To make the cream cheese icing, mix together the cream cheese, vanilla extract, and butter until smooth. Then, beat in the confectioners' sugar 1 cup (125 grams) at a time. Taste the icing and adjust the consistency or flavor with more sugar or butter.

Step 9: Spread a thick layer of icing over the pumpkin bars.
Using a rubber spatula, spread the cream cheese icing over the cooled pumpkin bars in a thick layer. You can also add some extra flavor or texture with sprinkles, chopped nuts, or chocolate chips.

Step 10: Wait for the icing to set, then cut the sheet into bars.
Let the icing set for 1 hour before cutting the pumpkin bars into squares.

Step 11: Make the glaze.
For the glaze, mix together the confectioners' sugar and spices in a large bowl. Then, stir in the melted butter, vanilla extract, and 1½ teaspoons (22.5 milliliters) of water. Taste the glaze and adjust the consistency with more water.

Step 12: Pour the glaze on top of the bars.
Once the glaze is ready, carefully pour it over the pumpkin bars. Make sure to spread it evenly across the top.

Step 13: Wait 1 hour for the glaze to set, then cut the bars.
Let the glaze set for another hour, then slice the bars into little squares. 

Step 14: Serve the bars on a plate.
Take the pumpkin bars out of the pan and arrange them on a plate. Serve them to your friends and family with tea or coffee for a special fall treat!

Knowledge on how the correlation between Vata Dosha and Nitric Oxide (NO) works can help us to understand numerous physiological mechanisms that shape life. In this article, we present a brief introduction to Vata Dosha and its relationship to NO, providing an overview of the scientific basis of this correlation and further discussing possible ways to apply this information to modern biologic sciences.

Vata Dosha is a Sanskrit word meaning air, and within the context of Ayurvedic medicine, it is defined as the energy of movement. It is believed to be the cause behind every type of motion related to the body, both on a molecular and macroscopic level, and is largely responsible for maintaining homeostasis. In TCM terms, Vata is linked to the element of wind, and is generally represented as the force of air and space.

Nitric Oxide (NO) is also considered a gaseous element and is a messenger in both intra and extra cellular pathways. It delivers signals to target cells, plays a significant role in physiology, and is associated with numerous pathologies.

When looking at the correlation between Vata Dosha and NO, it is important to consider the similarities between the two substances. They both have gaseous states, and both have rapid onset of action, meaning that they have powerful effects and can be used in a direct or immediate way. Additionally, they act as messengers in the human body, providing signaling pathways to target cells and tissues and allowing for efficient physiological processes in the body. 

This correlation is seen and studied in numerous areas of biomedicine, such as cardiovascular physiology and neurology. In regards to cardiovascular physiology, nitric oxide is known to influence four major processes: hypotension, hypertension, myocardial ischemia, and platelet aggregation. It has also been utilized in several studies to regulate the endothelium, a layer of thin tissue that lines the inner surface of blood vessels, helping to reduce inflammation and control vasomotor tone. 

In the field of neurology, nitric oxide has been used in a number of applications, ranging from its role in synaptic plasticity and neurotransmission to its ability to modulate pain transmission in the peripheral nervous system. As a gaseous substance, it is capable of diffusing across the blood-brain barrier and is essential in the development and maintenance of normal neuronal function. Its connection to Vata Dosha in this realm relates to its implications in enhancing cognitive function, as well as its potential role in protecting against neurodegenerative diseases.

An additional area of biomedicine that we can consider when analyzing the correlation between Vata Dosha and NO references the relationship between these two elements and endocrine function. It has been shown through research that there is a link between nitric oxide production and Vata Dosha balance, which in turn can have an effect on the endocrine system. This is due to the fact that nitric oxide production is required for the proper functioning of many endocrine glands, and that Vata Dosha can affect their functioning and secretion of hormones.

In conclusion, Vata Dosha and nitric oxide share many similar characteristics in terms of their physical state, onset of action, and numerous functions within the body. They both act as essential messengers in intra and extra cellular pathways, and are correlated in many areas of biomedicine. While further research is needed to understand the full breadth of their relationship, the connection between this gaseous element and the energy of movement is a valuable starting point for improved biologic science.

Installing Hyperic HQ on your Ubuntu 7.04 computer can be a great way to ensure that you keep track of the performance, operations, and data of your machine. Hyperic HQ is highly configurable so that it will fit the needs of your system, while providing a variety of services such as monitoring, backup, and other capacity planning measures. In addition, Hyperic HQ will track your system's performance and availability, and send regular notifications of important changes. 

To get started installing Hyperic HQ on your Ubuntu 7.04 computer, first download the Hyperic HQ installer package from the official website. Once you've downloaded the appropriate version of the installer, run the installer with the following command: ./hyperic-hq-installer/setup.sh. You will be asked to select the software that you wish to install. By default, Ext JS, Oracle Database Manager, and Apache Tomcat will be selected - if you need these components, select them and hit enter to continue. 

Next, you'll be asked to select the installation path for the HQ server. Accept the suggested path, or if you'd like to change it, enter your desired path and hit enter to continue. You will then need to provide the name of the SMTP server that Hyperic HQ will use to send out email notifications. Many commonly used ISPs provide this service, so enter in the SMTP server's ip address or name at this point.

After you have identified an SMTP server, the installation will automatically begin - but before it finishes, you'll need to install the Hyperic HQ agent. To do this, open up a second terminal window and log in as root. You will then be asked to execute a script - do so with the following command: sudo /tmp/hyperic-hq-installer/installer-3.1.0/data/hqdb/tune-os.sh. After you've executed the script, return to the first terminal that has paused the installation process - hit enter to complete the installation. 

Once the installation has been finished, the install-log will be saved to /tmp/hyperic-hq-installer/installer-3.1.0/hq-install.log. Note that if you shut down or reboot the system, the temporary files in the /tmp/ folder will be deleted.

Next, you'll want to start the Hyperic HQ server. To do this, use the following command: /home/hyperic/server-3.1.0/bin/hq-server.sh start. You should see an output that says “Starting HQ server…Initializing HQ server configuration…”. When it has finished, you can log into your server using the following address: http://127.0.0.1:7080/. Note that due to the complexity of the setup, the first start may take longer than usual. 

Now, to start the HQ agent, use the following command: /home/hyperic/agent-3.1.0/hq-agent.sh start. You should see an output that says “Starting agent - Unable to load agent token file.” You will then need to configure the agent by inputting the IP address of the HQ server, as well as the port number that the server will use to communicate with the agent. You can also optionally enable encrypted communication between the HQ Agent and the HQ server using SSL. 

To make sure that the Hyperic HQ agent is properly communicating with the server, review the HQ server port and make sure that it matches the port you have entered. You will then need to enter the username and password that the HQ Agent will need in order to communicate with the HQ server. When you have finished, the agent should register itself with the host. 

Finally, you can access the Hyperic HQ server via a web browser on your host computer, or if you'd like you can access it with a web browser on another computer. Just navigate to the following address: http:// 127.0.0.1:7080 or with the ip address of your host computer http://%hostip%:7080 and you should see the Hyperic HQ dashboard where you can begin monitoring the performance and data of your system.

Using Windows Movie Maker is an easy way to edit a movie or video file. It's available as subscription through Microsoft, or you can download it for free. Once you've done that, follow these simple steps to get the hang of the program:

Open your file or movie. This can be done by clicking the “Import video” button, and selecting the file you wish to open. It may take a few moments for the file to load, depending on the file size and length of the clip. 

Once the file has loaded, you should be able to see it in the Storyboard at the bottom of the screen, and you can click and drag the different sets of clips you've shot one at a time. 

Next, you'll want to add effects and transitions between the clips. In the Effects tab on the left panel, there are several different types of effects available. There are also several transitions you can choose from if you want a smooth transition from one clip to the next.

If you want to cut out some time from a clip, click the half triangle on the clip's edge in the Storyboard to move how long you want the scene. You can also mute the camera if you're making a music video; this way, you won't hear the sounds from the video while the music plays. 

To add a title or credits to your movie, choose a link from the options in the left panel. Then, click the Timeline view at the bottom of the screen. You should now be able to see the time line with any music, titles, clips, effects, and transitions you've added. 

Once you're satisfied with the movie, you can save it to your computer or, if you have a CD/DVD, save it to that too. It may take a few moments for the file to save, but when it's done, you'll be finished with your movie. Now you can watch it and share it with others!

How to Wear Makeup at a Young Age

For those just starting out with makeup, the task can seem intimidating. But wearing makeup as a young person can be fun and pair with your own style. With some simple tips and tricks, you can learn how to wear makeup at a young age in a way that is both stylish and age appropriate.

The most important thing to remember when wearing makeup is to stick to subtle makeup colors that are suited to your age range. Dark, bold colors like blues and blacks could look unnatural, especially in pre-teen makeup. Instead, opt for lighter shades like a very light pink, light blue, silver, or skin color.

Before applying any makeup, make sure to cleanse your face first with a warm washcloth. This will help create a clean canvas for your makeup and prevent it from becoming oily or streaky. For eyes and cheeks, use a light tinted moisturizer to keep your face looking hydrated. Start off simple with blush and lip gloss that matches your skin tone. How to Treat a Broken Ankle 
If you have a broken ankle, it is important to take good care of it in order to avoid any further complications and speed up your recovery. Treating a broken ankle involves following a few simple steps, such as monitoring the pain or swelling, taking appropriate medications for pain relief, and using a cast or splint to protect it from further injury. Here's how to treat a broken ankle:

Take note of any loss of function you experience in your ankle. You may notice that it's painful to move your ankle, or that it feels weak. These symptoms may be a sign of a broken ankle, so it's important to take note of any changes in your ankle's mobility.

Monitor the pain you feel. Keep a record of the pain you have in your ankle and let your doctor know if it gets worse.

Check for swelling. Swelling is a common side effect of a broken ankle and can be painful. Check for a lump or swelling in the area around your ankle.

Look for any redness or bruising on or around your ankle. Redness or bruising may be a sign that the ankle needs medical attention.

Monitor any heat you feel in the area around your ankle. Heat can be caused by inflammation, so if you're feeling any heat in the area around your ankle, it may be a sign that you have a broken ankle.

Follow the acronym PRICE if you are unable to get to a doctor right away. PRICE stands for Protect, Rest, Ice, Compress, and Elevate. You should protect the ankle from further injury by using a splint, rest the ankle, apply ice to reduce swelling and pain, compress the ankle with elastic bandages, and elevate the ankle above the heart. 

Take acetaminophen to control the pain. Talk to your doctor to determine the correct dosage based on your age, weight, and any other medical conditions you may have. 

Get yourself to a hospital to get your ankle taken care of. Depending on the severity of the break, you may need to have a cast put on your ankle or you may need to have a procedure called aclosed reduction done if your ankle is both fractured and dislocated. 

Talk to your doctor about surgery if you have multiple fractures or a severe dislocation. In some cases, surgery may be necessary to properly align your ankle bones and properly set the fractures.

Get some rest. This is essential for recovery and may even help to reduce the pain you are feeling. 

Consider taking some over-the-counter pain medication. Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as ibuprofen or naproxen can help to reduce inflammation and pain.

Use crutches to support yourself. Crutches gives you more stability and can also help to prevent further injury to your ankle. 

Avoid getting your cast wet. If you do get your cast wet, it can weaken the structure of the cast and also increase the risk of infection. 

Make an appointment with a physical therapist. A physical therapist can help you regain strength and mobility in your ankle. The therapist can also provide guidance on exercises that you can do to strengthen your ankle.

Understand that you must rehabilitate your ankle in order to regain strength and movement in your ankle. After getting treatment for your ankle, you will need to go through an ankle rehabilitation program to regain full range of motion and function. 

Perform ankle joint stability exercises. These exercises, such as the single-leg stance, help to strengthen the muscles around your ankle joint. 

Do an ankle joint mobility exercise. This exercise entails stretching the muscles and tendons around the ankle joint in order to increase flexibility and reduce stiffness. 

Perform a calf raise exercise to strengthen the muscles, tendons, and ligaments surrounding the ankle joint. Calf raise exercises help to improve your balance and coordination, which can help you to avoid reinjuring your ankle.

Try toe towel curls. This exercise helps to strengthen all the small muscles of the foot, which helps to improve balance and stability.

Increase your flexibility with a calf stretch. This stretch helps to increase flexibility in your muscles and tendons, which can help to reduce swelling and pain in your ankle.

Try doing tennis ball rolls. This exercise helps to break up any knots in the muscles and ligaments around your ankle joint, which can help to reduce pain and better support your ankle.

Treating a broken ankle can be a difficult process, but following these steps can help ensure a full recovery.
