How to Repair a Remote Control
Are you stuck with a remote control that's no longer functioning? Don't worry! Repairing a remote control can be quite simple, as long as you know the correct method. With some careful planning and a few inexpensive items, you can make sure your remote functions properly. Read on to learn how to repair a remote control.

Items You Will Need
• Keypad repair kit 
• Dull knife 
• Cotton swabs 
• Alcohol 
• Acetone 
• Conductive paint

Steps
1. Remove any batteries out of your remote control. 
2. Check over the remote control and remove any screws keeping the remote together. 
3. Open the remote control by using a dull knife or something similar. 
4. Once you have it open, make a note of any switches or loose pieces so you will know where they go when you put the remote back together. 
5. Clean the circuit board and keypad to remove any dirt and oil 
6. Dip a cotton swab (provided with keypad repair kit) in some alcohol or acetone (acetone is provided with key-pad-repair kit) and clean all the black contacts the meets with the circuit board on the backside of the rubber keypad. 
7. Apply the conductive paint (included with keypad repair kit) to the keypads contacts. 
8. Let the remote dry for a few hours. 
9. Carefully place the remote back together remembering to put all sliding bars and loose objects back where they came from. 
10. Place batteries back in and test it.

Tips
• Purchase the keypad repair kit, which is well worth the money, especially if the remote is a really expensive remote control, or no longer manufactured. 
• If the remote still does not work, perhaps the best option is to consider buying a new one and dumping this one in the recycle bin. 
• Keep in mind that this type of repair can void your remote warranty if you have one.

Warnings
• Be very careful when working with the remote to avoid cracking or breaking it. 
• Make sure to avoid contact with the alcohol or acetone as it can be harmful to your eyes and skin. 
• Make sure to follow all instructions with the keypad repair kit as it will keep your remote safe.

Doing everything step-by-step is the most effective way to teach your dog how to get a beer from the refrigerator. With a bit of patience and time, your pup can become your own bartender! 

The first part of teaching your dog to get a beer from the fridge is to make the fridge easy to open for your dog. This means taking away all the obstacles that block your dog's access to the fridge as much as possible. If you have handles with locks, try temporarily putting a piece of tape over them so that they no longer block your dog's path to the door.

The next step is to teach your dog to notice the towel or rope. Place the towel or rope in front of the fridge and direct your dog towards it. With a bit of treats, verbal encouragement, and lots of pats on the head, teach your pup to bite the towel or rope when he comes near it. It's extremely important to reward your pup for biting the towel, as this helps shape their behavior and lets them know that this action is desired.

Once your pup knows to bite the towel, teach them to pull on the towel or rope whenever they feel it tugging. This way, your pup can open the fridge door. It's important to reward your pup for this action, as it encourages them to keep doing this.

Once your pup has mastered pulling the towel or rope, you can move on to the final part of this subtask: teaching your dog to open the door. To do this, buy some beer cans that will fit in your dog's mouth and place them in the fridge where your pup can get them. Place a cold beer on the floor and direct your pup to it. 

Teach your pup to notice the can and reward them for trying to bite it. You can also reward your pup for carrying the can to you and releasing it. This will reinforce the desired behavior in your pup and make the whole process much easier for them.

Finally, you can open the refrigerator to give your pup access to the beers. Make sure you point to the beers and give the command for them to retrieve it. Reward him for touching, then biting, then holding, and then retrieving the can. You should also consider adding commands like "closed door" and "open the refrigerator" to the list. 

To get your pup even more comfortable with the process, you can open a door in your house and teach your dog to move to the correct side of the door. Praise your pup when he stands on his two hind legs and train him to fall forward hitting the door with his front legs. Then reward your pup when they close the door on command. 

Once your pup knows how to open the refrigerator, you want him to open it on command at a distance. To do this, point to the door and give the command, then reward your pup for touching, then pushing, and then closing the door. Finally, practice doing all three of these tasks in a sequence. When your pup completes the first two tasks with one command, reward them, and you'll know they've mastered the action. 

After that, all you have to do is sit back and relax as your pup happily brings you a cold beer right out of the frig. With a bit of patience and practice, you can train your pup to get you a beer in no time.

Writing college papers can be a daunting task for any student, but that doesn't mean it's impossible. With the right preparation and strategies, you can easily ace any college writing assignment. Before you begin writing your paper, it is important to take the time to create an outline of your points.

An outline will help you to organize your thoughts and serve as a step-by-step guide to crafting your paper. To create your outline, begin by jotting down all of the major points you want to discuss. From there, subdivide each point into smaller subsections and make sure to include any research you may already have. Once you have a skeleton for your paper, add in transitional phrases and evidence that will back up your points. This should result in an outline that will easily guide you through the writing process.

Once your outline is completed, you can tape it to the side of your monitor or desk and begin writing your paper. With your outline in front of you, you will always have guidance and don't need to be constantly flipping through your notes. Additionally, having your outline in front of you will help you craft a great transition between your paragraphs. For example, you can have the last sentence in one paragraph lead into the first sentence in the next one; giving your paper a coherent and organized flow.

When creating your outline, be sure to jot down any golden phrases or quotes you may want to use in your paper. Although some of this may be discovered as you write, having them written out already can make the writing process more efficient. Examples of these phrases may include, "lackluster ivories" (I'll Never Touch Those Ivories Again, by Jack Schultz) or "balding grumpy old semi-naturalist" (The Vast Cross-Generational Barrier: An Old Man's 'Final Frontier', by Jack Schultz).

Finally, an outline will help you construct a strong, coherent conclusion. Especially in college, having a strong conclusion is an important aspect of the paper and can often be the hardest to create. Having an outline will help you structure your paper in a way that leads to a strong conclusion. Additionally, having an outline already created can help you to solidify the thesis statement that you use in your paper, as having an outline of your ideas will make your topic much easier to narrow. 

All in all, creating an outline is an important step to success in any college-level writing assignments. An outline will give you guidance as you write, help you craft transitions between paragraphs, and lead to strong conclusions. Additionally, having an outline can help you jot down golden phrases and craft a thesis statement for your paper. By following this advice, you can be sure to ace any college writing assignment.

Putting on compression stockings can help reduce pain, swelling, and fatigue that often come with medical conditions such as varicose veins or diabetes. They can be used after surgery, while pregnant, and while exercising to improve blood flow and circulation. It's important to talk to your doctor to figure out which type of stocking is best for you. There are several steps to understanding and properly putting on compression stockings.

First, you will need to determine which pressure grade of stockings you need as determined by your doctor. You will also need to figure out the length of stocking you need. You should have your legs measured as compression stockings come in different lengths depending on your height.

You can purchase compression stockings at a medical equipment store or at a pharmacy. It is important to remember that compression stockings in one size may not fit in all sizes, so make sure to find the right size for your legs.

Once you have the right size and type of stockings, you can begin putting them on. It is important to do this first thing in the morning when your legs are the least swollen.

Start by sprinkling a bit of talcum powder on your legs. This will help prevent the stocking from sticking to your skin. You can use a sock aid if you have difficulty reaching your feet but if not, you can use your hands.

To put the stocking on, start by putting your hand into the stocking and grabbing the toe. Pull the top of the stocking off your arm and have the stocking in a tubular shape with the toe still attached. Sit on a chair or the side of the bed. If you have difficulty stretching the stocking, you can use latex or rubber gloves to help.

Next, put your toes in the stocking and bring the stocking up your leg. Make sure to adjust the sock as you draw it up your leg. You should repeat the process for the other leg.

When taking off compression stockings, make sure to do it at night. Pull down the top of the sock so it is just below the knee. If you have difficulty getting the stocking off, you can use a medical dressing stick or ask a trusted friend or family member to help.

Wash and care for your compression stockings after each use. This will help keep your stockings sanitary and in top condition. It is important to talk to your doctor if you experience any pain, swelling, or other complications.

In summary, putting on compression stocking is an important part of self-care to reduce pain and fatigue. Make sure you know the correct size and pressure grade for your legs and always wear them first thing in the morning. Once you are finished wearing them, make sure to take them off at night and wash them after each use. Talk to your doctor if you experience any pain or swelling while wearing them.

How to Make a Pettiskirt

Making a pettiskirt doesn’t have to be a difficult or expensive. With the right materials and tools you can make a cute and stylish pettiskirt for your child or for yourself. Here is how you can make a colorful and fluffy pettiskirt of your own. 

First, you will need to purchase the materials. For this project, you will need to get a ruffler foot for your sewing machine, three yards (2.7m) of nylon chiffon in the color of your choice, an additional 1.5 yards (1.3) of silk charmeuse for the waist band, a ribbon in the color of your choice, and elastic. 

Once you have all the materials, you will need to start prepping them. Cut your nylon chiffon into strips on a cutting mat. Cut your satin charmeuse lining fabric into a single rectangle and snip a ribbon into 2 18-inch (46cm) pieces. 

Measure your child’s waist and set your ruffler foot on your sewing machine. Layer your 2-inch (5cm) strips on top of your 4-inch (10.2cm) strips. Sew the strips together using the ruffler foot and then reset the gathering ratio when you have sewn your 2-inch (5cm) strips to your 4-inch (10.2cm) strips. This should create a ruffle look that will be used for one of the layers of the pettiskirt. 

You will need to repeat this step for all the layers of the skirt. Make sure you layer the ruffle you just made on top of the 6-inch (15.2cm) strip of nylon chiffon. Sew the strips together again and then remove the first layer of the skirt that includes the ruffles you just made with strips. Otherwise, this layer will get mixed up with the others. 

Repeat the steps to create two more layers of nylon chiffon ruffles using the remaining fabric. Stitch each of the layers into a tube separately by adjoining the entire width of the layer. Use a basting stitch to attach the 3 layers of chiffon ruffles together at the top. 

Now, you will need to make the waistband. Fold your piece of silk charmeuse along the length and pin it along the short side (7.5-inch/19cm). Sew a 2-inch (5cm) seam along the short side of the fabric and leave a 1.5-inch (3.8cm) opening in the short side for turning. Turn the waist band inside out through the hold and use an iron to press the waistband at the fold and create a rectangle waist band. Stitch a 1/2-inch (0.6cm) seam below the fold and turn your waist band inside out. 

Pin the three layers of chiffon to the bottom edge of the waistband and stitch the layers of chiffon and the waistband together in a loop. Before stitching the sides shut, you will need to feed the length of elastic and the satin ribbon through the top area of the waistband, between the two seams. Sew the ends of the elastic together and pull the ribbon until you have excess to tie a bow on both ends of the waist band. 

Your pettiskirt is now complete! With a little bit of patience and the right materials, you will now have a colorful and stylish pettiskirt to wear or to give away. Enjoy your new pettiskirt!

How to Weave Rope Seats
If you've ever wanted to craft your own seat from natural materials like rope, learning how to weave rope seats is a great place to start! With a few supplies from a local craft store, you can successfully create a unique and inviting chair that you can be proud to show off in your home. 

Let's get started by gathering the supplies you'll need for your project: rope, shuttles, spacers, and a crochet hook. Once you have everything you need, you're ready to start weaving that seat. 

First, tie the first half of your rope to one of the horizontal seat poles using a clove hitch. This is a basic knot that helps hold the rope in place. Lay the 1" spacer across the seat, perpendicular to your knot. This is important for keeping your rope in place and evenly spaced. 

Now wrap the rope around the whole width of the chair, then back to your starting point. Keeping the strings from overlapping, wrap the rope around everything four more times. After this, tie an individual wrap around the seat pole on one side of the chair, creating a spacer. Run the rope to the other side and wrap the first seat pole once to create a second spacer. Make sure to keep the strings close together, but don't let them cross over each other. 

Repeat the process of five horizontal wraps and one spacer until you have covered the whole chair. If you run out of rope before finishing, be sure to tie a new clove hitch right after creating a spacer and then add more rope. Use a crochet hook to weave any stray strands back into the weave. 

Once the chair is covered in the rope wrap, it's time to move on to the shuttles. Wrap the remainder of your rope onto the shuttles and you'll be ready to begin the weaving. Start by weaving in your large spacer, passing it over every other group of five strings. Now turn the seat upside-down and repeat the step above with your second spacer, lifting the other sets of five strings. 

Tie down the rope from the large shuttle to a seat pole with another clove hitch. Use the shuttle to slide under the lifted strings and wrap the rope around the width of the chair five times. Wrap up the seat poles after five rounds to create spacers and follow the same pattern of five wraps and one spacer as you continue along, sliding the shuttle underneath the lifted strings. Use the crochet hook to manually weave the final few strands – the weave is likely too tight at this point for the shuttles. 

Once your chair is finished, use scissors to clean up any loose threads, strands, and tails. Finally, tie off the rope by laying the end of the rope over the top of your pole (the edge of the seat), pulling the end under the pole, and then wrapping it back around. Cross the end of the rope over the standing line wrapped around the pole and tuck the end back under the pole as if double wrapping. And that’s all there is to it! Congratulations on successfully creating a unique, hand-crafted chair from rope.

Type 2 diabetes can have a significant impact on your health and lifestyle. It is important to take steps to avoid it or to manage it if you're already at risk. Understanding the connection between diet and diabetes is an essential part of the prevention or management of diabetes. Through making better food choices and adjusting your lifestyle habits, you can reduce your risk for diabetes. 

To prevent Type 2 diabetes or to manage it with dietary changes, you can start by eating more fruits and vegetables. Choose a variety of colors and try to have a minimum of five servings per day. Complex carbohydrates should also be a part of your daily eating plan. Additionally, limit the sugar you’re drinking. One of the leading sources of empty calories and excess sugar is drinking sugar-laden beverages such as sodas and “juice drinks” with limited juice content. 

In addition to sugar and refined carbohydrates, snacks like potato chips, cookies and candy should also be avoided. Instead, stock up on healthier snacks such as nuts, fruits, or carrots and hummus. Eat healthier fats such as olive oil, nut butter and avocado, but also remember to reserve treats for special occasions only. 

Rather than thinking of your eating habits as a “diet”, reframe them instead as lifestyle changes. Diets tend to fail because they are short term and have an end point. Obesity, a major risk factor for Type 2 diabetes, can be successfully addressed through lifestyle changes. 

It is important to focus on nighttime eating as well. Avoid late-night snacks and try to finish eating at least two hours prior to bedtime. Mid-evening snacking can also be addressed through other strategies such as reducing stress levels, getting plenty of sleep, and engaging in emotional eating avoidance. Eating slowly can also help to reduce overeating. 

In addition to dietary changes, consider talking to a Registered Dietitian and Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE) to get advice from a health professional. You can also prioritize exercise as a means of losing weight. Crucially, it is important to remember that exercise should be enjoyable. Go for a walk during your lunch break or after work, take your dog for a walk, and walk to your local shops instead of driving. Try to make it fun by listening to your favorite music. 

Above all, it is important to differentiate between the different types of diabetes. Know the differences between type 1 and type 2 diabetes, as well as the dangers of Type 2 Diabetes. In particular, be aware of risk factors for diabetes that are controllable such as obesity, lack of exercise, and unhealthy eating habits. Be aware of risk factors for diabetes that you can't control such as age, gender and family history. Taking prompt action to address controllable factors can reduce the risk of diabetes. Finally, make sure to return for testing if you think you may have Type 2 diabetes.

How to Develop an IT Change Management Program
Change management is essential for any organization that needs to program changes in order to keep up with evolving technologies and stay competitive in their industry. It is a process that helps ensure consistency, predictability, and visibility in system development and other related tasks. The IT Change Management Program (CMP) is a formalized approach to manage all upgrades, fixes, and other changes to IT systems in order to minimize any risk posed by the changes and maintain the performance of the systems. A CMP is developed in seven steps and this article will cover them in detail.

Step 1: Develop a Request for Change (RFC): This may originate from problem management, where an issue, or a series of related issues, is identified and a mitigating change is necessary to prevent (or minimize) future effects. The change request should document all the details of the change including stakeholders, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

Step 2: Obtain Business Change Acceptance: The decision to make a change is typically a business decision where costs vs. benefits are weighed. This approval is documented in the Change Request form.

Step 3: Initiate the Development Project: Development of the change (including testing) is an IT-guided function. A project charter should be developed to document roles, responsibilities and timelines.

Step 4: Pass the Change Management Gate: The Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews all changes before they can be put into production. The CAB should review all RFCs to determine the scope of the change, risks, supporting documentation and estimated date for implementation.

Step 5: Implement the Change: If the CAB does not approve the change, the reasons are listed (this is always because certain risks have not been mitigated or communications have not been planned) and the development team will be given time to fix those issues and reschedule a meeting before the CAB.

Step 6: Report the Results: Either the change was implemented successfully with no issues, the change was implemented with issues that were corrected during implementation, the change was implemented with issues that were deemed acceptable, issues arose that were unacceptable and the change was rolled back, or in the worst case the change was implemented with unacceptable issues and could not be rolled back.

Step 7: Link Problem Management to Changes: Issues that arise should be compared to the CAB documentation of changes so any unanticipated adverse effects of a change can be isolated. This will help the business make informed decisions about which changes should be prioritized and implemented.

Step 8: Periodically Audit the CMP: At least once each year an audit of the CMP should be conducted to assure that all change documentation is maintained and available. This will help verify that the CMP is effective and that all changes are properly documented and approved.

In conclusion, an effective CMP ensures that only well-planned, vetted and approved changes are implemented. This prevents any unplanned downtime, compromises to security or quality of service, and ensures that changes pass through an organized structure with a designated approval authority. An IT Change Management Program is an essential element of any organization’s IT infrastructure.

How to Be Friends with People from Other Social Groups
Having friends from diverse social groups can be beneficial and enriching. It can provide us with insight and understanding that we don't normally get from spending time with just our own group of friends. Here are some ways to build friendships with people from different social groups.

First and foremost, be willing to be personable and friendly to everyone. Trying to build a friendship with someone of a different social group begins with a willingness on your part to reach out and be accepting of all people, no matter what their background or interests are. Being kind and friendly to everyone is the first step towards being able to develop a strong relationship with just someone.

Realize that the way someone dresses, the music they like or the people they hang out with does not define who they are as a person. Many people have the tendency to make automatic assumptions about a person based on the way they present themselves. This can limit you from forming strong relationships with people since you might be judging them by their exterior trappings instead of getting to know them on a deeper level.

Try and look for things that you have in common with people from other social groups. It is likely that you share other interests outside of your respective social groups. Find those things you both like - music, books, movies, etc. - and utilize those as bridges to becoming friends.

When you do meet someone from another social group, try to engage in conversations with them about things that are mutually interesting. This is the best way to get to a point where you can start to share interests and develop a mutual understanding and appreciation of each other.

It is important to understand that you may never be best friends with someone from another social group, but that you can certainly build a strong friendship on the basis of common interests. It's important to remember that, though it might take some effort on your part to break through the prejudices that you may have, it is possible to reach out and make a meaningful connection with someone who is different from you.

Spending time talking away from the context of your respective social groups, when possible, can be one of the best ways to spark and nurture a friendship. Seeing someone of a different social group in a different environment, free from any preconceived notions, can make it much easier to develop a connection.

Take advantage of modern technology and exchange emails, chat messages or Skype calls with the person from the other social group. Don't expect to jump into the other person's social clique or feel like they are a part of yours overnight, but getting in contact and staying in contact is key to locking down a meaningful relationship.

When it comes to sharing your taste in music or the TV shows you watch, it's important to not expect to convert the other person or have them conform to your taste. Don't be afraid of making suggestions but also don't try to force them to change what they like or who they are.

Remember to be respectful of the differences between yourself and the other person. Being a friend does not mean that you have to change your values or beliefs. An important part of building a strong friendship is being able to respect the other person's beliefs and values, regardless if they're different from yours.

Resist the urge to make a statement or act in a way that would make the other person uncomfortable or embarrassed. Many people will be looking for the slightest opportunity to judge you and make assumptions, so it is important to be mindful of the things you are saying or doing. Also be conscious of body language, as that can have a very big effect on your friendship.

Don't ignore people when they ask questions about why you have chosen such a diverse group of friends. People will naturally be curious and will want to learn more about why you choose to be friends with people from different social groups. Answering these questions will demonstrate maturity and open-mindedness.

Overall, it's important to relax and go with the flow of the friendship. Don't force the issue if the other person is not ready to talk or become friends with you. Don't be too serious about trying to create a perfect friendship, as it can lead to disappointment and an unsuccessful attempt at making a connection.

It is important to understand that on occasion, the social boundaries between you and the other person may be tested. Understand that the relationship you are building will grow and develop with the friendship. Additionally, you and the other person may eventually drift closer or further apart depending on the circumstances in the other person's life.

Keep in mind that assumptions can ruin any potential friendship you are trying to build. While it is easy to make assumptions about someone based on their social group, those assumptions can be wrong and can easily get in the way of building a strong relationship. Instead, try to get to know the person as an individual before forming any beliefs.

Learning how to fold and care for a topo map is a simple process that doesn't require any special supplies. Taking the time to learn the correct method of folding and storing a topo map will help ensure it doesn't become wrinkled and torn over time.

First, select a clear, zip-close plastic bag for storing your map. It is important that the bag will fit the size of the map snugly and that it is able to be securely closed.

Next, lay the map face down on a table or other flat surface. Make sure there is nothing on the surface to create any bumps or wrinkles on the map as you fold it.

Begin by folding the top edge of the map down to meet the bottom edge. Then, lay the plastic bag flat on the folded map, making sure one edge is flush with the folded edge of the map. Move the plastic bag so that its edge extends a half-inch past the folded edge of the map. Now, hold the plastic bag in place with one hand, while using the other hand to fold the top layer of the map up, creasing it along the near edge of the bag. Once the bag is in place, extract it from inside the fold and lay it on top of the new fold, once again overlapping the uppermost fold by a half-inch.

Fold the top layer of the map down toward you again, creasing at the far edge of the plastic bag. This is the most important step in folding and caring for your topo map since if done incorrectly, it could tear or crack the delicate paper. Afterward, extract the plastic bag and set it aside.

Then, fold the uppermost layer of the map up, creasing in line with the crease of the layer directly below. Once done, keep folding the uppermost layer of the map back and forth until it’s completely accordion folded. Then, turn the map over and repeat the accordion-fold process on the other side, using the plastic bag as a guide.

Once the map is completely folded, you can use the plastic bag to store it safely. Just slide the folded map into the bag and make sure it's zipped securely. Doing this will help keep the map protected from moisture and other elements that could degrade it.

When you’re ready to use the topo map again, just unfold it carefully. As you unfold the map, make sure each layer is smoothed out before unfolding the next layer.

By following these steps, you can easily fold and care for your topo map so that it will remain in top condition for years to come.

How to Protect Yourself when Shopping on Internet Auctions
Shopping on online Auction sites can be convenient and enjoyable. But it pays to know some key tips on how to protect yourself when doing so. Taking the time to follow a few simple steps can save you from buying the wrong item, wasting money, or even running into a fraudster. 

Before you begin bidding, make sure you understand as much as possible about how the particular auction site works and what your commitments and responsibilities as a buyer are. Find out what kinds of fees will be charged and how long you have before payments are due. In the same vein, know what obligations the sellers have before you bid – must they abide by website policy or do they also have the authority to create their own “shop policies” (a la Etsy)?

Pay particular attention to the method of payment the seller is asking for and know the policies of the website regarding problems or issues that can arise with transactions. Good auction sites will have detailed explanations displayed prominently that you should take the time to read. Is the seller asking for wire transfer? Pay close attention. In some cases, wire transfer may be the only payment method, though it is usually safest to use a credit card in the event of any mishap.

To ensure you know exactly what you’re bidding on, thoroughly read item descriptions posted by sellers and look carefully at any pictures posted. While many of the more established online auction sites have restrictions in place on fake or counterfeit items, it’s still important to not take any chances when it comes to making a purchase. Also make sure to double check any size or weight specifications to make sure what you’re getting is indeed what you want. 

Does the seller have a return or exchange policy? Knowing the policies related to returns and exchanges should be taken into consideration before you make a bid. Some websites will have explicit policies that make it difficult, if not impossible, for buyers to get refunds, make exchanges, or receive warranty coverage. Some retailers may set their own shop policies, so make sure to clarify before you lay down any cash. 

Finally, do a few background checks. Double-check the seller’s information; is the phone number and email address they provided in working order? A quick Google search of their name or business can give you the information you need. Do some price checking online with comparable items to see if you are getting a good deal. And never provide personal information such as bank account numbers or your social security number.

Above all, remain vigilant when seeking out deals and always question suspiciously low prices or deals that seem too good to be true. Taking some proactive steps in advance can help protect you from fraud, mistakes, and getting taken for a ride. Follow these tips and you’ll be on your way to making safe and savvy purchases online.

Making it on an all star cheerleading team is no easy feat, and it requires a lot of hard work and dedication. It takes a great deal of physical and mental strength and flexibility, and it's not for the faint of heart. However, if you have the drive and ambition, there's no reason why you can't fulfill your dream of becoming an all star cheerleader. Here's how to be on an all star cheer team:

1. Get your parents permission and support. This is the first and most important step. Your parents need to be supportive of your decision to pursue cheerleading, and make sure you have their full support before you get started.

2. Start acting like a cheerleader, even before you make the team. Start researching which competitions and teams you'd like to join. Watch cheer competitions, research proper cheerleading techniques, and start learning the basics.

3. Research good cheerleading teams in your area. Look for teams with strong reputations, excellent coaching, and competitive plans.

4. Decide what you're going to be. Cheerleaders can be split up into four main categories; basket tosser, flyer, base, and back spot. Each has a different responsibility, so make sure you decide what category you want to specialize in.

5. Motivate yourself and stay focused on your goal. Cheerleading can be tough and competitive, and you need to stay focused and driven. Set yourself realistic goals and work towards achieving them.

6. Improve your strength and flexibility. This will help you on the mat, and will be necessary to be able to do stunts and tumbling. Work with a coach to ensure that you have the right form and technique.

7. Get fit and exercise. You will need to have strong muscular strength and endurance to be able to do all of the stunts and tumbling. Work with a coach to ensure that you have the right fitness routine.

8. Take a preparation class before you join. Many gyms offer classes specifically for preparing for all star teams. This can be a great way to learn the basics and get familiar with the cheerleading environment.

9. Learn the basic motions: High V, Low V, T, Broken T, etc. These are the basic motions that you will need in order to perform cheerleading stunts.

10. Learn cheerleading jumps. You'll need to master the toe touch and herkie jump in order to have a competitive edge.

11. Learn how to dance. You will need to learn the basics of dance in order to look good in competition.

12. Learn roundoffs, back handsprings and handstands. Learning tumbling is one of the most important skills for any cheerleader, and there is a great deal of technique involved. Make sure you take a class or get a coach to help you with this.

13. Learn how to fall safely. Falls are inevitable in cheerleading, and you need to learn how to fall safely. This will help you stay safe during stunts and on the floor.

14. Face your fears. Cheerleading can be intimidating, so it is important to face your fears instead of avoiding them. It's normal to be scared, but facing your fears is the only way to become a stronger athlete.

15. Learn facials. Your facial expressions are just as important in competition as your stunts and tumbling. Learn the proper expressions and techniques to be successful.

16. Sign up. After you’ve gotten all the basics down, sign up for the competition to start your journey.

17. Try out with confidence. Make sure you are confident and try your best. Don't let mistakes stand in the way, as you can learn from them.

18. Once you've made the team, try talking to your teammates and making friends with them. Being able to work as a team is an important part of cheerleading and if you get to know one another, it will make it easier.

19. Have a light snack before each practice. Eating before practice will provide you with energy and help you stay alert.

20. Keep practicing at home and working out every day, even if you're already really good and have hard tumbling skills down. Being the best takes dedication and practice, so don't get complacent.

21. Keep in mind that it takes years to be a really good tumbler. Don't be discouraged if it takes time to get your skills perfect.

Finally, be confident, smile, believe in yourself, and be happy! Having a positive attitude will help you achieve your goals. Good luck!

How to Conduct Yourself Professionally on a Movie Junket

Attending a movie junket for the first time can be an intimidating and exciting experience all at the same time. It's a great opportunity to network with industry insiders and potentially use an event for career advancement, but you always want to conduct yourself in a professional manner at all times. Here are some tips to make sure you make the best out of your movie junket and don't accidentally embarrass yourself.

Save your receipt to and from the airport as a reimbursement expense. Most events (depending on the size and budget) will cover your travel expenses and should reimburse you if you turn in the proper paperwork. Make sure to double check this with the event organizers before you arrive, and keep your receipts and paperwork in a safe place.

Check into your hotel by giving them your credit card to hold against the room. Make sure to alert the hotel staff that you are attending a movie junket, confirm what time your event starts and ends, and ask for special requests. The staff may be able to provide you with free breakfast or additional amenities that will help you better prepare for the busy days ahead.

Find the location of the hospitality suite before heading up to your room. Most times the suite will provide coffee, snacks, and light meals throughout the day. Ask around or check the event handout to see when the suite hours will be and make sure to grab a few things to keep you going through the long days ahead.

Inquire about the event's phone policy. Some events will not allow phones in the hospitality suite or in the interview room. Some will kindly ask you to turn your device off for the duration of the event, and ask that you keep all pictures, audio recordings, and other content to yourself.

Confirm the per diem amount and what it covers. A per diem is the allowance for travel expenses that is often paid in advance or reimbursement. Check with the event organizers or the PR company to confirm the per diem amount and what will be covered such as transportation, meals, and hotel fees.

Have your interview questions ready and reviewed the night before. This will ensure that you have a clear idea of how your interview should go, and allow you to be flexible with your answers and questioning in the moment.

Dress comfortably because you will be in for long days. Since you will be spending most of your time on your feet, it's important to wear comfortable shoes and clothing that will also protect you from the weather. It's best to dress professionally, but stay away from overly flashy ensembles or clothing that may not be suitable for the event.

Attend all interviews on time. Try to arrive at interviews fifteen minutes early to give yourself enough time to greet the interviewer and settle in. Being late is a huge no-no and will give off a bad impression of unprofessionalism.

Follow all studio attendant and/or publicist instructions to ensure that you don't offend anyone and that you get asked back the next time. The studio attendants might not be able to answer questions but they usually know exactly what needs to be done in the interviews or the event itself. Ask if there's anything else you need to do before leaving the room and be sure to thank them for their time.

Be respectful of the time of the celebrities by asking interesting questions that pertain to the movie, not their personal lives, which may be a taboo subject for them to talk about and may lead you to getting kicked out of the event. Celebrities have a limited amount of time that they have to do interviews, so try to ask well thought out questions and don't dote on small talk as it will be a waste of their time and everyone else's.

Speak to publicists while you are waiting in order to build a good working relationship with them to ideally get asked back next time. While you may be tempted to hang out with other attending media outlets, it's best to not engage with them too much during the event. Instead, spend some time getting to know the event's publicists and have a conversation with them to build a rapport.

Refrain from public intoxication and poor behavior by limiting the amount of alcohol that you consume on the junket. It's ok to have a drink or two in the evening after all of the events are over, but do not indulge too much and get sloppy or intoxicated in public. This will lead to embarrassing moments and an incredibly bad reputation that could ruin your career.

Thank the organizers for their time when you prepare to leave. Before departing, take a few minutes to thank the event organizers and publicists (who were probably working around the clock to make sure everything runs as planned). A simple thank you goes a long way and will make a great impression of professionalism that may come in handy if you plan to attend future media events.

Making a custom bookmark for a baby shower can be a creative way to commemorate a special occasion. Bookmarks can easily be decorated with a photo, a fabric scrap, commemorative text, and be laminated for protection. With a few basic supplies, you can create an eye-catching bookmark to display at the baby shower.

To start, open a blank Word document, choose “Insert>Table” from the Table menu. Select a width of 3 columns and a height of 2 rows. Go to the Table menu and select “Table Properties.” Click the row tab and set the height of the row to 2”. Place your cursor on the second row of the table that you’ve created in your document and click inside the top left cell of the table. Resize the picture you want to display into the cell. Copy the cell onto the other empty cells in the row and add your text to the second row.

Print out the bookmarks onto cardstock. Decide on the dimensions of your bookmark. Cut out a piece of cardstock that is wider and longer than your final bookmark will be. Brush on some rubber cement on the front of the cardstock and then glue a fabric scrap to the cardstock. Turn the cardstock over and brush the other side with rubber cement and glue a second piece of fabric. Use a ruler, a set square, and a pencil to mark out the dimensions of the bookmark on top of the fabric. Then cut out the bookmark using sharp scissors or a rotary cutter.

Cut out the commemorative text that you made using scissors or a paper cutter. Place rubber cement on the back of the text strip and attach it to the front of the fabric. Turn on your laminating machine and place the bookmark between two sheets of laminating film. Push the film through the rollers on the laminating machine and when it exits, cut around the bookmark to separate it from the laminating film. Place the bookmark on the top of an ironing board with the vinyl heat-and-bond material side down. Place a sheet of protective paper or a piece of fabric over the bookmark and the vinyl. Press the paper or fabric with an iron for a few seconds to bond the vinyl into place. Repeat the process with the other side of the bookmark.

Once the bookmark is complete, it can be used to decorate tables at the baby shower or be wrapped up as a party favor. This creative bookmark will remind guests of the special day for years to come.

Knowing how to feed a starving horse is vital to ensure the animal's health and well-being. Start by identifying if the horse is actually starving or just malnourished. Signs of starvation include an abnormally thin appearance, ribby or concave abdomen, poor attitude, and failure to gain weight even with increased feedings. Once you determine that the horse is starving, it is important to give the horse some water, preferably electrolyte water if available. After giving your horse some water, you should let the horse rest in a safe and secure place for a few hours in order to allow them time to adjust to its new surroundings.

After the horse has started drinking for a few hours, you can begin feeding it. Start with an initial feeding of about a quarter pound of grass hay three times on the first day. Then, over the next few days, increase the hay to half a pound three times a day. Gradually increase the hay to about one and a half pounds of hay per feeding over the span of four to five days. During this time, you should also add about a half to three quarters of a pound of alfalfa to the diet. After four to five days, you can begin to let your horse out to graze in clean, mowed grass for about thirty minutes a day.

Once your horse gets used to the increased hay and alfalfa, you can start exercising them lightly. Start with about four pounds of grass hay and one pound of alfalfa twice a day, raise it to five and a half pounds and 1.5lbs of alfalfa accompanied with four pounds of grass hay once a day. Then, increase the hay to seven pounds of alfalfa twice a day and four pounds of grass hay once a day. Keep the seven pounds of alfalfa and four pounds of grass hay for around a week. Increase the hay to eight to nine pounds twice a day and then eventually seven to ten pounds of alfalfa two times a day. Make sure your horse is getting enough exercise to accompany the increased hay with gradual changes in the hay over about two to three weeks. With the correct knowledge and adequate steps, you can successfully help your horse recover from starvation.

How to Cut a Faux Hawk
With its buzz cut on the sides and a voluminous look on top, the faux hawk (or FauxHawk) can be a great way to show off both a daring side and a clean, neat edge. The best part is that it requires minimal upkeep. Whether you’re defining an existing faux hawk, or creating a brand new one, this article will provide you with all of the steps to cutting a faux hawk. 

First and foremost, it’s important to get the hair as clean and tangle-free as possible. Get the hair wet, comb it out to remove knots or tangles, and then dry your hair. If your hair is freshly washed, make sure that it is completely dry. You’re now ready to style!

Decide on the width of faux hawk you want; this will determine the length of the side portions. Draw a mental line across the top of the ears that will separate the mid and side sections.

Divide the hair into three equal sections - one from the front to the back of the crown (known as the mid section), and two that will form the sides. Use clips to secure the center section up. 

Depending on the density of your hair and the width of the FauxHawk you want, there are two possible techniques to cut the side sections: layer cutting or block cutting. Layer cutting is cutting into the hair in alternating layers to create a tapered look. Block cutting means cutting the hair in one length from top to bottom. 

It’s important to consider the risks of cutting your own hair - practising caution and having a good idea of what you want your new style to look like is essential. Make sure you understand the direction to cut in; against the grain when removing length, and with the grain for thinning and blending. Also be aware of the best hand and tool positioning for each step. 

Begin by cutting the sides with your chosen technique. Once you’re finished one side, move on to the other. When you’re done, clean up any sideburns or around the ears. Unclip the center back section and cut the lower back.

For the center top section, start by deciding which guard and which technique to use. You can use a #4 guard and draw a line from the bottom hairline to the top of the back and sides, or you can use the #3 or #4 guard and cut the hair in sections from the bottom to the top. The same process should be repeated for the #2 and #1 guards. Remember to over-direct each strip as you cut. 

When you just go have the Mohawk portion, it’s time to blend the hair for a smooth, professional look. You can texturize the top using a mousse or moisturizing cream then massage it in with your fingers. Thin out the top with a razor or thinning scissors if you want a choppy effect. You can also texturize the sides and back with a texturizing product too, if desired. 

Voila! Your Faux Hawk is officially finished. With minimal cost or expertise, you’ve just created a stylish and unique look that is guaranteed to turn heads. Enjoy your new style!

Teaching an autistic college student may come with its own unique set of challenges, but successful teaching methods can be adopted to provide effective instruction. By understanding certain aspects of autism, you can adjust your teaching style and environment to best accommodate your student. 

Perhaps the most important thing to remember when teaching an autistic college student is to forget everything you thought you knew about autism. The disorder manifests differently for each individual; thus, it is important for you to become as familiar as possible with your student’s particular needs. 

One important need you should recognize is that autistic listening body language is often different from the body language of a neurotypical listener. Your student may not be able to follow and answer relatively fast-paced dialogue, and the physical cues you are used to may not register for him or her. Be sure to speak slowly and take breaks for the student to process what you said. 

Expect stimming, which is the term used to describe various repetitive physical movements and behaviors such as hand flapping, rocking, and twirling objects. These behaviors are often used by people with autism to concentrate and self-regulate. 

Also, be aware that they may be sensitive to certain sounds or touch and that they may speak a little differently than you are used to. The student may be non-verbal, partially-verbal, or use echolalia, meaning they repeat a phrase uttered by someone else. 

Many times, students with autism can suffer from co-occurring conditions. Most commonly, these are conditions such as attention deficit disorder (ADD) and/or anxiety. It is important to be aware of these potential diagnoses, as they can create learning challenges. 

When it comes to expectations, it is essential to make them as clear as possible. If possible, provide written instructions both in class and online. Be sure to speak in simple, concrete language and answer any and all questions that arise. 

To make sure that important directions are clear to the autistic student, break large assignments into smaller, simpler tasks with individual due dates. Additionally, set up a class website with any additional information or resources they may need. It would also be beneficial to go over directions and any relevant topics in class and provide time for questions. Posting any power points or notes online makes them easily accessible in the event of an absence. 

On the first day of class, it is a good idea to reach out to any disabled students and encourage them to meet with you, or even just communicate via email. Let them sit where they please, as sensory issues can be impacted by where they are seated. Consider alternative seating for especially fidgety students, such as adjustable desks or bean bags. 

Reward timely submission of assignments, but do not put the student on the spot if they are late. Provide plenty of warning for upcoming due dates and changes in the routine. If you grade on class participation, try not to rely on verbal participation only; take into account written responses your student may provide. 

Keep in contact with the college’s disability services center, as they may be able to provide more specific information about your student’s needs. Additionally, they can provide any tools or materials that your student may need. If you assign group work, keep the group size small, and encourage them to work alone if the task allows it. 

Try to keep things from becoming too loud; it can be very difficult for an autistic student to focus. Pay attention to the autistic person’s group, and if things are not going too well, intervene. Check up on the division of labor among groups so that your student is not taken advantage of. Teach the autistic student how to handle recurring problems, such as peer disagreements, and provide alternative solutions when possible. 

Be sure to watch out for the signs of stress; they may include decreased eye contact, lack of motivation, or difficulty focusing. Quietly check up on them, just like you would with any other student, as autistic students may sometimes “fly below the radar.” Finally, be compassionate about any problems that may arise, and take them aside to discuss it in a comfortable atmosphere. 

By follow the tips outlined in this article, you will be able to teach your autistic college student in a comfortable and effective way. Autistic students can learn just like anyone else; it simply requires some adjustments and understanding.

Making a quillow - a combination quilt and pillow - is a great way to add an element of surprise and fun to a room. It can be a small pillow or a larger one, it can be for a child's room or an adult's bedroom, and it can be made from a variety of fabrics and patterns to match any décor. It's a snap to make, and with a little bit of supplies and some basic sewing knowledge, you can make a quillow that's perfect for you! 

To start, you'll need to select your fabric. Choose something that is lightweight and won't be too bulky when folded into a pillow shape. Cotton fabrics are a great choice, as are muslins, cottons, flannel, and denim. The fabric should be similar in weight to batting or stuffing. Pick out a pattern that goes well with the room's existing décor - anything from a classic floral pattern, to a modern geometric design, to something fun and whimsical - and pick out a thread to match. 

Next you'll want to cut your fabric. Measure it out to a size that you like. The wider the quillow, the larger the pillow will be when it's unfold, so pick a size that's comfortable for you. Then cut out two pieces of fabric, making sure the pieces are identical. Make a separate cut for batting, using the same measurements you used for the fabric. 

Pin the three layers together - one piece of fabric on top of the other, with the right sides touching each other, with the batting on top - using straight pins. Stitch the three pieces together with a 1⁄2 inch (1.3 cm) seam, making sure to leave a 12 inch (30.5 cm) opening so that the project can be turned right-side out. Remove the pins. 

Turn the blanket right-side out through the 12 inch hole. Press with an iron and tuck in the edges so that the seam looks neat. Sew a 1/4 inch seam around all four edges of the quillow, closing the 12 inch opening.

For the pillow part, take the 1⁄2 yard (0.5 cm) fabric and fold it in half, right sides facing each other. Stitch the long edges of the rectangle together with a 1⁄2 inch (1.3 cm) seam. Turn the pillow through the open side and press with an iron. Then sew a 1/4 inch seam to close the opening, but only on one side - do not stitch the way around the pocket.

Now to put it all together. Lay the larger, main blanket on a flat surface and lay the pillow pocket at the top center of the blanket. Sew the three outer edges of the pillow pocket to the blanket using a 1⁄4 inch (0.6 cm) seam. Place the blanket on the floor, pocket side down, and fold the outer edges of the blanket to the opposite edges of the pocket. Then fold the blanket up from the bottom, into three sections, until it matches the dimensions of the pillow pocket. Flip the pocket over and tuck in the edges. Smooth everything out and fluff the pillow. When you're ready to convert back to a blanket, just flip and unfold! With a few simple steps, you've made a quillow that's just as useful as it is cute.

Telling whether your boyfriend or girlfriend is cheating can be a signifiant challenge. It requires taking time to observe changes in behavior, trust, communication, and even their physical presence. You also need to know what to look out for to avoid making assumptions. The following tips and advice will help you tell if your significant other is being unfaithful.

Pay attention to changes in the normal routine of your boyfriend or girlfriend. Pay close attention if there have been changes in their routine and behavior that you weren't expecting. Did they start spending a lot more time out of the house or on the phone? Have they started coming home later than usual? It could be an indication of a problem.

Decide if you feel they have suddenly become moody and eager to start fights. Is your partner constantly angry? Are they picking fights with you or becoming easily irritated? What was different about how they acted before and how they are now? This could be a sign of guilt or turmoil, and a feeling of wanting to ease your suspicions.

Think about whether your boyfriend or girlfriend has stopped talking to you. Don't limit conversation to words, because body language speaks volumes. Pay attention to subtle changes they have made and try to pinpoint the actual moment it changed. Ask yourself questions like: do they really seem to be listening or are they zoning out? Are they more guarded?

Consider whether your boyfriend or girlfriend smells different when he or she comes near you. Your partner has an inherent smell, and with a cheating partner, it could be an indication of someone else's scent on them. This isn't necessarily an absolute sure sign of infidelity, as the unfamiliar smell could be from a new perfume or cologne they are using, or it could even be a sign of their change in career or work.

Pay attention to changing interests. Ask yourself if you are noticing any changes in their interests in music, political views, social issues, favorite books, movies, or other hobbies. Or maybe they have stopped participating in activities they once enjoyed with you. Ask yourself why there are these sudden changes, and what could this mean?

Examine the trust in your relationship. Are you having any doubts and worries ? Has there been a decrease in trust? Do they open up and talk to you the way they used to? Is there an increased level of confusion and an attempt to hide the truth? Also watch out for the amount of time they spend with other people.

Notice if they leave the room to take calls. Do they leave the room whenever they receive or make a phone call? Do you hear raised voices when they return? Again, these are indicators of possibly something more serious.

Watch carefully for unwillingness to accept you without notice. Do you feel that your partner is avoiding you? Does your partner have to "clean up" before letting you into their house, room, car, or even their emails? These can all be indicators of unfaithfulness.

Pay attention to whether he has to take calls or messages from someone else when you are together. This is a common sign of an extramarital relationship. If you feel like your partner is deliberately avoiding contact with you or only keeps you in the dark about certain issues, this could be a sign of dishonesty.

Notice if a boyfriend or girlfriend is constantly putting someone else down. Is your partner demeaning you, or speaking down to you? If your partner is constantly talking badly about a third party or expressing a lot of anger, this could be a sign of infidelity.

Catch them in a lie. If your partner is telling lies or having difficulties answering your questions, they may be trying to protect the truth.

Watch for unexplained bills, receipts for meals, etc. Checks and bank statements should be checked to make sure everything looks as it should. If there are unexplained expenses, it might be worth looking into.

Find out whether your boyfriend or girlfriend has additional email accounts or other online accounts. This is an obvious sign of a cheat. Online activity leaves a digital trail, and can offer information that seems suspicious.

Notice whether their friends are acting differently towards you. If you notice that their friends seem to be withdrawing from your relationship, or they act differently around you, it could be because they know something that you don't.

Notice whether he begins to buy you gifts out of nowhere, or she starts casually mentioning an end to your relationship. If your partner is doing this, it could be their way of starting to detach from you, or of making up for something they feel guilty about.

Listen to how your boyfriend or girlfriend explains his or her behavior. Ask detailed questions, and notice the tone of their responses. Listen carefully to the words they use, and watch for signs of avoidance and deflection.

Notice the response. After a few moments of silence and once the story has finished, recall one of the details that stuck out to you. See if your partner can respond with an explanation that makes sense.

Pay attention to what happens now. Your partner might become defensive, or try to find a way out through a distraction or change of topic. They could become agitated, or start to give explanations that don't add up.

Do it again with another detail oriented question. This will help you see if the pattern continues.

Expect to be questioned back. If your partner starts digging around to see how much you know or what kind of information you have come across, this should raise alarms.

Wait patiently. It's possible your partner will counter your questions with their own, a sign they're uncomfortable and trying to shift the focus.

Ask yourself, did you insinuate that they were hiding something? If your partner has never given much explanation, or turns defensive when you ask any questions, you should take a step back and reflect. If the situation isn't resolved after introspection and honest conversations, it might be time to reach out to a professional counselor or therapist to help you resolve whatever doubts you have.

Creating a perfect cheesecake is an art form and requires skill, patience, and creativity! With careful preparation and tasty ingredients, you can learn to make a delicious cheesecake in no time. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to make a classic cheesecake and then some variations on the recipe. 

First, it’s best to preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (180 degrees Celsius). Prepare the crust by crushing about 1 1/2 cups of graham crackers until they’re coarsely crushed. Then mix in some melted butter, 1/3 cup of sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Use a food processor or a mesh strainer to get the desired consistency. Line a 9-inch springform pan with the graham cracker mixture then pack it down evenly and into the corners. Bake the crust for about 10 minutes until it’s slightly browned.

Next, reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit (160 degrees Celsius). In a stand mixer, beat 2 packages of cream cheese until creamy. Add in 3/4 cup of sugar, a pinch of salt, 1 teaspoon of vanilla, and then 2 eggs one at a time. Once combined, slowly add 1/2 cup of sour cream and 1/2 cup of heavy cream. Then pour the cheesecake filling into the pre-prepared springform pan and place it in a baking dish. Fill the baking dish halfway with water - this will help to evenly bake the cheesecake. Bake the cheesecake for 1 1/2 hours. Keep the oven door slightly ajar during the last 15 minutes of baking for extra ventilation.

When the cheesecake is done baking, turn off the oven and let the cheesecake cool for 1 hour. Then, place it in the refrigerator for another 4 hours. This will set the cheesecake and will help prevent it from cracking. Top it with a creamy and flavorful homemade cream cheese frosting. 

Now that you have a classic cheesecake, here are some variations to try. To make mini cheesecakes, use a muffin tin and pre-make crusts that will fit in the cups. Bake for about 20 minutes. For a chocolate cheesecake, exchange some of the regular sugar with unsweetened cocoa powder. To make a caramel cheesecake, melt 1/2 cup of sugar in a pan and slowly add cream. Top the cheesecake with the caramel sauce. For a fancy and yet simple raspberry swirl cheesecake, mix four parts pureed raspberries with one part brown sugar and add it to the Cheesecake filling just before baking. For a delicious candy bar cheesecake, place small pieces of your favorite candy bar on top of the cheesecake batter and bake for the usual time. 

For a vegan cheesecake, replace the cream cheese with tofu and replace the eggs with a dairy-free substitute. For those looking for a unique taste, try making a goat cheese cheesecake. To do this, replace the cream cheese with a high-quality goat cheese and increase the amount of sugar by 1/2 a cup.

Whether simple or extravagant, making a cheesecake is sure to make a statement in any setting. Yet, with these variations of a classic cheesecake, you can celebrate the sweetness of the moment! Enjoy all the creations and celebrate with style with a seasonal cheesecake!

Have you ever wanted to understand how a bill becomes a law? The journey from an idea to a law is a complex process, one that is lengthy and occasionally frustrating. While it may not be the simplest of processes, understanding the steps can help you understand why some bills become laws and some do not. 

First, it is important to learn a little bit of history. The United States Constitution divides lawmaking power into three sections: congress, the executive branch, and the federal courts. The U.S. Congress is broken up into two houses - the House of Representatives and the Senate. It is responsible for making laws that apply to every citizen. The executive branch is composed of the President, Vice President, and the Cabinet members, and it executes the laws created by Congress. Lastly, the federal court system interprets and judges the law based on the Constitution.

A bill starts with a representative in either the House of Representatives or the Senate. The representative who introduces the bill may hire someone to speak on their behalf in the House of Representatives. After that, the bill is heard in a committee. During the hearing, the committee listens to experts and considers public opinion about the bill. 

Once the bill has been heard in the committee, it is sent to both Houses of Congress for additional consideration. At this point, the bill can no longer be changed. It is then reviewed and discussed by members of both the House and the Senate. Because the two chambers of Congress may not agree on the contents of the bill, a compromise version of the bill is created. 

The compromise version of the bill then returns to the committee to vote on the bill. If the bill is approved, it is sent back to both chambers of Congress for a final vote. If a majority of members of both chambers agree on the bill, it is then sent to the Governor for approval.

It is important to know that the Governor has the right to veto a bill if he or she does not agree with it. If the Governor sends the bill back, or "vetoes" it, the two chambers of Congress can vote on the bill again. If approved, the law is then in effect. 

Understanding how a bill becomes a law gives you a greater appreciation for the process and the people involved in making a law. It also brings greater awareness to the laws that you are living under and their effects on your life and the lives of those around you.

Obtaining a prenuptial agreement is an important step for many couples planning to get married. A prenuptial agreement, also known as a premarital agreement, is a contract that defines how assets will be allocated during the marriage and in the event of a divorce. It serves to protect the assets and liabilities of each partner, and it can also ensure that each will be treated fairly in the case of a divorce. 

Both partners should understand the implications of a prenuptial agreement before signing it. It is especially important to consider obtaining a prenuptial agreement if either partner currently has a higher net worth than the other, or if either partner has children from a previous marriage. Furthermore, if one partner will be bringing a business into the marriage, or the couple will be inheriting one, a prenuptial agreement can help in defining rights and responsibilities of each partner.

It is vital to hire an attorney when creating a prenuptial agreement. This not only ensures that all legal requirements are being met, but also that the agreement is properly represented in court, in the event that either partner wishes to contest the agreement. Communicating openly and honestly with your partner is also essential in this process.

In establishing the prenuptial agreement, both partners should list out all of their assets, such as bank accounts, insurance policies, stocks, and real estate, as well as any documents that refer to them. Liabilities should also be noted, such as loans, credit cards, and mortgages. In addition, both partners should list their existing debts, as well as their respective future incomes and earnings. Matching state laws should also be kept in mind when constructing a prenuptial agreement. 

In defining which property will be kept separate and which will be shared, be as specific as possible. Include any restrictions, if any, on how property should be used. Also, detail which debts are the responsibility of each partner. In the event of a divorce, the agreement should include language defining how wealth, debts, and assets will be allocated. It should also address issues such as what to do with financial support, taxes, and the marital home.

It is important to make sure that both partners agree on every detail within the prenuptial agreement and that it is fair. Also, ensure that the agreement leaves the marriage open to the possibility of changes in the future. Finally, make sure that both parties: read, understand, and agree to the prenuptial agreement before it is officially drafted and both sign it. 
 
Signing a prenuptial agreement before getting married is a critical financial step for many couples. In the case of a divorce, a prenuptial agreement can ensure that both partners are treated fairly. To obtain a prenuptial agreement, partners should consider state laws, make a list of assets, debts, incomes, and liabilities. They should also determine how property is to be allocated in the event of a divorce, and make sure that the agreement is fair for both partners. Following this guideline, couples can get a prenuptial agreement, protecting their assets and financial futures for the years to come.

How to Make a Christmas Tree Pop up Card (Robert Sabuda Method)
Making a Christmas Tree Pop up Card is a fun craft project that is perfect for the holiday season, following the instructions of prolific pop-up card creator Robert Sabuda. This type of card is extremely eye-catching and a unique way to wish your family and friends a merry and happy holiday. Follow this guide to create your own Christmas Tree Pop up Card.

Materials:
- Printer 
- Heavy paper, like cardstock or construction paper 
- Scissors
- Glue

Instructions: 
Step 1: Print out the full size image of the tree on a nice, heavy paper of your choice. This card will serve as the ‘pop up’ that you will cut and fold to provide the 3-dimensional design look. 

Step 2: Print out the second image of the card backing on a similar heavy paper. This card will be the ‘base’ or bottom of the card that holds the tree ‘pop up’ together. 

Step 3: Cut the main card (the one with the outline of the tree) from the paper using scissors. Make sure you are following the black lines accurately.

Step 4: Fold the main card in half. Make sure the outline of the tree is still showing and visible on the paper.

Step 5: Cut along the solid lines on the fold of the main card to create the sections for the tree’s branches. As you start to fold the individual segments, it may help to curve the edges slightly so the cut sections look more realistic. 

Step 6: Fold each of the segments back against the card along the dotted line and crease with your thumb or finger. After this step, the card should look like a flat tree with a dashed line in the center.

Step 7: Place each of the tree segments back to their original position. 

Step 8: Set the Christmas tree card aside and lay the backing card (from the second print out) on a flat surface. Cut the backing card from the paper using scissors, once again accurately following the black lines. 

Step 9: Fold the backing card in half with the dotted line facing inside. 

Step 10: Place the Christmas Tree card on a flat surface and turn over so the dotted outline is visible. 

Step 11: Carefully position the backing card, with the dotted line facing down, on top of the Christmas tree card. 

Step 12: Press the cards together, flattening them completely. 

Step 13: Add any extra elements or decorations to the card, such as glitter, ribbons, stickers, etc. 

Step 14: When finished, glue down the edges of the card to keep it in place. 

Your Christmas Tree Pop up Card is now complete! This project is a great way to show your loved ones how much you care by giving the gift of a homemade, unique card. We hope you had fun creating your own designs and making special memories with friends and family. Happy holidays!

Have you ever wanted to be as powerful and admirable as Superman? Well now you can with a few simple steps. You can find all of the items you need to create your own Superman costume easily and for a fraction of the price.

First, you'll need to find a long-sleeved blue shirt or blue leotard. This will be the foundation of the costume so it's important that it fits you well. You can find these at most clothing stores or online. Then, search for“superman” on Google images and look for the classic-style emblem. Print it out so it covers your chest area when you blow it up.

Now, you'll need to make your own stencil of the emblem. Cut out the outline of the printed-out emblem onto a piece of cardboard or construction paper. Be sure to cut it out accurately and neatly for a nice finished product. With this stencil, trace the emblem onto a piece of yellow vinyl. Cut out the emblem but leave a bit of extra vinyl around the edges for a more professional look.

After you've cut out the emblem, get some felt in a bright red color. With your stencil, trace the classic “S” logo onto the felt. Cut out the “S” logo and set it aside. Now, purchase three yards of synthetic red fabric. With a ruler, measure and cut out a rectangle which should reach just above the top of your calves and be big enough that it fits comfortably around the neck.

Now it's time to assemble the cape. You can either hand sew or machine sew the cape into the back collar of the blue shirt or leotard. Assemble and sew it neatly for a successful finish. To get the full costume look, you'll need to find (or make) yourself some red briefs. Outline the reflection of the brief shape on the fabric and then prepare the briefs for sewing. Once you outfit them, you just have to sew the sides together.
