How to Install Mesa (OpenGL) on Linux Mint

OpenGL is an open-source 3D graphics rendering language developed by Silicon Graphics Inc. and commonly used in 3D Computer games, computer-aided design, and scientific visualization. It is available on a variety of platforms, including Linux Mint. Thankfully, installing Mesa and using OpenGL on Linux Mint is relatively easy. Follow the steps below to get started!

1. Open a terminal and enter the following commands to install the necessary libraries for OpenGL development: 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get update 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install freeglut3 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install freeglut3-dev 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install binutils-gold 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install g++ cmake 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install libglew-dev 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install g++ 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install mesa-common-dev 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install build-essential 

Type/Copy/Paste: sudo apt-get install libglew1.5-dev libglm-dev 

2. After your development libraries have been installed to get information about the OpenGL and GLX implementations running on a given X display. Type the following command: 

Type/Copy/Paste: glxinfo | grep “version” 

This command will output the version numbers for the OpenGL renderer, GLX renderer, and GLX version that are installed on your system. 

3. To create an OpenGL program, open up a terminal, make a directory, change into the directory and use your favorite text editor such as nano or gedit to create your OpenGL source code. 

To start, download the sample source code from the Mesa project source under the 'OpenGL & GLX' category. Click the 'OpenGL Sample Programs' link and save the downloaded .tar.gz file to the directory of your choice. Once the download has finished, extract the contents of the tarball and change into the Sample-OpenGL-Programs directory created by its extraction. 

4. While in the Sample-OpenGL-Programs directory run the following command below. 

Type/Copy/Paste: ./compile_opengl_test.sh 

This will compile your example OpenGL source code into a program named 'OpenGLExample'. 

5. In order to run the program type the following below: 

Type/Copy/Paste: ./OpenGLExample 

If compiled correctly, the program will run the example OpenGL program that comes with the sample source code. 

6. For more information on OpenGL and other tutorials for you to try, see the following online reference manuals. Khronos provides a comprehensive OpenGL guide which includes tutorials, reference materials, API functions, etc. Another helpful resource is the previously linked Mesa project reference guide, providing information on a wide variety of topics related to OpenGL, such as GLSL shading language, screen surface management, vertex/pixel program management, to name a few. 

With the right resources and commands you should be able to compile and build OpenGL applications on Linux Mint with ease. Open up your virtual environment and start creating your cutting-edge OpenGL applications today!

How to Hide in Plain Sight
No matter the reason why we feel the need to remain unseen, we can all benefit from insights into hiding from plain sight. There exists a spectrum for how “plain” you want to be. The more “plain” a person manages to be, the less likely that they will draw attention to themselves. Here are a few tips and tricks for those looking to hide from plain sight.

Hide your distinctive qualities. Avoid wearing any clothing that stands out, like colours that are too bright or loud designs. While we are on the subject of clothing, do not dress yourself up too elegantly nor too sloppily either. Doing either can draw attention to you, which defeats the whole purpose of this exercise.

Apply camouflage. If you’re in a natural setting, wearing camouflage gear will allow you to blend in with your environment. This makes it harder for someone or something to spot you.

Leave the accessories at home. Accessories, like watches, pins, jewellery and patches, exist for the sake of making a person’s appearance more distinctive. Take for example someone wearing a baseball cap -- that can be used to identify them in a crowd or a single person in a far distance.

Groom yourself without style. While being unkempt will attract its own sort of attention your way, a scruffy or distinct hairstyle will draw eyes to you. Choose something subtle that won’t draw any extra attention to you. 

Obey the rules. Nothing attracts attention like breaking fee of the norm. Don’t draw attention to yourself or do anything suspicious that would draw more attention to you. Blend in with the crowd and observe the behaviour of people around you.

Train your situational awareness. A good part of hiding from someone is knowing where your seekers are looking or scoping out your surrounding environment. Knowing the area helps to keep yourself safe and away from potential dangers. 

Follow the behaviour of people around you. Losing yourself in a crowd means adhering to all of the crowd's norms. If they’re walking slowly, you should too and if they’re walking briskly, you should do the same.

Stick to near the center of the crowd. You are less likely to draw attention to yourself if there are many people around you. It’s just like if you were to vanish in a forest, you would go straight for the thickest trees for the greatest natural protection. 

Remain silent. The less noise you make the better off you’ll be, which means avoiding unnecessary conversation with others unless necessary. You don’t want to unwittingly give your position away.

Act agreeable in conversation. In some cases, you won't be able to avoid conversation with other people. Being respectful and agreeable can help cover up any anxiousness or overly suspicious behaviour.

Regulate your movements. If you're trying to hide in plain sight, you may be in a stressful situation and feel anxious as a result. While being frantic can sometimes be necessary, it is important to keep calm and practice self-control. 

Avoid eye contact. Eye contact is an important way for two individuals to acknowledge each other. Keeping your eyes down or visible but unfocused will help to keep people from making the link to you. 

Aim to be in the middle of a crowd. Getting stuck in the area where people transition in and out won’t do you any good. It’s best to try and remain in the middle of a crowd where the movement is consistent. 

Dye your hair. Changing the colour of your hair is one of the easiest ways you can recreate your appearance. If you want to go even further, consider cutting or trimming your hair in a style that reflects the population you are trying to blend into.

Obscure your appearance with accessories. Of course you may need to give up some aspects of your style to remain concealed from plain sight. However, what you give up can be supplemented with another accessory that is more common. For example, If you are trying to blend into an Asian crowd, an ivory fan may fit in better than a bright pink hat. 

Age your look. This is important to consider when considering how to hide in plain sight as people of different ages are typically expected to dress a certain way and should look a certain way. Facial hair, clothing such as hoodies and an overall more sloppy or laid-back look can help achieve a more aged look.

Change up your manner of walking. People aren’t usually conscious of the manner in which they walk. This means that all it takes is a slight change in stride or the way we carry our body to completely change our look.

Bloat your face. If you’re trying to make yourself look older, losing control of your face is a great way to do it. Make yourself look older than you actually are by puffing out your cheeks or blowing out your lips.

Use fake facial hair. Something as simple as facial hair can totally transform a person’s appearance. If you’re looking to hide in plain sight, consider crafting a look with fake facial hair. Mustache, beards, sideburns, and any other type of facial hair can make a person almost unrecognizable. 

Hiding in plain sight isn’t always easy, and it takes patience and practice to master. However, if you remain focused on the objective and follow the aforementioned tips, you should be able to be relatively Zen and hide yourself from those looking for you. Good luck!

Going to Walt Disney World is a magical experience and something your entire family will always remember. It takes some planning and strategy to make the most of your week at Walt Disney World, but it is completely worth it. Here are some simple steps to make sure your trip is the best it can be.

Plan your trip. Before anything else, you need to have a plan. How many days are you going to be at the park? Do you want to visit multiple parks in the same day? What attractions do you want to make sure you don't miss? All these things should be considered when you are planning your trip. 

Buy your tickets. You don't want to wait in line at the park to buy tickets. This is something that you should purchase online or over the phone. Prices may vary and depending on the kind of tickets you want, it could add up.

Confirm dining reservations and hotel reservations 180 days in advance. The Walt Disney World parks are some of the busiest places in the world, and you definitely don't want to be stuck waiting in long lines for food or missing out on your favorite hotels. 

Announce the trip! After you have finalized your plans, now it's time to tell your family and friends you are going. This will get everyone excited and ready for your magical journey. 

Pack for your trip. You don't want to forget anything for your trip to Disney. Pack all the essentials like clothes, sunblock, and first aid items, and if you are driving you may want to consider snacks, drinks and entertainment for the car ride. 

Check off everything you have packed. Do this the day before and you will rest easier knowing that you aren't about to forget something. Make sure you have all your documents, your tickets and any other items you may need. 

Go grocery shopping for water, crackers, or anything else you might need in the car or on the trip. Water is essential if you are going to have a full day in the park and you don't want to pay a fortune buying it in the park. Snacks can be a great item to save money and time while on your vacation. 

If flying, make sure you have the tickets on hand. Check that they are up to date and that any kids have their correct ID. 

If driving, fill up your car's gas tank. You don't want to be stuck in the middle of nowhere without gas, and you may pay more for fuel near the park, so be sure to fill up in advance. 

Eat a HEALTHY dinner at 4:00pm. Try to avoid sugary snacks, candy, and pop as much as possible. Besides, you will be eating in the parks and you want to have a healthy base to start the trip. 

Load up the car after dinner with luggage (snacks and other stuff too, if driving). Make sure that you have everything packed into bags so that you don't need to mess with it too much during your travels. 

Go to bed. Try to get a good night's rest before heading out on your adventure. This is something that is often overlooked but getting plenty of rest before your vacation will make your days ahead much more enjoyable. 

Wake up, wake everyone else up! It's time to start the adventure! Make sure you have some breakfast and some caffeine to help jumpstart the day. 

Make everyone get dressed and try to get everyone to do their business and brush their teeth beforehand. 

Get everyone to eat breakfast, and try to eat it in the car if you are driving. This will save time at the parks and will get you eating your healthy breakfast. 

Drive. To the parks or to your hotel, make sure you have the directions and routes mapped out and if you are driving, remember to take frequent stops so everyone can use the restroom or stretch their legs. 

Find your hotel once you are in Lake Buena Vista. Check in, explore the room, get settled and then head to the pool if you can. 

Eat dinner. You can go out and find a restaurant near the park, head back to the hotel room and get take out, or cook dinner in your own room if you don't have the energy to do anything else. 

Go to the pool. this will help you rejuvenate for the day ahead. It will also help you relax when you come back later from the parks. 

Come back to the hotel room and drive around the Walt Disney World Property. This is a great chance to get familiar with the area and get a feel for the different parks and attractions. 

Come back to your hotel room, sleep. Eat dinner first and then get ready for a good night sleep so you can wake up early the next day and start your park adventures. 

Wake up, wake everyone else up. Pack a lightweight cooler with water bottles and head off to the Magic Kingdom. Take the monorail or the ferry to get there. 

Go through the ticket lines. They can be long if the park is busy but don't let it dissuade you from experiencing the Magic of Disney! You are now at the park!

How to Make Crepe Paper Peonies

Making crepe paper peonies can be a fun and rewarding craft project. With some basic supplies and a bit of patience, you can make beautiful faux floral arrangement for your home or as a gift. You can create your own color combinations to match any occasion. Follow these instructions to learn how to make colorful crepe paper peonies.

1. Roll some crepe paper into a small ball. This will be the center of the flower.

2. Cover the ball with yellow crepe paper and secure it to a wire stem. This can be done using glue or tape.

3. Wrap yellow embroidery thread 9 to 10 times around two fingers. This will create a looped thread when you pull off the fingers.

4. Pull off the looped thread and cut it. This will create a string of yellow threads that will be used to attach the petals.

5. Spread the floss across a strip of double-sided tape.

6. Wrap the double-sided tape around the base of the ball.

7. Cut crepe paper into rectangles for the base of the petals. You can use yellow or white paper–it’s up to you.

8. Cut the rectangles into tabbed petal shapes. This will give the petals an authentic look.

9. Shape the small petals into ruffed cups. Do this by pulling the tabs back and up to create a cup-like shape.

10. Shape the large petals into plain cups.

11. Glue the first small petal to the stem.

12. Continue gluing the small petals to the stem. Leave some space between each one–they should be evenly spaced.

13. Finish off with the largest petals. This will create the full bloom effect.

14. Cut 5 small leaf shapes out of green paper.

15. Glue the leaves to the bottom of the flower.

16. Cut three 3-point leaves.

17. Glue the leaves to wire stems.

18. Wrap the top part of each leaf stem with florist's tape. This will help secure the leaves to the main stem.

19. Wrap the top of the main stem with green florist's tape. This will create a more finished look for your flower.

20. Secure the a leaf stem to the main stem.

21. Secure the next two leaf stems, spacing them 4 inches (10.16 centimeters) apart.

22. Finish wrapping the tape around the main stem.

23. Finish shaping the flower. If desired, you can add small beads or pearls to the center of each petal.

Now you have a beautiful crepe paper peony that can be used as a stunning decoration. You can also gift it as a token of love or appreciation! With a bit of practice, you'll be creating lifelike blooms that will bring joy to all who see them.

How to Make a Soundproof Hammock for Stealth Camping
Soundproofing is a great way to ensure that you have a peaceful, private camping experience. By making your own soundproof hammock, you can take your camping experience to a whole new level of stealth. Here is how you can make your hammock soundproof:

Get a double bed size duvet. Make sure that the duvet is thick enough to provide adequate insulation and soundproofing. 

Fold the blank half of the duvet over the towel covered sides, so that the towel side is sandwiched in the middle. Lay the duvet out flat and position it in a way that the two sides of the duvet are facing each other.

On the fabric, measure two 200cm by 170cm rectangles using tailors chalk. This will form the casing for the hammock. Once you have finished measuring the rectangles out, cut them out. 

Pin the two fabric shapes together and mark a seam on the longer edges, using tailors chalk. Sew along this seam line. Once you have sewed the seam, turn the fabric sleeve inside out and fit the duvet inside the casing, leaving 25cm of excess fabric at each end.

Measure two 2m pieces of rope and cut it to this size. Carefully thread the two pieces of rope through the fabric casing, ensuring that the rope is evenly spread out and that it has a secure grip. 

Place the rope at each end of the fabric, folding 5cm of the fabric over the rope and pinning it in place before sewing along this edge. Continue folding the fabric of a width of 5cm around the rope until reaching the duvet.

Pull the rope so that the fabric bunches around the rope, forcing the fabric into a hammock shape. To keep the fabric bunched around the rope, so the fabric forms a hammock shape, tie a double overhand knot using the excess rope for each end of the hammock. 

Once your hammock is secure and soundproof, it is time to find the right location for your camping trip. Look for a secluded spot with good support pillars to suspend your hammock from.

Hang up the hammock by looping the second piece of rope through an end of the hammock and passing these ropes around either side of the tree/pillar. Make sure that the knots securing the hammock are tight and secure.

Finally, to make sure that your soundproof hammock works as intended, test it out. Put on headphones, whilst playing domestic sounds and lay in the hammock. If you can't hear a thing, then your soundproof hammock is complete!

Playing the game of Balderdash is a great way to spend an evening with family or friends. Here are some tips to help you get the most out of your game of Balderdash.

Begin by ripping open the plastic seal and removing the game board from its plastic package. The package should also include plastic pieces and miscellaneous parts, along with a die and game cards. 

Next, you'll need to put together a small group of people for the game. Allow each player to take turns rolling the die. This will determine who will become the "dasher". The dasher is the person who will decide the category or topic, and who will read out the question for all of the players. All of the players must then write down the question in one section of their answer sheet, and their proposed bluffing answer in another section. All the players must also place the name of the dasher on the sheet and initials in the cards before bringing up their answer.

How to Care for Molting Hermit Crabs 
A molting hermit crab is a vulnerable creature who must be cared for in the usual ways and with extra attention during this important part of its life cycle. Molting is a normal and necessary process for hermit crabs, but it can put them in danger if not properly taken care of. In order to ensure the health and safety of your molting hermit crabs, it is important to know how to properly care for them.

The first step in caring for a molting hermit crab is to track how much food and water your hermit crab consumes. By keeping an eye on how much and how often your hermit crab is eating and drinking, you can better monitor its health and recognize the signs of molting, such as less appetite.

You should also watch for signs of excessive digging, as this could be an indicator that your hermit crab is preparing to molt. Molting crabs often dig into their substrate or hide in their shells for stability during the molting process.

If your hermit crab appears to be significantly less active than usual, note this as a possible sign of molting. Not all hermit crabs show this behavior before molting, but it is definitely possible and can be a warning bell that your hermit crab is close to starting the process.

Look closely at your hermit crab for signs of molting. They may have a pale spot where the shell will come away, indicating an impending molt. At this point, it is best to isolate your hermit crab from the others to avoid potential injuries cause by a weakened crab. 

After you note the early signs of molting, it is a good idea to estimate the frequency and length of molting your hermit crab will go through. Molting can last anywhere from a few weeks to a few months, depending on the species, size, and age of the hermit crab. Keeping a molting journal is a great way to track this information and make sure your hermit crabs are safe and healthy through their entire life cycles. 

When it comes time for your hermit crab to start the molting process, you will need to set up the substrate appropriately. Make sure to use a soft, cushioned surface that will allow your crab to belly-dig in without getting hurt. Hermit crabs like to dig in a humid environment, too, so try to maintain temperatures between 70 to 75 degrees Fahrenheit and tank humidity between 70 to 75%.

It is also important to feed your hermit crab high protein and high calcium foods during this important period, to ensure that they are getting the nutrition they need for a successful molt. Give them both regular and salt water in containers deep enough for them to submerge themselves in, but not so deep they can’t get out.

If you still want to separate your molting hermit crab from the others, you can. Isolate your crab in a separate tank that is well-ventilated and filled with freshwater and saltwater containers. If needed, you can also build berms, boulders, and small landmarks as a shelter for your weakened hermit crab. 

Once your molting hermit crab is in its separate tank, you can begin to care for them. One way to do this is to mist the sand over the molting hermit crab for an extra humid environment and to replenish the moisture in their exoskeleton. Make sure to give them privacy while molting as well, as experience hermit crab owners know that a quiet environment is best for molting.

If your hermit crab decides to molt on the surface, protect it from accidentally rolling over and getting hurt. You can help stabilize them by putting several pieces of paper or cardboard underneath them, keeping their body flat while they molt.

Allow your hermit crab to molt at their own pace, as rushing them can lead to further injury or stress to your hermit crab. During this time, your hermit crab will be particularly sensitive, so keep them away from other hermit crabs in your tank or any other predators that may be in the tank.

Save your hermit crab’s old exoskeleton children. This is an important part of the molting process, as it will help the hermit crab properly shed their shell and grows to their new size.

Once your hermit crab is done molting, provide it with the necessary food and water, and slowly reintroduce it back into the main hermit crab tank. Give your hermit crab a variety of shells to choose from, as they may need to change shells once they have molted to better fit their size.

With proper care, your hermit crab will emerge healthy, strong, and ready to enjoy their hermit crab life. Molting hermit crabs are fragile creatures but with the right help and understanding, they can molt safely and successfully every time.

How to Help Your Autistic Child

Autism is a condition that affects many children and families in unique ways; it is therefore important that families work with their autistic child's specific needs to ensure they have a comfortable and secure life. Here are some tips to help families to help their autistic children:

Maintain consistency. This is essential in helping children with autism, since changes in routine can cause anxiety and confusion. When possible, try to stick to a routine that works for your child, and when changes are necessary, make sure that you communicate them so that your child can adjust.

Avoid making unnecessary changes, especially in what your child perceives as their domain. For children with autism, their space can be a safe haven for them, so moving furniture or changing decor can make them feel unsafe. If changes are necessary, make sure they are made with input from your child and done gradually.

Use natural or full spectrum lighting whenever possible. Fluorescent lighting can be extremely overstimulating and can lead to a meltdown. Natural light has a calming effect and so does sunlight. Whenever you can, try to ensure that your home is well lit.

Consider noises in the environment. Children with autism can be oversensitive to noises, even within their normal range. Make sure to remove any sources of loud noise or background noises as much as possible and keep the environment as quiet as possible.

Let them retreat to a quiet area when they want to. It is important to give your child the freedom to go to a room or space where they feel safe and free from overwhelm. Consider setting up a calming corner or space they can escape to when the environment becomes too stimulating.

Ensure safety around your home. Children with autism often wander. Take the necessary precautions such as installing door alarms or locks to make sure that your child cannot wander off. Most importantly, teach your child about safety around the home and the dangers of leaving the house without permission.

Understand stimming. Stimming is a self-regulating behavior used by some autistic children. It could be anything from flapping their hands, rocking, humming, or repeating the same phrase. It is important to accept and allow stimming as a coping mechanism, however, understand the boundaries and when it is not appropriate.

Understand the importance of special interests. Autistic children often have intense interests in certain topics and activities. It is important to let your child explore their interests, and encourage shared activities and conversations. This can also help them to build relationships and develop social skills.

Expect different body language. Autistic children may not express themselves in the same way as other children. They may have difficulty making eye contact, have a flat affect, and have difficulty with communication in general. Understanding that these are signs of autism, and not willful misbehavior, helps to better address their needs and feelings.

Know the signs of sensory overload. Children with autism can be overwhelmed by too much sensory input and can have meltdowns as a result. Knowing the warning signs of a meltdown, and being prepared to help, can be useful. The signs include screaming, crying, or isolating themselves in a quiet area.

Check up on the child's health with their GP regularly. Many children with autism also have medical needs that must be addressed. Keeping regular appointments with the child's doctor can help diagnose medical issues before they become too serious. It can also help ensure that the child is getting the right medication and therapies for their needs.

Speak to your child often. Despite difficulties in communication, your child will still benefit from trying to engage with you in conversations. Using simple language and allowing your child to take their time responding can help with communication.

Encourage communication, verbal and otherwise. Communication can take place through many ways. It could be through sign language or even using visuals and pictures. Let your child explore different ways of expressing themselves.

Make it clear that the word "no" is important. Teach your child that no is an acceptable answer and let them know that it is okay to say no when they feel uncomfortable or unsafe.

Explain the rules, and the behavior that you expect. Let your child know what you expect of them when you are giving instructions. Being clear about the rules can help your child to understand the consequences of their actions.

Understand the use of visual stimuli. Autistic children often benefit from the use of visuals, such as picture boards, schedules, or written instructions. Visual aids can help to reduce confusion and stress.

Find fun, constructive therapies that help your child grow. There are many different kinds of therapies available to help improve your child's communication, social skills, and daily living skills. Finding something that your child enjoys and can progress in is important for their development.

Recognize that autism is lifelong. Autism is not something that can be "cured" or cured; it is a lifelong condition. Accepting this and learning to manage it can be emotionally challenging, however, knowing that this is a journey will help families to better prepare themselves and support their child.

Quit measuring yourself and your child against other families. Every family is different, and so is every child's autism. It is important to understand what works for your family and what you can do to support your child. Comparing yourself or your child to others will not be productive.

Teach your child about autism early on. Teaching your child about autism at an early age can help them to understand themselves and the world around them. It can also help in developing positive self-esteem and prevent any anxiety that could come with feeling different.

Have the attitude that you're in it for the long haul. Autism is not something that will go away overnight, and it takes a lot of hard work and understanding. Make sure you and your family recognize that this is a journey and that you are in it for the long haul.

Learn from autistic teens and adults. Learning from autistic adults can help to provide insight into how to better support your child. Reading books and other personal accounts from adults with autism can help you to understand your child better and provide new and helpful strategies for parenting an autistic child.

Trust your instincts about how your child is treated. Make sure you protect your child and always trust your gut instincts if you feel that someone is not treating your child properly.

Love your child. Despite the challenges that come with parenting an autistic child, it is important to always show your child love and support. Encourage your child and assure them that they are safe, and that you are always there for them.

How to Remove Interior Walls'
Removing interior walls in a home usually involves a lot of planning, labor, and preparation. While the task may seem daunting, with a few easy steps and some precautions the job can be done safely and successfully. This article outlines the steps necessary to properly remove interior walls from your home.

First, determine if the wall you want to remove is a load bearing wall, meaning it supports the floor above. If the wall you want to remove is at a right angle to the floor joists - STOP. Interior walls that are at a right angle to the joists that hold up the floor above should never be removed because the structural integrity of the floor joists may be compromised and the floor above could collaps.

Look at the wall for electrical outlets, switches, etc. If there are any, you will need to disconnect them and safely dispose of the wiring. On the other hand, if the walls are void of any obstructions, don't worry – the only demolition should be removing the drywall and studs.

Since demolition will bring up a lot of dust and debris, empty as much from the rooms as possible and cover any doors with plastic sheets to contain dust. Wear safety goggles and a dust mask when demolishing the wall. Wearing work gloves, grab onto the edge of the smashed drywall and pull off.

Once all the drywall has been removed, you can start to remove the wall studs. Wall studs are usually nailed to the floor and ceiling plates with a reciprocating saw. Make sure to unplug and safely dispose of all the wires and outlets that were attached to the wall studs. After all the wall studs are removed, you can remove the floor plate.

Once all the debris is removed, you'll have to patch the ceiling where the wall was removed with a strip of drywall and patch the floor with a new piece of flooring. It is important to make sure the wall studs were all removed properly so you can check and make sure the floor isn't sagging. On the ceiling, measure the width of the hole created by removal of the wall. The drywall should be cut almost as wide as the new opening (tape and mud will cover any gaps). Mud the edge of the new drywall and the existing ceiling with drywall compound ('mud"). Allow the mud to dry (check the box/container for drying time required) and sand the drywall mud. Add another layer of mud, using a wider trowel to taper the edges. You may need to do the above steps several times to obtain an almost seamless match between the patch and the existing ceiling. Once you are satisfied with the patch, you can add a coat of drywall primer/sealer and repaint the patch to match the existing ceiling.

Depending on the type of flooring, you will need to add a patch to the carpeting, tile or hardwood from the adjoining rooms. If the floor is carpet, you will need to measure and cut out a patch from the joining room's carpet to cover the hole. Using an adhesive (according to carpet instructions) to stick the patch, and gently press down the edges to make sure the patch is secure. If the floor is tile or hardwood, measure and cut a patch to cover the hole, making sure to match the grain and color as closely as possible. Using adhesive, attach the patch, and press down the edges gently.

Once everything is patched and looking great, you have successfully removed an interior wall in your home! Congratulations!

How to Defend in Soccer
The art of defending is essential in soccer; it is the difference between being a good player and a great player. It helps ensure that a team’s attack isn’t easily defeated, allowing them to retain possession and launch successful counter-attacks. Here are some tips on how to defend in soccer:

Establish a Training Regimen
To become a better defender, you’ll want to create a well-rounded training regimen focusing on basics such as improving your speed, agility, strength, and endurance. You must improve your ability to keep up with, or stay ahead of, your opponent. To do this, try integrating interval or compound training — a type of physical activity which consists of bouts of bursts of intense exercise with intervals of rest.

Increase Your Cardiovascular Activity
Cardio training and endurance workouts will help build your muscle and lung capacity. With increased cardiovascular activity, players can maintain their energy throughout the match and defend with more creativity and focus. Ultimately, this means that an athlete can push themselves further and work their way up to mastering more intricate defensive tactics.

Raise Awareness of Positional Developments on the Field
A basic understanding of the game’s positional dynamics is essential for players looking to become better defenders. Knowing where your teammates are passing the ball, where the strikers are setting up their attack, and where the midfielders are attempting to move will help you establish control over the pitch.

Polish Your Basic Skills
As a defender, you need to be able to do the basics with confidence: passing, tackling, positioning, heading, and reaction speed. Practice these essential skills on a regular basis so that you’re most likely to be successful when the moment of decision arrives. Even the most experienced players can benefit from honing their basic skills.

Know Where to Look
When defending, it’s important to keep an eye on the ball and the players in their possession. Paying attention to the whole field helps you anticipate where the ball could be sent to; look out for runs of midfielders into the box, or defenders pushing forward to win back the ball.

Cover Opponents and their Angles of Approach
Defenders must be able to cover their opponents. Try to close the opponent’s route to goal as much as possible and force them to go past you instead. Have an awareness of which side of your body will most likely be exposed to a quick counter-attack and adjust your positioning accordingly.

Be Determined in Your Mindset
Your mindset is key to successful defending. Even more so than your technical and tactical abilities, your determination and mental strength will be instrumental in successful defending. To ensure that you’re mentally strong, assess your opponents and try to predict their movements on the pitch.

Evaluate the Opposing Players’ Style
It’s important to analyze the way that opposing players play. Evaluate their attack and defense in terms of how aggressively they employ them, or if they use more of a patient approach to maintain control. With this information you can better modify your strategy to best defend against what the other team is trying to achieve.

Cut Off Attacks on Net and Passes Between Players
Cutting off your opponent’s attacks is every defender’s job. You’ll need to close down your opponents when they’re trying to pass to their strikers or crosses into the box. This means getting close to them and cutting off their passing angles.

Limit Your Stabs at the Ball
Jabbing your foot out to try to haphazardly prod the ball away from your opponent can compromise your balance and give him an opportunity to pass you by. Instead, choose your timing carefully and try to anticipate when you can do the most damage in the tackle.

Angle Your Hips and Your Approach
Try to go into the tackle with your hip angled directly away from the attacker so they can’t penetrate into your physical space. Also bear in mind that the speed of your approach makes a difference; going too fast can leave you off balance and open to attacks.

Herd Attackers into Positions of Pressure
You can do this by cutting off the angle of an attacker’s approach in a way that is accessible to other defenders, like midfielders. If attackers are forced into less favourable positions, it makes it harder for them to score or make dangerously accurate passes.

Communicate with Fellow Defenders
Defenders need to communicate clearly with the keeper, the midfield, and each other. If the defense is playing an offside trap, or if a defender is not in line or not marking a player, he should be informed of this loudly and quickly. This way, defenders can coordinate their efforts and time their tackles properly.

Practice One-on-One Defense
To learn how to effectively defend, put yourself in simulation situations and practice battling it out with an attacker in one-on-one drills. This will help you in responding to tough situations, such as having to close down multiple attackers in quick succession.

Try a Faster-Paced Two-on-Two Drill
In this practice drill, two attackers and two defenders must face off against each other. The attackers must try to break the defensive line with a good pass, while the defenders must adjust their positioning to cut off the angles of the attackers’ approach. This drill adds a bit of pressure and improves the defenders’ ability to react quickly and stay in control of their opponents at all times.

Learn to Defend against Crosses
One of the most difficult tasks for a defender is to prevent crosses into the box. Defenders usually have to fight for control of the ball and use body position to disrupt their opponents’ attempts to send the ball in. Plus, defenders must be able to read offensive passes and intercept them.

Enact a Full-On Penalty Area Defensive Drill
Defending in the penalty area is vital to any team’s success. These drills can help defenders become more disciplined and organized when defending the box. Players should be taught when and how to clear the ball, as well as tactics for screening attackers and keeping passes from getting through.

Defending in soccer isn’t easy; it requires a lot of work and dedication. But if you practice the tips mentioned here and work on improving your style, you’ll be sure to see improvement in your own defensive skills.

How to Build an Easy Woven Stick Fort
Building a fort with sticks is an easy way to get kids and adults alike outside and having fun. It's a great way to use up material that can be found in nature and enjoy the environment in all its glory! Forts can be a great way to bond with friends and family and just make some incredible memories. Here is how to build an easy woven stick fort that you and your family can enjoy.

Go to the general area you want your fort. If you want a fort with a view, look for a high point like a hill or a ridge. If you want a fort with water nearby, look for something in the vicinity of a river or lake. Look around for big boulders, thick fallen trees, a stream, and/or open space, so you can determine where to start and what type of fort you want to build. It’s key to observe the lay of the land to ensure that your fort won’t be too close to streams, rivers, or bogs, as the base of the fort may be eroded.

Mark out the space you want your fort. Make sure the location is clear of any brambles, nettles, briars, and other plant life that could cause you injuries while building. Then, start gathering materials.

Gather long sticks that are 6 to 12 inches taller than as tall as you want your fort to be. Typical, upswept forts are about 3 to 6 feet high. You will need sticks that are cut to length and are the same thickness for all of the beams. Consider a strong woods like oak and ash, which are usually strong and fire-resistant.

Make a hole in the ground as wide as your sticks and 5 to 12 inches deep around the edge of where you want your fort. Fill the hole with some compost or manure and put a stick perpendicular to the other sticks. Water the area around the hole occasionally and test if the stick stays in place.

Insert the sticks into the holes and make sure they stay upright on their own. If the sticks do not stay upright, dig the holes deeper and make sure the thicker end is at the bottom.

Gather more sticks of any width. This will create a thicker wall for the fort and may provide some better insulation. Put the thicker sticks on first and work your way up the width.

Start the bottom of the upright sticks by the door. Start weaving sticks across the logs horizontally, starting at the bottom. If you weaved them from the top they would easily come out and the fort would be easily destroyed.

Keep layering your sticks until you have created a solid wall all the way up. Make sure that the weaving is tight, because the weaving is what makes the fort structurally sound and keeps the walls up and the fort standing.

Ok. You have your walls and frame. Now the fun part begins; insulation! Gather leaves, grass, sod, moss, or any plant that you can stuff into the frame. Once you have your basic leaves and moss and grass shoved into the frame, consider covering weak parts of your insulation with mud. If you do decide on mud, get a bucket like the kind you use to make sand castles at the beach or wash your car with.

Find a stick that spans across the door. Stick it into the ground and balance the stick across the door frame, making sure you leave enough room for a person to crouch down and go through the door.

Find an old towel or something similar. This will provide shelter from the elements when the fort is complete. Dye the door to make it look more natural, if wished.

Every fort needs a roof. If you choose to continue, crisscross the sticks across the fort. Then, do the same with smaller sticks cross the bigger ones. Layer leaves, grass and moss on top of the sticks and continue with mud, as for the insulation.

Done! You now have a wonderful, woven stick fort that you and yours can enjoy for many years to come. Have fun!

How to Wear Plaid
Wearing plaid can be a fun and fashionable way to show off your style. Plaid can be casual or dressy, so experiment and find what combination works best for you. Follow these tips to master the art of wearing plaid.

1. Wear one plaid piece of clothing at a time. Plaid can be a subtle statement or it can make a bold statement, so it's best to keep it at one piece of clothing at a time. Think of it like the statement necklace: one is enough to get your point across.

2. When in doubt, pair your plaid with neutral solids. Plaid, have the tendency to stand out, which can be great when you want that effect. To tone it down a bit, wear it with neutrals. Think tans, whites, and creams that prevent the plaid from being "too much" for your outfit.

3. Match one color in the plaid with other colored clothes you wear. Plaid can often times be busy, and pairing a unique color in it with another piece can help create cohesion. Look for colors within the pattern that will match an article of clothing that you already have.

4. Pick an appropriate color for the occasion. Plaid can be a great way to inject life into an outfit, but it needs to correspond to the general atmosphere of the event. For example, if you are attending a more formal event, you will want to stay away from louder colors and brighter patterns.

5. Pick a comfortable fabric for the season. One of the key elements of an outfit can be the fabric you use. You want to be able to feel comfortable in whatever you wear, no matter the season. Choose lightweight t-shirts, cotton dresses, or jersey for summer, and wool, tweed, and velvet for the winter months.

6. Pick a print pattern and size that compliments your outfit. Plaid has come in a variety of sizes, shapes, and colors. Have fun with it and pick a pattern that complements the rest of your outfit. Whether you want to make a statement or just add a touch of color, there is plenty to choose from.

7. Don't forget plaid accessories. Accessories can be a quick way to elevate an outfit with a touch of plaid. Think a plaid headband, scarf, or belt to give your look a pop.

8. Try a loose or fitted flannel shirt. Flannel is a popular and very wearable option for plaid. You can go for a streamlined fitted style, or opt for a drape fit for a cozier vibe.

9. Tie a flannel around your waist for a splash of color. Tying a flannel around your waist is a great way to add color. It's an easy and chic way to spruce up any outfit when you don't want to commit to a full shirt.

10. Pair with Capri pants for casual chic. Capri pants can be the perfect way to finish off a plaid-inspired outfit. They allow you to show off a bit of your personality without going overboard.

11. Dress things up with leggings and accessories. Leggings can easily give off a more dressy vibe. Throw on a blazer, and maybe a scarf or jewelry, and you can be dressed for a special occasion.

12. Use a plaid skirt for a "schoolgirl" look. The traditional "schoolgirl" look does not have to be boring. Add in a plaid skirt for a jolt of color that will draw everyone's attention.

13. Spice things up with plaid accessories. Accessories can be a great way to add plaid in an unexpected way. Maybe it's a pair of booties or a hat in a plaid pattern to add a bit of flair.

14. Use traditional plaids for a lumberjack look. Traditional plaid is a great way to go for a lumberjack look. Use one of the classic colors such as red or navy to create the perfect vibe.

15. Use light-colored plaid shirts for lighthearted charm. Light-colored plaid can lighten up a look. Play with pastels and soft pink tones to create a sweet and subtle style.

16. Sport a pair of plaid shorts. Shorts are not just for the summer. Plaid shorts are a great way to stay stylish and warm in the cooler months.

17. Try a plaid tie. A plaid tie is a great way to add a bit of style to a more formal look. Choose a tie that has colors in it that match with your outfit to create a cohesive look.

18. Use a very subdued pattern for plaid suits. If you are wearing a plaid suit, less is more. Choose a more muted color and pattern in order to make a sleek impression.

19. Never go plaid-on-plaid. As a fashion rule, plaid-on-plaid should be avoided. Stick to one plaid item of clothing at a time to create a more cohesive look.

20. Avoid plaid for formal events. Plaid does work for certain occasions, but a formal event is not one of them. Stick to solids and neutrals for these types of events.

21. Don't pair plaid with eye-grabbing colors. Avoid colors such as neon's and bright neons when pairing plaid. You want the focus to be on the plaid and not the other colors.

22. Don't feel like you have to buy plaid new. Vintage stores are a great place to find plaid staples that will last you for years. You will also get more bang for your buck.

23. Don't wear plaid pants unless you're supremely confident. Plaid pants can be tricky to accessorize, and is usually best left to the experts! Go for simpler options such as a skirt or shorts for a more versatile look.

By following these tips, you will be sure to look fabulous in plaid. Wearing the print can help to give your wardrobe an extra boost, so have fun experimenting!

Having ovarian cyst(s) can be a painful and worrying experience. Fortunately, there are ways to ease ovarian cyst pain and even prevent them from forming in the first place. By taking certain medications, making dietary changes and considering other alternative therapies, ovarian cyst pain can be relieved.

The first-line pain treatment for ovarian cyst(s) is typically a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) pain medication. NSAIDS have been found to be effective in relieving the pain of ovarian cysts. Common NSAID's available by prescription include Ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), Naproxen Sodium (Aleve) and Celebrex (Celecoxib).

In some cases, however, a more potent type of pain relief, such as a narcotic painkiller, may be necessary to manage severe pain. If you are considering trying a narcotic painkiller, talk to your doctor first as these medications come with a risk for side effects and addiction.

If you are not sure that an ovarian cyst is the source of your pain, it is important to confirm this through a medical examination. Your doctor may use ultrasound imaging, pelvic exam or other techniques to identify an ovarian cyst or to rule out other potential sources of pain.

If your ovarian cyst pain is persistent, surgery may be recommended as a treatment option. The decision to undergo an operation to remove your ovarian cyst(s) will depend on a number of factors, including the size of the cyst(s) and the possibility that it may one day become cancerous. If your cyst(s) is not yet showing signs of persistent pain and/or a risk for cancer, then the doctor may advise "watchful waiting", wherein you will be asked to return for periodic ultrasound imaging to monitor the cyst(s).

One way to help prevent any new cysts from forming is to take hormonal birth control pills. While these pills cannot help relieve any existing ovarian cyst pain, they serve to reduce the frequency of cysts by altering hormones that affect the growth of ovarian cysts. It is important to talk to your doctor to make sure that there are not any medical conditions that could contraindicate you from taking birth control pills, such as breast, uterine or other cancer that is "fed" by estrogen.

If you are looking for a more natural way to reduce pain associated with ovarian cysts, consider consuming foods that have anti-inflammatory effects, such as ginger and/or turmeric. You can incorporate these spices into your meals or a warm drink like tea. Additionally, heat treatments, such as heating pads or hot baths can also help to reduce pain associated with ovarian cysts.

Other alternative and complimentary therapies for ovarian cyst pain relief include acupuncture and hypnosis. A skilled acupuncturist can help to activate the body’s natural healing response, while hypnosis helps to remove worry and anxiety and promote relaxation. Both therapies can help to relieve pain and other symptoms associated with ovarian cysts.

Finally, if you are dealing with ovarian cyst pain, try to distract yourself with activities that you enjoy doing and take time out to ensure that you are taken care of. Speak to a friend or a family member to help you process any worries that you may have. All of these measures, in combination with medical treatments, such as NSAIDS and birth control pills, can help to reduce and manage ovarian cyst pain.

Building a climbing wall can be an exciting and rewarding home project. A climbing wall made from plywood and manufactured stone holds can be built in a few hours, depending on the size you want and the experience level of the installer. By following this step-by-step guide, you will have your wall built in no time!

Lay a 4 foot by 8 foot piece of plywood flat on the work surface. Glue a 7 foot piece of 2 inch by 4 inch lumber to the back of the plywood on each side. Glue a 4 foot piece of 2 inch by 4 inch lumber to the back of the plywood at the top and the bottom. Flip the plywood over and drive wood screws through the plywood into the support lumber glued to the back at 4 inch intervals along all 4 sides.

Next you will need to attach the climbing holds. Use the hardware provided by the manufacturer to attach manufactured stone hold climbing rocks to the front of the plywood using your own design or the pattern supplied by the manufacturer. As you attach the holds, it is important that each holds anchor is secured with a 1/4 inch hole drilled on both sides of the panel in the same position. Once finished, you will have a completed wall.

To create a more adjustable panel, you will need to build 2 adjustable side supports for your panel. To do this, take two 6 foot pieces of 2 inch by 4 inch lumber and fasten them together at a 90-degree angle. Use a length of 2-1/2 inch by 3-1/2 inch lumber and cut 4 pieces measuring 30 inches. Bolt the pieces of lumber together to reinforce the structure.

Drill two 1/4 inch holes 6 inches from the top and 5 inches from the bottom in each side studs of the panel. Leave the pre-drilled holes in the side supports of the panel open and use them to attach directly to the side studs of the frame. Place the piece of the side support underneath the side studs and line up the holes of the support to the holes drilled in the side studs of the panel. Finally, secure the adjustable side support to the wall using two 1/4 inch bolts and nuts.

Repeat the process for the second side support and adjust the angle of your climbing surface by removing the bolts from the top and bottom of the climbing panel, tilting the wall and reinstalling the bolts through the various holes in the side braces. After you’ve adjusted the wall to your desired angle, you have now successfully built a climbing wall! You can now have fun testing your walls strength and have a great time climbing it with friends.

Creating a basic 3D Solar Printer is a fairly straightforward task that can produce intriguing designs. In order to get started, you will need to gather the materials listed above and have a basic plan for the printer. With the right amount of patience and concentration, you will soon be creating visually appealing 3D structures of your own.

First, you will need to measure and cut the boards of 2x4x8 wood. Measure and cut two boards at 8’ (no cuts required), two at 6’, four at 5’6”, and one board into two 2’8’’ pieces. The four 5’6” boards will need to have 45-degree angles cut on both ends so that they do not line up parallel with one another.

Once the cuts are complete, you will need to combine the boards. Take the two 8-foot boards and place the 6-foot board at the midpoint of the 8-foot board to make a ‘T’ shape. Secure this connection with two screws, one from either side of the 6-foot board into the 8-foot board. Once the setup is secure, take the cut pieces with the 45-degree angles on either end and place them so that they touch both the base and the vertical boards simultaneously. Repeat this step again to make two symmetrical support structures.

With these structures made, you will need to use a 2’8” board to attach it to the base of the structure as well as the other structure we created in the previous step. Measure 5 feet up from the base of both vertical boards and drill a hole on both sides of the Fresnel Lens frame at the midpoint, which should be at the 12-inch mark on a 24x24 Lens. Feed the 1/2 threaded bolts through the frame and into the vertical supports.

You will now need to secure an open ended box and place a balance Fresnel Lens in front of it. Make sure to orient the lens correctly, so that the sun’s rays can be directed into the box. Once the focal point is met, begin to slowly add layers of sand into the box and start to monitor for any melting taking place. Once you have managed to build up the desired shape, you can let the bowl cool off and admire your creation.

Creating 3D structures with a basic solar printer can be a fun and gratifying experience. With the right materials and a bit of experimentation, you can quickly produce simple shapes or something more elaborate. Put in the work and the results will be sure to amaze you.

How to Make Baby Blankets'

Babies love snuggle time, so why not make your very own baby blankets to keep the little ones warm and cozy? Baby blankets come in all shapes and sizes, and they make a perfect handmade gift. Here's how to make your own from two pieces of fleece material.

Start off with two one-yard strips of fleece material; one with the soft, fuzzy side facing up, and the other with the rougher side facing up. Using a self healing mat beneath them, cut off the rough selvage edges of the fleece with a pair of scissors or a rotary cutter.

To create a four inch by four inch square template, take your tape measure and lay it across the fleece from the top of one right angle to the other, so that there is a four-inch strip of fleece below the tape measure. Again, using either scissors or a rotary cutter, cut strips of fleece that are one-inch thick, along the four-inch section. Make sure to pin the tape measure in place as you do so. Repeat for the remaining three sides of the fleece.

Once all four sides of the baby blanket have been cut, it's time to tie the fringe (the cut pieces of fleece) together. Separate the top layer of fleece from the bottom layer of fleece for each fringe, and tie the two together in a double knot. Double-check to make sure that each tie is tightly knotted and you're finished! Your baby blanket is now ready to use.

You can also make your own unique designs in your baby blanket by cutting from different shapes. Avoid complicated pattern designs as it can be difficult to lace up all the ties. Use the same technique as described above, although you may need to use some extra pins to keep the template in place. Get creative and let your imagination run wild! Congratulations – you have just crafted your very own handmade baby blanket.

Learning how to fold the Ship of 1000 Cranes is a fun way to make a unique origami sculpture. This step-by-step guide is designed to help beginners master this challenging paper craft. To start, you will need a square piece of paper. 

Begin by orienting your paper so that it looks like a diamond, with two opposite corners pointing directly at you and the other two to your left and right. Fold the paper in half horizontally to create a triangle that looks like half your diamond. Then fold it in half vertically again to create a second triangle. 

You should now have a diamond-shaped sheet of paper with two intersecting folds at the middle. On the top and bottom sides of the paper, fold them inward towards the center. Similarly, fold the left and right sides in to the middle. Preserving the diamond shape, re-orient the paper.

To give the ship its shape, you will now have to refold it in three stages. First, fold the paper in half horizontally, then in half vertically. You should have four corner points that are facing the center (each corner contains two of the original paper points). Carefully fold each corner into the center. Then, turn the paper over and fold both the left and right sides inward to the center. 

Next, turn the paper over again and lift the two top points in the center outward to create a butterfly shaped structure. Take the tips of the top and bottom triangles, fold them backwards, and press them down flat. Take the left and right triangles at the center (these have two of the original corner points facing towards the long side of the paper) and pull them outward, preserving the butterfly shape while doing so. 

Turn the paper over and locate the five-sided shape. You should have five corner points - two facing the center and three facing outward. For each corner, follow steps 11 and 12 to fold the paper into the center. This will give you a rectangle and paper which you should pinch at the line and pull out slightly. 

Finally, fold the rectangle in half horizontally and your ship is now ready for display. With a bit of practice, you should soon find it easy to fold the spectacular Ship of 1000 Cranes.

Since the advent of the internet, having an email address is a must for individual or corporate communications. The creation of ‘.com’ email addresses is a reliable and efficient way to ensure secure online communications and quick delivery of important messages. Creating and managing a ‘.com’ email address is a relatively simple process provided you have access to reliable hosting and web services to help facilitate the process. Follow these steps to get your own ‘.com’ email address up and running in no time.

The first step is to brainstorm creative business domain names and select the one you wish to be your ‘.com’ email address. This is the first level of branding for your domain name, so make sure it is something memorable and recognizable that speaks to your company or individual goals. Be sure to include the ‘.com’ suffix at the end.

Once you have chosen your domain name, you can now register and purchase it on a hosting service website. You have two hosting options for your ‘.com’ email address, paid hosting or free hosting. Paid hosting is the more reliable and secure option but free hosting services could work for you depending on your needs. Browse the hosting website you have chosen for their different package options and then purchase a web hosting account on the hosting website.

The next step is to log into your account on the hosting website and click the control panel. From here, you will designate how much disk space you will require for your email account. Once you have determined the needed space, you can access your email through the hosting website if it offers its own web mail feature. Otherwise, you will need to open Outlook. Regardless of which email service you are using, you will need to input the username and password you registered with the hosting site.

In order to activate and get your ‘.com’ email address running, you will also need to specify your incoming and outgoing server type, quality, and address. To set this up, you will need to go into the account settings of your email. There, you will want to go to the More Settings tab → Outgoing Server, and then open the Advanced tab. Once you have done that set the incoming server port to 143 and outgoing server to 2500 for an IMAP setup. Once the settings are entered, select Next then Finish to save the changes.

To set up a ‘.com’ email address through Zoho, first go to www.zoho.com/mail/ and click the “Get Started” button. Select the "Free & Ad-Free" option on the far right of the page and verify your domain name in the address bar provided. Log into mail.zoho.com as Super Admin and provide the username part in the text box. Input a password for the username then log into your domain registrar's website to launch the DNS control panel. 

From your control panel, click the option that specifies MX records/Email servers/Email settings then locate the option to add a new record and select that. Type mx.zohomail.com into the address field and set the priority level to any value if you only have one email account. Once you have done this, select "Save Zone File" or "Save" or "Add Records" to save the changes.

By following these steps, you will be equipped with a reliable ‘.com’ email address that can be used for both individual and corporate communications. From start to finish, the entire process will take between 30 minutes and an hour so investing the time is worth it to make sure you are prepared for any online communications that may come your way.

How to Convince a Child to Eat Dinner
Eating is an important part of a child’s development and health. It is not always easy for parents to encourage their children to adopt healthy eating habits and to develop a well-balanced diet. This can be a particular challenge if you are trying to get your child to eat dinner. There are plenty of steps you can take to ensure that your child is getting the nutrition they need at meal times.

Ask your child why they will not eat. Often there is an underlying reason – such as a lack of appetite or dislike of the meal – that can be addressed. If they do not have a legitimate answer then talk to them about the importance of nutrition and how necessary it is for them to eat a varied diet.

Organise ground rules. Both you and your child should be aware of what you expect them to do at the table. They will want to leave as quickly as possible and you want them to finish their meal. Be clear about what is expected of them.

Get them involved in cooking. If your child is involved in the preparation of the meal then this can be more interesting to them than just waiting for dinner to appear on the table. Let them decorate their own meals with pastry or cheese slices cut into shapes or arrange the food in funny ways.

Make dishes they like occasionally as a treat. Everyone enjoys treats, including children. If they like burgers and chips then make a tasty, healthy burger with oven baked seasoned wedges, which can also be healthy. Just make sure to ensure there is no double standards between yourself and your child.

On some children it works well to get personalized cutlery, plates, and cups. Letting your child choose their favorite plate or cup can make them believe that this is a special opportunity and they will be more willing to eat if this is the case.

Avoid bribing, begging, or shouting. The way that you try to encourage your child to eat should be positive. If you become frustrated when they refuse to eat then this could only nurture the idea that meal times are something to be dreaded.

Get rid of all distractions at dinner time. In today’s world there are endless technological distractions that can take away the importance of meal times. These should definitely be avoided.

Have family dinners. If your child sees that you enjoy the meal time and that it is a time for the whole family to get together then this can be a great encourager and you can all enjoy a meal together. This will also help define proper table manners for your child.

Allow them to have friends over for dinner. If your child has friends over for dinner it will make the meal time more fun and enjoyable and there can be more conversation than usual to keep them engaged.

Promise dessert or some other treat that your child will enjoy. As previously mentioned, children love treats and they will be more likely to eat their meal if they know there is something delicious waiting for them afterwards.

A very simple entree that kids enjoy is finger food. Let your child choose some of their favorite fruits and vegetables and provide them with a yummy yogurt or cream cheese dip. This can be a fun way to encourage them to eat and it is very tasty.

Keep them at the table until they are done. A common mistake that parents make is letting their children leave the table when they are not finished with their meal. This sends a message that if they do not eat their dinner then there will be no consequences. Be sure to let them know that this is part of the rules.

By following these steps you can find the best way to encourage your child to enjoy meals and to eat well and healthily. Eating dinner should be an enjoyable experience and part of a healthy lifestyle.

How to Build a Concrete Driveway' is a great project for those looking to build a durable, attractive, and long-lasting driveway. Building a concrete driveway requires planning, preparation, and some physical labor. To ensure that your concrete driveway is properly constructed and lasts for many years, here are some steps to help you effectively build your driveway.

Develop a plan for your driveway. Building a driveway should be a well-planned project. Ideally, you will have a plan that outlines the dimensions you want for your driveway, any additional features that you would like on the driveway, and an overall design that is consistent with your house and landscape. With a plan, you are less likely to overlook the critical steps of the project.

Do a cost estimate of the driveway. A great way to ensure that your project remains within budget is to plug in the estimated costs of site preparation, drainage, forming, steel, concrete, engineering, permitting, labor, and other items into a project cost estimate.

Check with the local jurisdictional agencies to determine what engineering and permitting requirements may affect your driveway. Building a driveway may require a building permit and a licensed engineer to ensure that your structure meets building codes and requirements.

Determine the soil bearing characteristics of your project site. The soil type and bearing load capacity are important components in the design of the concrete slab. Without proper compaction of the fill and a sufficient bearing capacity, the resulting slab may crack or fail.

Lay out the sides of your driveway. You can use builder's line and stakes to lay out the sides of the driveway and ensure that the entire driveway is of the same width. Cut the sod or remove all vegetation from the area to ensure your slab doesn't have any obstructions.

Measure the width of the drive so that it corresponds with the plan you have made. With the edges laid out and measured on either side, you can now measure to ensure that the width is consistent with the plan.

Remove any sod or other vegetation from the driveway location after you have established the edges with builder's line. This will ensure that any vegetation that may impact the pour and curing of the concrete does not settle underneath it.

Determine if there are any underground utilities that should be modified or installed before adding fill material or setting forms. Installing or modifying underground utilities is necessary to avoid any disruption and breakage that could occur when pouring and curing the concrete.

Install the forms for your driveway. Forms are the boards or elements that give structure and shape to the concrete when it is poured. It's important that the forms are of the proper size and on a level surface.

Grade the fill material or existing soil so that your slab of concrete will be the correct depth, or thickness. Grading the soil or fill material is necessary so that the concrete slab is the correct thickness and can support the load that the driveway may experience.

Compact the fill material using a plate compactor, rented from a local tool rental establishment, or if there is none available, a hand tamp, which can be purchased at a home improvement or hardware retailer. Proper compaction is essential as it increases the bearing capacity of your soil and makes for a smoother surface when the concrete is poured.

Install reinforcing steel if desired. Steel reinforcement can be used to reduce potential cracking of the concrete, increase strength, and add structural rigidity to your driveway.

Plan your pour, that is, the placement of your concrete, carefully. The placement of the concrete must be within the confines of the forms and must be level. Doing a "dry run" of the pour may help you to determine which plan of reinforcement will be most effective for your driveway.

Finish the slab as desired. You can broom, trowel, or otherwise finish your poured concrete slab to the desired finished look.

Cure the concrete. Curing is a critical step necessary for the concrete to reach its full strength. The prescribed method of curing involves pre-wetting the slab and applying a cure-and-seal material.

Test drive your driveway. Before you start landscaping your driveway or planting trees and shrubs along the edges, it is important to test drive it to ensure that there are no sinkholes or soft spots that need to be corrected prior to parking and using it.

Remove the forms, and repair the landscaping along the edges where the lawn was damaged in the forming process. When the forms have been removed, it is time to restore the landscaping that may have been disturbed from the building process. This may involve bringing in new soil, replacing sod, and planting plants and shrubs.

Once you have gone through all of these steps, your concrete driveway should be ready for use and will provide many years of enjoyable service.

How to Use Windows Movie Maker to Create a 'Multi Track' Soundtrack

Creating a multi track soundtrack with Windows Movie Maker is surprisingly easy! All you need is your computer's sound card and some audio files to get started. Once you know how to use Movie Maker, you'll be able to create soundtracks with multiple tracks of audio and even add video effects.

To get started, open the Start Menu and go to the "All Programs" menu. Look for the Movie Maker icon and open the program. If you don't already know how to use Movie Maker, it should be fairly easy to learn.

The next step is to get an image file. This will serve as the background for your audio soundtrack. Any image file will do fine, but make sure that it has a resolution that is high enough for whatever you will be creating.

Once you have an image file, go to the "File" menu and select "Save Project". This will open a window where you can type in whatever file name you want. It's best to choose something that helps you remember what the project is called.

Next, go into the File menu again and select "Publish Movie", or alternatively hold down the "Ctrl" key on the keyboard and press the "P" key. This will open up a window where you must choose the settings for the movie. Depending on your computer hardware, this can take a while (you were notified that this required patience).

Once the movie has been published, it is time to add audio files to the Movie Maker window. Start by dragging one of the audio files you want onto the window. Then click and drag the file onto the empty space on the left side of the movie window. The audio file should now appear there.

To create your multi track soundtrack, repeat this step for each audio file. Click and drag each audio file one by one onto the empty space in the Movie Maker window. This will allow you to create separate audio tracks.

Now you repeat steps #4-10 until you have as many audio tracks as desired. Once you have the desired number of audio tracks, it is time to create the movie file. Click on the File menu and then click on the "Save Movie File" option.

The computer will now ask you to choose the settings for the movie. Once you do this, the computer will start to generate the movie file. Depending on the size of the audio files you have, this can take a few minutes.

Finally, when the movie file has been created, it is time to add it to the Movie Maker window. Click and drag the movie file to the formerly empty space in the Movie Maker window where you dragged the audio files you wanted. Drag the movie file you created into the "Video" track.

Now go back to the File menu and select the "Save Project" option. This will save your project so you can work on it at any time. You can also go back and make adjustments later.

Writing a book can seem like a daunting task at first, but with the right preparation and resources, any writer can prepare for and complete a successful book. To get started, you'll need to choose the necessary materials, plan an organizational system, carve out a dedicated space, research your topic, and make a plan of action.  

Before beginning the writing process, choose your writing materials. Consider if you would prefer a desktop or laptop for portability, or a notebook and pen for the traditional writer’s experience. You may also consider other writing tools such as a graphic tablet, or voice-typing software. Once you have the right tools for writing, the next step is to create an organizational system. This could be a three-ring binder, a file folder, or even just a designated spot on your computer to store documents and writing notes. 

When possible, it's best to have a dedicated writing space, separate from the distraction of everyday life. Whether indoors or outdoors, your writing space should be comfy and inviting. Finding an inspirational writing location can be a great way to get the creative juices flowing. This could be a coffee shop, a park, or even a perch overlooking a beautiful view. Once you've found your space, make sure it has whatever you need to make your writing time comfortable. This could be a cozy chair, blankets for warmth, snacks, and maybe even a picture of someone to keep you motivated.

Next, it's important to determine when you work best. If you work a regular job, you may have to adjust your schedule to accommodate free time for writing. Consider your other obligations and create a writing schedule that works for you. You can opt for a strict daily routine or be more flexible and devote several days in a row to your work. Whatever you choose, make a promise to yourself that you won't get drawn away from the routine. 

It's also important to set deadlines for yourself. This could be completing a certain number of words or chapters in a certain amount of time. Setting deadlines is a delicate balance; make sure that they are achievable and don't put too much pressure on yourself. To keep you accountable for reaching your writing goals, consider finding an accountability partner. This could be another writer or a friend who is willing to keep you on track and check in with you regularly. 

Before launching into writing your book, you should determine its genre and purpose. Think about what type of book you want to write and what you hope to provide the reader. Are you providing advice, historical facts, or storytelling through creative fiction? Once you have some initial ideas, you can conduct your research and begin to outline your book. This will help to make sure that you have all the facts, figures, and characters needed to flesh out your story. 

By taking the time to carefully plan and prepare for writing a book, you'll be sure to get the creative juices flowing and stay motivated. Doing your research and outlining your book are essential steps to make sure you stay on track. By organizing your materials, creating a writing schedule, setting deadlines, and finding an accountability partner, you'll be ready to write something amazing.
