Learning to say phrases and words in Tagalog will both start the speaker on the path of fluency, as well as help them build their vocabulary. Becoming a fluent speaker of Tagalog doesn't happen overnight; it requires commitment and practice. Being able to say different phrases and words in the language can open the door to better understanding and forming sentences in Tagalog. Start by learning and practicing some of the most common phrases and words.

To make sure you get started on the right path, start with some basic phrases that are used every day. Examples include “Nasaan ang banyo” (Where is the bathroom?), “Tulong” (Help!) and “Ano 'yan” (What is that?). These common phrases will give you the confidence to open a conversation, even if you don't understand the other person's response.

To start making more complex sentences, it's important to learn and practice the words for this, that, and it. In Tagalog, “Ito’ (This), “Iyon” (That), and “Yan” (That) can mean the same thing, depending on context.

Counting numbers is another important part of getting to know the language. While saying “Sampu” (10) always means the same thing, “Labing-isa” (11), “Labing-dalawa” (12), and “Labing-tatlo” (13) will help you add more specificity to your conversations.

It's also important to learn how to respond to simple questions. Knowing how to say “Hindi” (No) or “Oo” (Yes) are essential for conversations. Knowing how to say phrases like "Mahal kita" (I love you), "Ayoko" (I don't like it), and "Salamat" (Thank you) can also help express your feelings and be polite.

Finally, which phrases you learn can depend on your environment. If you are in an environment where you will need to learn food-related words, try saying words like “Ulam” (Food), “Gutom” (Hungry), “Uhaw” (Thirsty), “Almusal” (Breakfast), “Tanghalian” (Lunch) and “Sopas” (Soup). Other expressions like “Kamusta” (How are you?) and “Teka” (Wait a minute) can also come in handy.

By practicing these phrases and words, you will be well on your way to becoming a proficient speaker of Tagalog. Take the time to learn and practice, and soon, you'll be able to have conversations in the language.

How to Play Super Mario 64 DS
Playing Super Mario 64 DS is an incredibly fun and rewarding experience with hours of exciting game play. To get the most out of your game, here are some tips to help you get through it.

Learn the Controls of the Game
Super Mario 64 DS has three different control modes that you can choose from. The traditional Mode is the one most people are familiar with and it uses the Control Pad to move Mario in the game world. The Touch Screen Mode gives you a greater level of control by using the Stylus to move Mario by dragging him and tapping on the screen to make him jump. The Motion Mode is the newest version, and it relies on the use of the Motion Sensor to move Mario in the game world. You can switch between the three modes anytime during the game, so it's important to learn all three.

Know That There are Four Different Characters in the Game
The four characters you can choose from in the game are Mario, Yoshi, Luigi and Wario. Each of them have their own unique abilities and each will be necessary at some point to beat the game. For example, Yoshi can hover and flutter jump for a short period of time, Luigi can jump higher and further than the others and Wario is the only character who can pick up and carry most items in the game.

Recognize What Happens When You First Turn On Your Game
When you first turn on the game, you'll be greeted by the unlockable opening cutscene. This cutscene will set up the story for the game and it's important to pay attention to it. Once the scene has finished, you'll be brought to the main menu, where you'll be prompted to start a new save file.

Start a New Save File
Starting a new save file will allow you to record your progress in the game, so it's important to always have a save file for your game. From the main menu, select the option to start a new game and name your save file. 

Allow the Opening Cutscene to Play
Once you've created your new save file, the opening cutscene will play. During the cutscene, you'll meet Princess Peach's assistant, Rabbit, who will give you a key to unlock the castle.

Catch the Rabbit Who Has the Key to Unlock the Castle
After the cutscene, it's up to you to catch the rabbit with the key. You can use the stylus controls to control Mario and aim and swipe to throw your cap at the rabbit. When the rabbit is caught you'll have the key to the castle, and you'll be taken to the world map.

Enter Peach's Castle
Once you've entered Peach's Castle, you'll be taken to the lobby where you'll find two portraits framed on the wall. On the right wall is a portrait that leads to the room leading to Bob-Omb Battlefield. By touching the portrait you'll be taken to the level entrance.

Enter the Room Leading to Bob-Omb Battlefield
When you're in the room leading to Bob-Omb Battlefield, your objective is to get the first Power Star in the game. You'll need to get the key to open the gate blocking the star and defeat the Big Bob-Omb Boss at the end of the level. 

Beat the First Level of Bob-Omb Battlefield
Once you have the key, you can enter the gate and get the first Power Star. After you beat the level you'll be rewarded with the star. You'll also have access to the castle's secret stars, but they won't be available until you get more stars.

Recognize That You Have a Lot More Choices for What to Do Now That You Have Your First Star
You now have access to many more areas of the game world. You'll see a few more levels to play and you'll be able to enter the castle's secret stars. When you get a certain number of stars, you'll also be able to enter the castle's basement, where Bowser bosses and more levels await you.

Continue Getting Stars
Continue playing the game until you have at least 50 stars. As you play through the levels, you'll find that each star that you collect will open new areas of the game world for you to explore. 

Beat the First Bowser Boss Battle When You Are Able To
Once you have plenty of stars (at least 50), you can open the door leading down to the castle's basement. Down in the basement you'll fight against the first Bowser boss battle. When you defeat him he'll give you a key that will open one of the castle doors, leading to the first of the four Bowser bosses.

Know What Door That the Key He Gave You Opens
The key that Bowser gives you will open a door with two star blocks in it. When you open this door you'll be taken to the level that the Bowser boss is in. Beat this level and the Bowser boss to get the star he's guarding. 

Play the Next Levels That Are Down in the Basement
Once you've beaten the first Bowser boss and have the star, you can open the door to the next Bowser boss battle. Repeat this process for the second and third Bowser boss battles and collect the stars they have. 

Beat the Second Bowser Boss Battle
Once you've beaten the second Bowser boss battle, you'll be rewarded with a key to a door that's only accessible in the basement. Beat the levels and Bowser to get the star he's guarding.

Know What This Key Opens
The key that Bowser gave you will unlock the door to the final castle level, where you'll have to get at least 70 stars to continue. This level is very difficult, because it requires you to jump on platforms at high speeds.

Play the New Levels Until You Reach 50 Stars
Once you've got 70 stars, you'll be able to beat the final Bowser boss battle and open the door to the final level. In the final level you'll need to collect 8 Red Coins and then touch the star at the end of the level. When you do, you'll be rewarded with the final Power Star.

Notice the Few New Levels That Are Available to You
Once you've collected all 70 stars, you'll be able to enter the castle's secret stars. These stars can be found by catching rabbits for keys in the mini-game room. Additionally, you'll be able to enter two more levels that become available when you have more than 50 stars. 

Collect at Least 70 Stars
Once you've collected 70 stars, you'll be able to enter the castle's basement and fight the third Bowser boss battle. Beat him and collect the last power star, but don't forget to watch the credits at the end of the game.

Beat the Final Bowser Boss Battle
When you've collected all 70 stars, you'll enter the castle's basement and fight the final Bowser boss battle. Once you defeat him, you'll be rewarded with a star he's guarding.

Watch the Final Cutscene and the Credits
After you've defeated the final Bowser boss battle, you'll be taken to the credits. Once the credits have finished, you'll get to watch the game's final cutscene and then the game will end.

Catch Rabbits to Get Keys for the Mini-Game Room
Throughout the game you can find rabbits running around in the world, usually underneath trees or out in the open. If you catch one, you can use it to get a key to the mini-game room, which is full of mini-games and other interesting activities.

Find the Castle's Secret Stars
As you progress through the game, you'll be able to find stars that are hidden around the castle's exterior. These secret stars are hidden in places that are hard to access, so you may have to use Yoshi's hover or Luigi's high jump to get to them.

Use the Touch Screen Map to Your Advantage
The touch screen map is incredibly useful in many aspects of the game. You can touch it to bring up a map of the area you're in, which will help you find hidden items and stars. Additionally, it's easier to track your progress with the map, so make sure you use it whenever possible.

Know What Stars Look Like After You've Already Gotten Them
The game will remember which Power Stars you have collected, so it's important to remember what they look like after you've already gotten them. This will help you make sure you collect every star in the game and get the best ending.

How to Clean an Xbox 360 Slim
Cleaning your Xbox 360 Slim is an effective way to keep your beloved console performing optimally without overworking the fans, which in turn helps prolong its lifespan. Here's a step-by-step guide for cleaning your Xbox 360 Slim:

Position your Xbox so you can remove the side panel vent. To access the interior of your Xbox, you'll need to first unscrew the caseed vent on one side. To do this, you'll need to tilt the console so the side you need to access is facing up.

Remove the vent from the Xbox. Unscrew the vent and set aside. This will give you the room to access the side panel release tabs.

Gain access to the side panel release tabs. Use a flat-head screwdriver to gently pry open the side panel to access the tabs. Disengage them in preparation for taking off the side panel.

Disengage the side panel release tabs. Carefully slide two release tabs towards the center of your Xbox to unclip the side panel. Then slide the panel off.

Remove the wireless card. Unclasp the antenna cable from the wireless card. Reach into the Xbox and pop off the plastic clip to separate the wireless card from the base.

Take off the vent from the other side panel. Unscrew the vent from the other side of the Xbox and set it aside. Then, access the release tabs for the second side panel.

Disengage the release tabs for the second side panel. If you've properly disengaged the side panel release tabs, you can easily take this panel off the Xbox by gently sliding it off.

Locate the back panel release. Use a Philips screwdriver to remove four screws from the back panel of your Xbox. This will give you access to the back panel release tab.

Make a hole to gain access to the back panel release. Once you unscrew these screws, you'll see a notch within the circle. Take a drill or sharpened pen and make a small hole in the circle to get to the release tab.

Prepare to release the first set of inner tabs. Once you've gained access to the back panel release tab, press the tab and tilt the back of your Xbox upwards. This will allow you to access the first set of inner tabs.

Release two casing tabs. Use two flat-head screwdrivers to delicately release two tabs from either side of the casing.

Disengage the remaining two tabs. To remove the casing, slide the remaining tabs to the center and lift the casing off your Xbox.

Position the Xbox for casing removal. Once the case has been taken off, set the console on its side with the open edge facing up.

Remove the case. From here you can now completely remove the casing of the Xbox to get down to the inner workings of your gaming console.

Take apart the inner metal casing. Unhook any ribbon cables from the Xbox motherboard. Then, use a Philips head screwdriver to take off the two screws on each of the side panel vents and the four screws that hold the hard drive in place.

Remove the inner casing. Grab the inner casing where the hard drive was and gently pull it away from the console.

Lay the faceplate flat on your work surface. Place the internal metal casing onto the surface and locate the Xbox drive, an alfenine platter copper disc that will fit into a groove on the motherboard.

Remove the drive. With a Phillips-head screwdriver, unscrew the drive and set it aside.

Remove the fan shield. It's important to clean out the fan blades to ensure that your Xbox's internal fans are working optimally. To get to the fan blades, unscrew the existing fan shield and pull it off.

Loosen dust with a soft bristle brush. Use a small, soft bristled brush to loosen any built-up dust around the fan blades.

Clean the rear drive area if necessary. If needed, clean the metal rings of the rear drive area with your brush. Make sure to move the brush around the area to get out all the dust and dirt.

Remove dust from the Xbox with pressurized air. Using a can of pressurized air is a great way to get down and dirty dust from the Xbox's fan blades, motherboard, and buttons. Be careful and make sure to stay away from the optical drive.

Reinstall internal components. Start by reattaching the Xbox drive and putting the inner casing back in place. Add back the fan shield and secure it with screws.

Reattach the top cover. Place the top cover back onto the Xbox and secure it with two screws.

Refasten the black metal casing screws. Reattach the black metal casing to the inner the metal casing and refasten the screws that hold it in place.

Replace the bottom cover. Put the bottom cover back onto the Xbox and secure it with two screws.

Reattach the side panel with the access door. Place the side panel back, aligning the access door, and secure it with the release tabs.

Reinsert the wireless card and refasten the last side panel. Securely reattach the wireless card to the antenna cable and then place the second side panel back over the console. Use the screws to secure the panel.

Once this is done, you may want to use the pre-packaged compressed air with a straw attachment to get any remaining dust out of the Xbox crevices. Monitor your console temperature for a few days and make sure no new dust appears. Your Xbox should now be in great condition and ready to take on another gaming session!

Are you dreaming of designing and building your very own bridge out of popsicle sticks? After all, stable and strong bridges are a marvel of engineering and construction! With the help of some everyday household items and a little bit of creativity, you can make your own sturdy and stable bridge out of popsicle sticks.

Before you start, you should understand the basic principles and materials needed. Determine the length of your bridge - the most important factor when it comes to building a bridge out of popsicle sticks. Once you have determined the size of your bridge, it is time to gather the supplies. In one trip to the store, you will need to purchase popsicle sticks, wood glue, superglue, and a ruler or measuring tape. Trying to maximize your possibilities, it is helpful to have a variety of different size popsicle sticks and a variety of colors for each.

Ready your work space for action. It is extremely important to make sure that the area that you plan on working on is very well organized and clear of all unnecessary items. A cluttered work space can lead to missed measurements or time wasted.

Once your space is ready, it is time to decide on the kind of bridge you will make. The most basic bridge structures that can be built with popsicle sticks are simple beam bridges and truss bridges. The more complicated designs arestructures such as Arch Bridges or Cantilevers. Once you decide on the structure of your bridge, it is time to imagine a blueprint for your bridge.

Draw your blueprint and plan out your truss beam layout in finer detail.For most bridge structures, you will need to create at least four trusses. Each truss will consist of two sticks laid across each other at an angle, with two additional sticks laid across at both ends to help create a strong truss beam structure. Glue your truss beams together, and when all four trusses are complete, lay them out side by side with the deck of your bridge facing up. Allow for the glue to set for a short while before continuing.

Next, measure your cross supports for your truss. Cut and glue two short popsicle sticks at 90-degree angles for each truss beam. This is to create support to ensure a stable bridge. Make sure that these beams are the correct size in order to ensure a strong bridge.

Now, it is time to unite the truss beams together. Lay out your trusses and glue them together at the sides, over lapping by at least one inch on both sides. fit snug.

Now that your truss beams are complete, lay out the deck of your bridge. Starting at one end, lay the popsicle sticks into the shape of the deck of your bridge. Make sure to keep the sticks at an even distance apart from each other and that all sticks fit snugly together.

Anchor your deck with staggered lengthwise supports. This is to ensure that your structure is stable and won't break down. Starting at one side of the bridge, measure six popsicle sticks starting at the edge of the bridge. Glue them together at an angle and add two more below it to form an 'anchor' for the bridge deck. Alternate the length of the sticks at the side as you go along.

Measure for cradle supports for your deck and truss joiners. Cut and glue three sticks to the cradle supports; two on the outside and a slightly longer one in the center to form a triangle. These truss joiners help to unite the trusses together and to support the deck.

Now, unite the truss walls. You may want to consider having a friend help you for this part of the bridge assembly, or you might use books to lean your trusses up against to make gluing more manageable. This will give you a better idea of how it will look when completed. Lay additional deck support beams as needed.

Attach your deck, if desired. Stagger the deck boards across the trusses to ensure their strength and glue them into place.

Add upper support beams.If you have long popsicle sticks, you can simply lay these across the top of the struts and then glue each into place. This will add extra stability and strength to your bridge. You can also choose to add an extra layer of support for the bridge by gluing support beams underneath the trusses.

Finally, take a step back and admire your bridge. Your bridge should be strong and ready to support the weight of your toy cars, marbles or your imagination! The possibilities are endless when it comes to building bridges with popsicle sticks. Have fun and enjoy!

How to Create a Low Budget Movie'

Making a low-budget movie is an ambitious undertaking, but with the right planning and drive, you can bring an amazing film to life with just a spark of creativity. Before you dive into the world of filmmaking, it is important to determine whether or not you are passionate about being a director or creating a movie. Once you have a clear plan for the project, you can begin the process of creating a movie on a tight budget. 

The first step in creating a low-budget movie is deciding whether or not you really want to make a movie. To create a movie, you will need an idea, a plan, and a vision. It is important to have a clear understanding of what you want the movie to be before beginning the process. Progressive aphasia is a degenerative disorder of the brain involving the gradual loss of language ability. It is debilitating to the person affected as well as to the people who rely on that person's abilities to communicate. However, there are ways to treat progressive aphasia and help manage the disease's progression.

The first step in treating progressive aphasia is to visit a speech and language therapist. With the help of this professional, people can work to address the difficulties associated with language and communication. This may include working on the understanding of written and/or spoken words, as well as the ability to express oneself with the appropriate words and articulation.

In addition to visits with a speech and language therapist, it is important to know that progressive aphasia is a condition that can be managed but not cured. There is no reversing or slowing the disease's progression, but it can be managed to help maintain communication abilities. Joining a support group with others who suffer from the same condition can be very helpful in this regard. Information about the patient's illness should also be carried with him or her in case it is necessary to explain the condition to others.

In addition to treatments provided by a speech and language therapist, some individuals with progressive aphasia may be able to pursue modified duties regarding their occupation. It is important to discuss such endeavors with a physician or employer. Likewise, doctors should conduct regular clinical exams in order to gain insight into the patient's condition and progress. If needed, a CT or MRI can be performed to rule out other degenerative brain diseases in addition to progressive aphasia.

Lastly, it is crucial to understand the causes of progressive aphasia and the course of the disease. A physician or speech language pathologist should provide information related to disease, including what to expect in terms of symptoms and treatment. Additionally, reading books or participating in additional forms of research is beneficial in order to gain a deeper understanding of this condition and how to best treat it. 

Overall, progressive aphasia is a difficult and life-altering condition that cannot be cured. However, with proper attention and treatment, individuals will be able to manage and lessen the severity of the disease's effects. Through an appointment with a speech and language therapist, a support group, and a knowledge of the causes and course of the condition, individuals can find hope and help in dealing with progressive aphasia.

In today's world, buying products online can be a tricky process. One particular area of concern is how to avoid purchasing fake designer sunglasses on eBay. Fake designer sunglasses are counterfeit items that appear to be the genuine product but without the quality and craftsmanship that you would expect. To ensure you purchase only authentic designer sunglasses on eBay, there are certain important measures you should take before parting with your hard-earned money.

When looking for designer sunglasses on eBay, you need to take extra care because unfortunately many unscrupulous individuals take advantage of unsuspecting buyers.

Before you buy, it is important to look closely at the listing description and check for any discrepancies. For example, does the language explain the item for sale properly, or is it misleading? Is the item being sold as ‘original’ or ‘inspired’ by the designer? If it is not explicitly stated as an original, avoid purchasing it.

Also be sure to pay attention to the photos of the sunglasses. Do they show any manufacturer’s packaging or is there just a photo of the sunglasses themselves? Packaging is very important when it comes to authenticity because good packaging is often a sign that the sunglasses are genuine.

Moreover, if the photos show any labels or other design details than those you would find in the store, it could suggest that the sunglasses are counterfeit. Fake designer sunglasses often vary from the genuine product in certain subtle ways, which is why it is important to cross-reference their details such as logos and font styles before you purchase.

Another important thing to look out for is the model number, which should be stamped on the barcode on the sunglasses. To verify the authenticity of the sunglasses, be sure to match the barcode on the item you’re intending to purchase with that of the manufacturer’s website.

Additionally, many designer sunglasses will have an internal code or serial number written on the inside of one of the temple arms. Often, such codes can be used to verify the product's authenticity.

Be wary of any listings boasting an unbeatably cheap price tag and be on the lookout for any wording that includes the phrases ‘replica’, ‘replicas’, ‘copies’, ‘fake’ or ‘high quality imitation’. If a price looks too good to be true, it probably is, so do your research and exercise caution.

Furthermore, if the item being sold uses photographs taken directly from the designer’s website rather than original images, it could be a sign that the sunglasses are not authentic.

If the glasses have any sticker adornments such as fake designer labels, this is another sign that the product is not genuine. In addition, beware of any sunglasses with words like ‘style’ or ‘look’ in the title, these types of items are also commonly counterfeit.

Any item sold on eBay should also have some form of guarantee, so be sure to read the listing carefully and establish what buyer protection measures have been put in place by the seller.

It is best to contact the seller with any questions or queries you have about the product and never be afraid to ask for proof of authentication. An honest seller should be able to provide adequate proof of the item’s authenticity.

Finally, be sure to read the seller’s feedback and reviews from past customers. If the feedback is all overwhelmingly negative, it is probably best to move on to the next listing. Also, beware of very new sellers. They may offer designer sunglasses at rock bottom prices but there is a strong chance that they are doing so dishonestly.

Buying designer sunglasses on eBay doesn’t have to be a daunting task if the steps outlined here are taken. So the next time you’re looking to purchase designer sunglasses on eBay, be sure to take note of the above tips and you should enjoy a successful shopping experience.

This type of restraining order requires the petitioner to provide evidence of abuse or harm, and the respondent, or the person the restraining order is being filed against, has an opportunity to present their case in court.

How to Make Mozzarella Cheese with Culture

Making mozzarella cheese at home is easier than you think. With just a few simple ingredients and some equipment, you can make a soft and delicious cheese you and your family will love.

To begin, you will need cultures to make mozzarella. Place 2 to 3 tbsp. of either kefir yogurt or prepared mesophilic cultures into a separate, sterile bowl. Add a bit of the milk you will use to prepare the cheese and mix until it is fully dissolved. Place the yogurt into a fridge until you are ready to make mozzarella cheese.

Repeat this process to continue making kefir yogurt. Make sure to store it in the fridge until it is ready to use.

Next, you will need to begin preparing the cheese. Start with a gallon of whole milk, if possible. Then, place the gallon of milk into a pot on your stove. If the milk is pasteurized, you can heat it up to 88-90 degrees Fahrenheit to facilitate the cultures. Warm the milk to 88 to 90 degrees F. To accomplish this, place the burner on low and warm very slowly while occasionally stirring the milk until reaching the desired temperature.

Once the temperature is reached, it is time to add the rennet. This is a natural enzyme found in the stomachs of cows and other animals. To use, dilute the rennet in clean water 1:10 and then pour it into the warm milk. Allow the rennet to remain in the milk for 20 minutes. Then, test for a clean break by poking your finger through the coagulated milk.

After the clean break is achieved, the curdling process is complete. You will need to cut up the curds into small pieces, about an inch square. To do this, use a whisk to chop up the coagulated milk. Then, cover the pot and let the curds rest for 4 hours while the fermentation continues.

Once the 4-hour period is up, carefully scoop the curds into a cheesecloth strainer and press the whey from them. Test the pH using the pH meter by testing the whey accumulated in the holes.

After testing, it is time to begin shaping the cheese. Place the curds onto a cutting board and use a stirring spoon to break it into chunks. Then, take these chunks and separate them into three equal bowls.

Heat a large pot of water to approximately 180 degrees Fahrenheit. In the meantime, pour 1 to 2 cups of hot water into the bowl with the cheese curds. Let sit for two minutes and then dump the water out. Take the stirring spoon and begin to push all the cheese curds together. Once a single mass forms, it can be moved to the other two bowls.

To create the traditional mozzarella ball shape, take a 2-inch strip from the formed mass and fold small sections over itself 3 times. Then, force it through your index finger and thumb and the mozzarella cheese is complete.

One last step remains. Place the fresh mozzarella ball into the bowl with cool water. This will firm up the mozzarella and make it easier to handle. Place the mozzarella balls into the ice-cold water and store in the refrigerator until ready to use. 

Now you can enjoy homemade mozzarella cheese with family and friends. Even better, you can impress them with your skills in cheese making. Enjoy!

Administering a rabies vaccination is a very important and necessary step in protecting oneself and others from rabies and preventing it from spreading. For those looking to learn how to administer a rabies vaccination, read on for instructions.

To begin, it is important to practice proper hygiene by washing your hands thoroughly with antibacterial soap and clean water. Once this is done, explain the procedure to the person who is going to receive the vaccination and prepare the necessary materials for the vaccine and put on sterile gloves. 

Once the materials are all in place, take the package insert and read it carefully to understand the instructions for administering the vaccine. Following that, take a cotton ball soaked in alcohol and wipe the top of the sterile water bottle and the vial. After this, take a 1 ml syringe and insert it into the rubber on top of the sterile water bottle. Aspirate 1 ml of rabies vaccine using the syringe and then, check for air bubbles on the syringe.

The infected person should then be checked for any allergic reactions prior to the injection. When ready, choose a proper injection site and wipe it with a cotton ball soaked in alcohol. With your non-dominant hand, pinch the skin and then, using your dominant hand and the thumb, inject the vaccine at a 90 degree angle and push the plunger. Following this, put a cotton ball on the injection site and apply pressure.

Next, discard the used syringe and needle in a puncture proof container, remove the sterile gloves and wash your hands thoroughly. Lastly, be aware of how the vaccine uses antibodies to fight the virus, do not use an expired vaccine, get the vaccine before you are bitten or if you are going to be in areas with animals known to carry rabies and talk to your doctor if any side effects or reactions occur. 

It is also important to make sure your pets get their rabies vaccination regularly, do not let your pets roam free and call local animal control if a wild animal enters your property. By following these steps, you can help protect yourself and others from rabies.

How to Field Strip a M 16 Service Rifle
Field stripping is a necessary part of rifle maintenance, allowing for a thorough inspection of the inside of the rifle. For those with some familiarity with the M 16 Service Rifle, it can be done in just a few quick steps. Follow this guide to learn how to field strip your M 16 in no time. 

To begin, the rifle must be unloaded and the firing chamber inspected to be sure the rifle is unloaded and safe to handle. 

Once unloaded, the process of field stripping begins as follows: 

1. Lock the bolt to the rear. This ensures that the firing pin cannot slip out.

2. Push the rear dis-assembly pin, located above the pistol grip. This pin secures the upper and lower receivers together. 

3. Repeat step 2 on the front dis-assembly pin located above the magazine well. 

4. Separate the upper and lower receivers by pulling them apart.

5. Remove the upper and lower hand grips by pulling down on the O-ring located in front of the magazine well while pulling the hand grips away from the barrel. This will remove the hand grip and allow access to the bolt carrier group. 

6. Remove the bolt carrier group by pulling the charging handle to the rear. This releases the bolt carrier group from the rear of the rifle. 

7. Remove the charging handle by lining the détentes up with the recesses in the upper receiver housing and pulling downward. This removes the charging handle and the handle spring and buffer, which are located inside. 

8. Remove the buffer assembly from the lower receiver. This is done by simply pulling the buffer assembly out of the lower receiver. 

9. Pick up the bolt carrier group. The firing pin is retained by a cotter key located at the rear of the bolt carrier. Pull the cotter key out to remove the firing pin and spring. 

10. Remove the bolt located inside the front of the bolt carrier by simply pulling it out.

11. Remove the cam pin located at the front of the bolt carrier by turning it so that it clears the gas tube and then pull it out. This will release the bolt from the bolt carrier. 

12. Removing the extractor pin and extractor is not necessary for field stripping a rifle. 

13. Open the compartment in the butt-stock by depressing the latch. This opens up the back of the rifle and exposes the buffer assembly.

The M16 Service Rifle is a reliable firearm, but it is important to routinely inspect the internals of the rifle for any wear and tear or damage that may have occurred. Field stripping is an important part of ensuring that your rifle performs optimally and safely. Taking apart and putting together your rifle is a necessary part of understanding its operation and function. And now that you know how to field strip your M16, you’ll be able to keep your rifle in top condition!

How to Set Up iTunes
Setting up iTunes is a relatively simple process most of the time, but it can be confusing if you already have an old version installed, or if you’re not sure what preferences to change. Here’s a step-by-step guide to getting started and making the most out of your experience.

Download the iTunes software from the Apple website.
The first step to using iTunes is to download the program from the Apple website. Depending on your operating system, iTunes will download either as a setup file or an application. Make sure to remember where you save the download.

Uninstall old versions.
If you’ve already installed a version of iTunes on your computer, you may need to uninstall the old version. This will make sure your new iTunes install runs smoothly.

Find the downloaded setup program.
Once your download is complete, locate the setup program or application that was downloaded to your computer. It may be located on your desktop, in a Downloads folder, or anywhere else you typically save files.

Run the setup program.
Now that you’ve found the downloaded setup program, you want to run it. That will begin the installation process for iTunes.

Restart your computer after installing.
After installation is complete, a restart will help to ensure everything is working properly.

Start iTunes.
Once the restart is complete, you should now be able to start iTunes from either the Start menu on a Windows PC, or the Applications folder on Mac.

Click the small profile icon next to the “Search Store” bar.
When you start iTunes, you’ll see a small icon with a human profile near the top-right corner of the window. Click on this icon.

Enter your Apple ID information, or click “Create Apple ID.”
Once you’ve clicked on the icon, iTunes will ask you to sign in or create an Apple ID. If you don’t have an Apple ID, you’ll need to create one here before you can continue. The Apple ID will allow you to manage your purchases, share content, and more with other Apple devices on your account.

Deauthorize an old computer (if necessary).
If you’ve previously installed iTunes on another computer, you may need to deauthorize that computer before you can install it on this computer. Open iTunes and look in the Account menu for the option to deauthorize.

Click the “Edit” menu (Windows) or “iTunes” menu (Mac).
From either the top-left corner, you’ll find an Edit or iTunes menu (depending on your operating system).

Select “Preferences.”
Once you’ve opened the Edit or iTunes menu, you’ll find the Preferences option. Click on this.

Set your “General” preferences.
From the Preferences window, you can set a wide range of preferences for how iTunes runs and looks. You’ll start with the General Preferences. Under this tab, you can set things like whether or not iTunes should display in your dock, whether or not the application should check for updates, and more.

Set your “Playback” preferences.
Under the Playback tab, you can set various playback settings, including whether or not you want the sound to come out of the external speakers connected to your computer or if you’d like to use the computer’s built-in speakers.

Set your “Sharing” preferences.
From the Sharing tab, you can decide whether or not you want to share your library with other computers on your home network. This setting enables Home Sharing.

Set your “Store” preferences.
The Store tab in the Preferences window will let you decide whether or not you want iTunes to automatically download purchases made with your Apple ID. You may also want to set up a password for purchases if you don’t want your kids buying things with your account.

Set your “Parental” preferences.
If you’d like to restrict what kind of content is allowed in your iTunes library, you can do so with the Parental tab. Here, you can decide whether or not to allow certain types of music, movies, or TV shows based on their rating.

Set your “Device” preferences.
The Device tab is only helpful if you sync with an Apple device, like an iPhone or iPad. Here, you can choose to sync contacts and calendars, as well as encrypt your device’s backups.

Set your “Advanced” preferences.
From the Advanced tab, you can control various iTunes settings, like where to save your library files and how the program should handle imports and CD burning.

Add music files to your iTunes library.
Now that you’ve adjusted all of your preferences, you can start adding files to your library. To do so, find some music or audio files on your computer that you’d like to add. You can add them to iTunes either by dragging and dropping them onto the program window, or by using the File > Add File to Library option in the menu.

Add movie files to your iTunes library.
You can also add movies to your iTunes library. This works the same way as adding music files. Just find the videos you want to add, and drag and drop them into the iTunes window.

Rip audio CDs to your library.
If you have an audio CD that you want to add to your library, you can use iTunes to rip the CD into individual audio files. To do this, insert the CD into your computer’s drive and click the small downward arrow icon next to the “ripple” icon at the top. iTunes will then ask you to set the encoding settings and format for the resulting files.

Purchase content to add it to your library.
You can also purchase content on the iTunes Store that will be added to your library. This will require you to have an Apple ID and a payment method associated with it.

Connect your Apple device to your computer.
If you have an Apple device that you’d like to sync with your iTunes library, it’s time to connect it to your computer. Plug in the device and iTunes should recognize it almost instantly.

Select your device in iTunes.
With the device plugged in, you’ll see it pop up in the list of devices. Click on it to access settings for it.

Set your backup options.

How to Take Care of Puppies
Taking care of a puppy is a big responsibility, but with proper care and attention, your pup will grow up to be a loyal and loving companion. Before you bring your new puppy home, make sure you’re familiar with the steps you need to take in order to give them a happy and healthy life. 

First and foremost, make sure that the puppy you’re getting is right for you and your family. If you can, familiarize yourself with the breed of your pup and the temperament they tend to have. It’s also a good idea to research any prospective puppy’s parents and genetic history.

Once you’ve decided to bring home your new pup, it’s important to puppy-proof your house. Move any dangerous objects out of reach and make sure that all cords and wires are kept away from your pup’s chewing mouth. Provide enough space for the puppy to roam and explore.

Purchase two metal (preferably stainless steel) bowls — one for food and one for water. Get him a high-quality puppy food to ensure he is getting the nutrients he needs. You may also want to get him some quality puppy treats to reward him for good behavior.

Provide a puppy bed — a soft, warm, comfortable space where your pup can go to relax and sleep. Shower him with toys — chew and squeaker toys are recommended for puppies. This will also help him develop his natural chewing instinct.

Apart from his social needs, make sure you have all the necessary grooming tools for your puppy — a nylon harness, flat collar (webbed nylon or leather), and metal tag. Get him used to these items by familiarizing him with them in a positive way.

Before bringing him to his forever home, it’s important to get the puppy comfortable with being in a new environment. Pet him often and handle him with care. While taking him for walks, it’s also important to protect him and guard him from potential mishaps. Have a microchip implanted for the sake of identification and/or possible recovery.

Provide your puppy with a safe area to play — this could be a large enclosed space such as a garden or lawn. If you don’t have space, you can always designate a particular area of your home where your pup can move around and play without any risk of injuries.

Choose the right dog food for your pup. Speak to your veterinarian about the proper amount of food to feed him. Make sure you follow special feeding guidelines for small or toy breed dogs. Avoid buffet-style feeding — featuring puppy food on the floor, for example — which can lead to unhealthy overeating among puppies. When feeding your puppy, watch him to make sure he eats it appropriately. Don’t feed your puppy table scraps; some foods that are ok for humans can be toxic to pet dogs. 

It’s important to ensure that your puppy always has access to plenty of fresh, clean water. Make sure your puppy’s environment is safe. Keep an eye on the temperature, especially during hot days, and provide him with adequate cooling solutions.

Your puppy needs to get plenty of exercises. Take him for walks daily and throw him toys now and then. It’s also crucial to socialize your puppy and get him familiar with other animals and people. 

If you don’t already have one, choose a veterinarian who is located nearby and who is experienced with the breed of your puppy. Ask your friends and family for recommendations. Have your pup vaccinated according to schedule and consider having him spayed or neutered. Make vet trips fun by offering treats to your pup and trying to make the experience a positive one.

Keep an eye on your puppy to catch any health problems early. Brush him daily to keep his skins healthy. Trim his nails when they grow too long and make sure you care for his teeth and gums. Only bathe him when he needs it; harsh shampoos can damage his skin. Establish a potty training routine and consider crate training your puppy, which helps them learn the difference between “sleep time” and “play time”. Teach your puppy basic commands such as “sit”, “speak”, and “lie down”, and get him used to car rides by taking him to places where he can explore, play, and learn. Consider enrolling in an obedience class for puppies — it’s a great way to gauge your pup’s progress and ensure his safe growth and development. With proper care and attention, you can look forward to many years of loyalty and companionship with your pup.

How to Chip a Golf Ball
If you’re looking to improve your golf game, then you’ve come to the right place. Chipping the ball is perceived as one of the tougher aspects of the quintessential sport, but with some practice, it is an easily obtainable skill. To get you started on your chipping journey, here’s a comprehensive guide on how to chip a golf ball.

Swing with your full upper body. Use your entire upper body to facilitate the chip. This means incorporating your whole torso, from your arms to your legs, when you swing the club by lifting your arms up and pushing with your hips and legs. The resulting momentum will help you sink your ball in the hole with much more ease.

Swing downward. Your initial contact with the ball should be in a downward strike. If you attempt to slice the ball, you will be unable to get maximum distance and control from your swing as the force is not concentrated in the same area.

Raise the club as it makes impact with the golf ball. While you'll be able to maximize your force and control by swinging downward, scooping up when your club meets the ball will give the ball the air it needs to escape the grass. To position your club appropriately for this, lift your wrists and elbows when at the peak of your backswing.

Follow through with the motion after the ball has made contact. When you let go of the club, don’t completely stop your arm and leg motion. Let the motion carry through until the end so your club makes contact with the ball without you having to grapple it down.

Watch where the ball ends up. Visual feedback is key to making incremental improvements with each practice. Look where you hit the ball and take note if you’re consistently slicing or hooking it.

Decide if the situation warrants chipping the ball. Using a chip shot is usually more beneficial when there is some type of material like sand or grass between you and the center of the hole. When in doubt, take a few practice swings and decide if you can find a suitable angle among the ground.

Choose a club with the right ratio. A ratio refers to the distance you want the ball to fly compared to the distance you want it to roll after. A common ratio used for chipping is 8:1, which roughly equals 8 yards of flight for every 1 yard of roll upon contact.

Hold your club firmly. With any shot, including chipping, you should hold the golf club firmly. Maintaining a solid grasp on the handle of the club is critical to the success of your shot.

Align the ball with your sternum. Much of a good chip in golf revolves around proper stance and positioning. When you have perfected your grip on the club, get into your stance. Turning your body away from the center of the hole by a few degrees, make sure the ball is aligned with your sternum.

Keep your chest up. Keep your arms back and your chest up throughout the course of your swing. Standing with good posture will ensure that your club maintains a consistent contact with the ball as your arms follow through after your legs have pushed you forward.

Place your feet closely together. Your feet should be planted firmly on the ground while you execute a chip. When positioning, keep your feet close together for maximum support and grip. This will help with weight transfer when swinging, making sure your arms don’t go too far ahead.

Open up your hip. A proper swing will disperse the exertion throughout your upper body, rather than packing the strain into one area. Open up your hip to the target, subtly twisting your torso as you swing your club in the intended direction.

Get lessons. Lessons will accelerate the learning process. It’s an excellent way to check and critique your technique to identify areas of improvement. They’ll also provide you with tips and techniques to find the best chipping formula for you.

Train using an elongated club. If you’re having any issues with footing and stance, an elongated club will act as a helpful indicator of when you go too far. It will also prevent you from accidentally interfering with the natural path of the swing when chipping.

Make phantom contact with the ball as you work out your stance. In some cases, the ball might not rest safely in the center of the club, so you must take measures to determine what could be causing this misalignment. To solve this, make motions to ‘chop’ the ball without the ball being there and notice where your hands and arms come at contact.

Practice every week. Chipping is a skill, like any other sport. You need to practice regularly to become familiar with the motion and form. Dedicate some time every week to practicing.

Experiment with different chipping stances. Although there are certain rights and wrong when it comes to golf stances, part of the fun of learning involves figuring out your personal style. Move around the course and try a few variations here and there to see how they affect the results of your chip shots.

With this guide, you’re now set to start competing in golf and improve your game. Remember that form and technique are essential, so practice every day and you’ll be a pro at chipping the ball in no time!

Building steps is a task that requires a great amount of precision, accuracy, and often a bit of math. It's important to make sure the stairs are the proper size, the correct run, and are positioned correctly in the space they'll occupy. When you're ready to begin, just follow these steps to have your stairs built in no time.

Step 1: Measure the height of the area where you will install the stairs. Measure the overall height from the bottom of the stairs to the area at the top they will be connected to. This is called "the rise". Write down this measurement.

Step 2: Divide the total rise by the typical rise per step. A basic rule of thumb is 7-1/2 inches per step. Divide the total rise of your stairs by this figure to calculate the total number of steps.

Step 3: Divide the total rise by the number of steps to get the actual rise per step. This will tell you how much vertical height each of your steps will need.

Step 4: Establish the run of each step to get the total run of the staircase. To do this, you'll need to determine how wide of a step you'll need. The ideal running width is around 11-1/2 inches. Multiply the number of steps you determined previously by this figure to get the total running width of your staircase.

Step 5: Calculate the length of the stringers. The stringers, or "beam" of your staircase, are the boards that will hold the actual treads and risers. To get the total length of your stringers, you'll need to add two inches of space for each tread to account for the rises, and then measure from the bottom of the bottom of the stairs to the top of the floor.

Step 6: Determine how you will attach the stairs to the existing structure. This will be dependent on the connection points you have available to you. Research the proper methods for attaching them securely.

Step 7: Determine how many stringers you will need. Take the overall run of your staircase, and add four inches for the bottom and top coffers (boards that connect to railing posts). Divide the total length of your stringers by this figure to get the number of stringers you will need.

Step 8: Lay out a sufficiently long piece of 2x12-inch (5cmx3m) lumber. This will be your template for the shape of your steps. Measure and mark the lumber accordingly to fit the total run of your staircase, and draw additional marks on the lumber to indicate each of the steps. 

Step 9: Mark a framer's square to the height and depth of your steps. To do this, you will need to adjust the height of the square so it matches the figure you divided the total rise by in step 3.

Step 10: Modify the top of the stringer to account for the overall angle. If the angle of the stairs is greater than or equal to 25 degrees, you'll need to make adjustments to the top of the stringer to account for any overhang.

Step 11: Measure and mark each step along the piece of lumber. Using the marks you've created on the template of the stringer, use a carpenter's square to measure and mark the exact length of each of the steps.

Step 12: Use a circular saw or hand saw to cut the step-notches into the stringers. Wear protective eye and earwear, and double check your measurements for accuracy before making any cuts.

Step 13: Square off the bottom of the stringer so that it will sit flush with the ground. Cut the bottom of the stringer so it is perpendicular to the length of the entire staircase.

Step 14: Test the stringer by setting it in place. Take the stringer to the actual location of the staircase and set it in the area where you plan to install the stairs. Make sure it is level and fits within your allotted space. 

Step 15: Use the first stringer as a template off of which to base the next stringers. Measure the first stringer in order to make sure each successive stringer matches the height and depth of the first.

Step 16: Install the stringers. Use 2x4-inch lumber to construct the structure from the bottom of the stairs to the mounting point at the top. Secure the structures by bolting them together.

Step 17: Secure and stabilize the stringers by installing risers, or toe boards (optional). Make sure each riser is securely nailed to the stringers in order to hand the knotted treads.

Step 18: Cut and install the risers. Measure and cut the risers to fit within the dimensions of the stringers and ensure each riser fits securely into place.

Step 19: Cut and install the treads. Measure the length and width of each step when cutting the treads. Install carpeting or other non-skid material on each tread for safety.

Step 20: Fit any trim board underneath the overhanging tread and nail to the riser. This board provides additional support for the staircase, and is a great way to add a decorative touch to the design.

Step 21: Varnish, paint, or seal your steps if necessary. Finish the steps by varnishing or painting them according to your taste and the aesthetics of the home.

When you have completed these steps, you will have a completed staircase that is securely installed in its space. Following these steps will ensure that your staircase is correctly sized and positioned, giving you an attractive, long-lasting staircase.

How to Become a Free Software Hacker
If you are seriously considering becoming a free software hacker, it is important to remember that you need to be dedicated and ambitious. Hacking can be a fun and rewarding experience when done properly. Here are some tips to help you get started and become an expert free software hacker.

First of all, you need to choose the right operating system for your free software hacking needs. Commonly, open source systems such as Linux, FreeBSD, and OpenBSD are preferred. All of these options provide the user with a large set of open source tools and applications that can be used for free software hacking. There are also some more commercial options available, such as Apple's OS X.

Next, it is important to learn the basics of using the command line. You can use this to make changes to files, build code, run programs, or do just about anything. Many open source applications are written in either Bash or Python, and being familiar with them even at a basic level can increase your productivity.

Your next step is to learn a popular programming language. Ideally, you should work with the language until you reach a level of comfort with which you can code without assistance. The most popular languages in free software development are C, C++, and Java. However, Python and Ruby have started to grow in popularity as well.

Once you have become comfortable with programming languages, it may be useful to take the next step and learn how to use an integrated development environment (IDE) tool. These tools allow you to code more quickly and efficiently by providing text editing, project management, debugging, and more. The two most popular IDE tools for free software development are NetBeans and Eclipse.

Advanced users may also want to consider learning the command-line based text editors Emacs and VI. These tools provide a lot of power and flexibility in terms of customizing the editing environment. While not required for free software hacking, they can come in very handy.

In order to build up your skills with free software projects, it is recommended that you start with a smaller project first and then move on to a larger one. This can help you to get acquainted with the process of development and also give you much-needed practice.

Before starting work in a project, make sure to contact the administrator of the project and read the rules. Following the rules of the project is essential not only to ensure successful results but also to ensure the longevity of the project.

Try to stick with the project for a few months. This will give you plenty of time to learn and grow, and it will also show potential employers and clients that you have the dedication and ambition to stick with something for the long haul.

Once you have developed enough skill with a smaller project, it is time to move on to a larger, more serious project. Research some of the more popular projects and try to get accepted into one of them. The acceptance process can be intimidating, but remember that the more experienced developers will be aware of your skills and will be more likely to accept you.

Once accepted, you can look for more challenging tasks. If you get the opportunity, apply for Google's "Summer of Code" program, which provides funding for contributors to open source projects.

Finally, consider attending a relevant conference or an install party. Attending a conference may provide the opportunity for you to present something and hobnob with other experienced developers. Going to a party can help you to learn more about the way that free software is installed and troubleshot.

By following these tips, you can become an expert free software hacker with dedication and hard work. Take the time to learn the language, follow the rules of the project, find an appropriate project, and stay dedicated. With some hard work and practice, you will soon become an experienced free software hacker.

Carbs: Good or Bad?
In order to understand why low-carbing works, let's first look at how eating carbs affects us physically.

When we eat food high in starch such as breads, pastas, rice, potatoes, cereals, fruits and vegetables containing starches, these foods break down inside our stomachs into simple sugars called glucose.      Glucose travels through blood vessels all around our bodies where it fuels every cell's need for energy.        When there isn't enough glucose available, cells turn to other sources of fuel known as ketones.  Ketones come from fatty acids found in adipocytes (fatty tissue) located beneath skin and between organs. People suffering from bipolar disorder experience periods where they feel normal between each episode; however, during an episode, everything feels completely overwhelming.    There are four main types of bipolar disorders:    Type 1: Episodes of both high and low mood states last several days and require hospitalisation.     Type 2: Episodes of both high-and low-energy states last longer than one day and usually don't need hospital admission.      Cyclothymia: High-energy states alternate with mild depressive states without reaching full-blown manic or depressed phases.        Bipolar II Disorder: Low-energy states alternate with hypomanic episodes lasting less than 4 days.       If you're experiencing signs of bipolar disorder such as:   Extreme irritability Difficulty concentrating Irritated speech Sleep problems Excessive spending Lack of interest in usual activities Increased risk-taking Behavioural issues like gambling, sex addiction etc. Talk to your doctor immediately!

The following steps will help treat a closed fracture until professional medical attention arrives.

Stop Bleeding  Stopping blood flow immediately helps minimize damage to surrounding tissues and reduces the risk of infection.  To do so,  apply pressure directly above the wound using gauze pads or a clean piece of cloth.  Do NOT use butterfly bandages because they don't provide enough support.  You should also try to keep the victim calm since stress increases heart rate and causes blood vessels to constrict, thereby increasing blood flow.    Make sure all dressings stay dry before applying new ones.  Change the dressing every 15 minutes unless the bleeding has stopped completely.  In addition, make sure the patient doesn't get too cold.  Keep him/her warm instead of cool.  Warmth promotes healing processes whereas cooling slows down these processes.  For example, wrap the patient's arm/leg in a blanket or jacket once the bleeding stops.  Don't elevate the limb higher than the level of the heart.  Doing so could cause increased blood flow back into the damaged tissue causing additional trauma.  

Immobilizing the Injury Preventing unnecessary motion of the injured area prevents further injury and allows time for proper treatment.  It does this by keeping the bones together and preventing their displacement.  Once again, immobilization depends upon what part of the body was injured.  However, some general guidelines include:   Avoid putting weight on the injured area.  Restrain the injured limbs gently yet firmly.  Support the injured area with pillows, towels, cushions, etc.  Secure splints or braces to stabilize the joint(s) near the injured area.  Cover the injured area with something soft and comfortable.  Never tape anything tightly across joints.  Tape only loosely along edges of splints/braces.  Take extra precautions

Install an Accumulator/Receiver-Dryer:  The first step after removing any remaining gasoline vapors is installing an accumulator/dryer between the compressor discharge line and the condenser outlet header tank.  These devices contain desiccated material such as silica gel inside them that absorb moisture from the compressed air stream before it enters the condensers.  They also help remove excess water vapor created during compression.  You should never run without these units installed because they protect against corrosion caused by condensation within the lines.     Remove the old dryer and install the new one using the same mounting bracket and clamps.  Be careful about how much force you use while tightening down the clamps; too much could damage the rubber gasket around the drain hole.  Don't forget to connect the charging hose to the top side of the accumulator/dryer!     Replace the Old Orifices Tubes:   After replacing the accumulator/dryers it's time to check the orifice tubes again; make sure they're clean and free of debris!  Then you'll need to replace those that were damaged or worn-out.  You'll probably find two sets of orifice tubes; one set goes directly to each evaporator core and another pair connects both cores together via the expansion valves.  It's important to note here that there must always be equal flow through each orifice tube regardless of whether only one or both fans are running.  Otherwise, the vehicle's temperature control won't function properly.  There are several different types of orifice tubes available depending upon what type of vehicle you own. Integrating functions is often difficult because we must determine how much area under the curve lies between two points.  Integration by parts allows us to split up an integrand (the function being integrated), which makes it easier to integrate.   The process involves taking one part of the integrand as the new “base” or “numerator” in another fraction; this can be done repeatedly until you reach your final answer.    This method works best when integrating rational fractions that are not easily factored out. You don't need special equipment; all you'll need is some open space where you're not likely to get knocked over while practicing this advanced posture.   If you'd like to practice outside of class but aren't quite ready yet, try performing cobra indoors first before moving outdoors (or vice versa). The most common place people perform cobra is during their warm-ups prior to beginning an actual workout routine.    This will help prepare them physically and mentally for what lies ahead.  It also helps improve flexibility throughout... Lie flat on your stomach facing upwards towards the ceiling.... Draw your shoulder blades gently apart,... Bend your neck backward until it's almost touching the floor. ...  Exhale deeply through pursed lips.  Inhale again when you've reached peak height.  Repeat 3-5 times per set.  Don't forget about breathing!   Do 2-3 sets total.  Rest between sets 1-2 minutes.  Practice regularly!  Be patient.  Always listen to your body's signals. .    To do this:  Stand straight with your arms raised above your head.  Turn one foot 45 degrees outward.  Rotate your torso 90 degrees counterclockwise around your hip joint.  Bring your arm opposite your turned leg behind your back.  Extend your free hand upward along side your bent knee.  Continue rotating your torso clockwise 180 degrees.  Return to center.  Repeat 10-12 times per set.  Do 2 sets total.  Rest 1 minute between sets.  Try these exercises once every 3-4 days after warming up.  They'll strengthen your core which makes cobra easier to hold longer without straining too much.  These movements should feel natural and easy--don't force anything.  Focus only on feeling good rather than trying to achieve perfection immediately.  For example,  if you find it difficult to keep your elbows tucked under your ribs, simply bring them closer instead of forcing them further inward.  As long as they're still pointing downwards, they won't interfere with the movement itself.  In fact, they'll actually make it look better because it'll give you something else to focus on besides just holding the pose correctly.  It's okay to cheat here since we're talking about improving our technique anyway.  Just remember to always return to correct positioning whenever possible.

Guardianship 

A guardian takes over parental responsibilities for minor children. Bump keys can be used for many different types of locks.  They work by bumping their way past pins inside the cylinder (the part with numbers) without actually turning them.   This is why they're called bump keys - because instead of using force like other picks do, these keys use pressure from behind to push themselves through the pin tumblers.    The most common type of lock you'll find will have 5 pins arranged around an inner core which rotates when turned.     These pins prevent the outer casing from rotating until the correct combination has been entered correctly.    If you've ever seen someone pick a lock then chances are they've done this by applying pressure directly against...   Purchase a blank key that fits exactly the same as the lock's keyhole pattern.  You may need to purchase several blanks depending upon how often you plan to make bump keys.  Blank keys come in various sizes but usually measure between 3/8 inch (.95 cm.) wide x 1 1/2 inches (3.81cm.)  A good place to buy blank keys online would be:  http://www.locksmithtoolsandsupplies.com/blank-keys/

If you're looking into protecting yourself from competitors copying or selling your invention without paying royalties, then you'll need to file a patent.  A patent gives its owner exclusive rights over their inventions so that they can make money off them by charging others who use it.   This guide will help explain what steps you should take before applying for a patent.    If you've invented something that's not yet available anywhere else but only exists within your mind's eye, it's important first to determine whether this idea could actually become reality....   You may have heard about people claiming they've invented things like flying cars or hoverboards years ago; however these ideas never came true because there was no way to build such devices back then...and even now some might still remain impossible due to technological limitations..    Inventors must also consider practicality when deciding whether they'll pursue developing their invention further..  For example,... 
The United States Patent & Trademark Office (USPTO) defines novelty as:  Something being "new" means "it does not exist elsewhere in nature nor has anything substantially identical thereto ever been disclosed publicly prior to the date of applicant’s application."  In other words,  something can't just look different than what's currently known - it needs to do something completely unique.  Novelty doesn't mean originality;  two products can both be considered novel while one looks nothing alike compared to another.  However,   something that appears very similar to existing technology won't qualify as novel unless there's enough difference between the two to prevent confusion among consumers.   No matter where you live around the world,    you don't own any intellectual property until you register it somewhere.  To get started registering your copyrights internationally, visit www.wipo.int/ipr/technology-transfer/en/support-information/factsheets/trade-marks-patents/copyrights/international-copyright/index.html

Becoming an attorney in California requires a lot of hard work and dedication. If you are interested in pursuing a career in law in the Golden State, here's how to do it:

1. Create a Law School Admission Council (LSAC) account.
The LSAC is the organization that manages the law school application process. You'll need to create an account on their website to get started. This will give you access to all of the resources you need to apply to law school.

2. Register for the Law School Admissions Test (LSAT).
The LSAT is a standardized test that all law school applicants must take. Make sure you register for the right test date and allow yourself plenty of time to prepare. You can find study materials and practice tests on the LSAC website.

3. Prepare for the LSAT.
The LSAT is a challenging test, so give yourself plenty of time to study. Consider taking a prep course or hiring a tutor to help you prepare. Practice tests can also be helpful in getting yourself ready.

4. Apply to accredited law schools.
Once you've taken the LSAT and received your score, it's time to apply to law school. Make sure you research the schools you're interested in and apply to those that are accredited by the American Bar Association (ABA).

5. Devote yourself to your legal education.
Law school is a challenging and demanding experience, so be prepared to work hard. Attend all of your classes, participate in discussions, and ask questions. Make the most of your time in law school by immersing yourself in the subject matter and learning as much as you can.

6. Complete your first-year classes.
Your first year of law school will be focused on core subjects like contracts, torts, and civil procedure. It's important to do well in these classes, as they will lay the foundation for the rest of your legal education.

7. Take part in extracurricular activities including law review and mock trial.
Extracurricular activities like law review and mock trial can help you develop your legal skills and gain practical experience. These activities can also look impressive on your resume when you start applying for jobs.

8. Complete second and third year courses.
In your second and third years of law school, you'll have more freedom to choose the courses that interest you. Take advantage of this opportunity to explore different areas of the law and figure out what you want to specialize in.

9. Work during your summer breaks.
Law firms and other legal organizations often offer summer internships to law students. These can be a great way to gain practical experience and make connections in the legal field.

10. Graduate with a Juris Doctor (J.D.).
After completing all of your coursework and meeting your school's graduation requirements, you'll earn your J.D. degree. This is the degree that will enable you to practice law.

11. Apply to take the California Bar Exam.
In order to become licensed to practice law in California, you'll need to pass the state bar exam. You can apply to take the exam on the California State Bar website.

12. Study for the California Bar Exam.
The California bar exam is notoriously difficult, so give yourself plenty of time to study. There are many test prep materials available, including review courses, practice exams, and study guides.

13. Take the exam.
The California bar exam is administered over two days and includes both multiple choice and essay questions. Make sure you are well-rested and focused during the test.

14. Pass the examination.
If you pass the California bar exam, congratulations! You can now officially practice law in California.

15. Send in a moral character evaluation.
Before you can be admitted to the state bar and practice law in California, you'll need to undergo a moral character evaluation. This is a background check that evaluates your fitness to practice law.

16. Take the Multistate Professional Responsibility Examination (MPRE).
In order to be admitted to the California state bar, you'll also need to pass the MPRE. This is an ethics exam that tests your knowledge of the rules and regulations governing the legal profession.

17. Comply with family support requirements.
Before you can be admitted to the California state bar, you'll need to certify that you are current on any court-ordered family support payments.

18. Provide your Social Security number.
You'll need to provide your Social Security number to the California state bar in order to be admitted to practice law.

19. Look for a job early.
There is a high demand for attorneys in California, but there is also a lot of competition. Start looking for job opportunities as early as possible.

20. Take part in campus interviews.

21. Search online.

23. Attend bar events.

24. Volunteer.
Volunteering for legal aid organizations or other community groups is a great way to gain experience and make connections while giving back to your community.

25. Stay up to date with continuing legal education (CLE) requirements.
In order to maintain your license to practice law in California, you'll need to complete a certain number of hours of continuing legal education each year. Make sure you stay on top of these requirements.

Aquaponics is a combination of aquaculture and hydroponics that allows you to grow plants and raise fish at the same time. Not only is it great for the environment, but it also produces fresh and healthy food for your home. Here's how you can make your own indoor aquaponics system using items from IKEA.

Materials:

- Frame (IKEA RÅSKOG or similar)
- Wire basket (IKEA KNAPPER or similar)
- 25 liter (6.6 US gal) plastic container
- Small 600 lph electric submersible pump
- Male and female threaded adapters
- 25mm-13mm reducer
- 60mm bell siphon
- 100mm media guard
- Ball-valve by-pass
- Growing media (clay pebbles, gravel, or similar)
- Fish (goldfish, tilapia, or similar)
- Plants (lettuce, herbs, or similar)

Instructions:

1. Visit IKEA to purchase the frame. Look for a sturdy and durable frame that can hold the weight of the growing media and water.
2. Use the wire basket as support for the 25 liter plastic container that will house the growbed. The container should fit snugly inside the wire basket and be able to hold the growing media.
3. If you want to personalize the system to fit in with your home décor, now is a good time to do it. Paint or decorate the frame and container to match your style.
4. Use a small 600 lph electric submersible pump in one corner of the fish tank which takes the water up to the growbed. The pump should be placed lower than the growbed to allow the water to flow back down.
5. Obtain male and female threaded adapters. Attach the female adapter to the pump and the male adapter to the top of the growbed.
6. Place the male adapter through the top of the growbed. Make sure it is centered and secure.
7. Observe the 25mm-13mm reducer on the far left of the photo shown below. Attach the 25mm side to the male adapter and the 13mm side to the 60mm bell siphon.
8. Place the 60mm bell siphon in the middle. The bell siphon should be placed higher than the growbed and the 25mm-13mm reducer.
9. Finally, the 100mm media guard, shown on the far right, is simply to keep the growbed media out of the bell siphon. Attach it to the top of the bell siphon.
10. Bell siphons can be tricky to get working. Check online resources or consult an expert for troubleshooting tips if it's not working.
11. Add the ball-valve by-pass. This can help control the flow of water in case the bell siphon fails.
12. Once you have all the framework, the containers, and the plumbing set up, add water into the fish tank and start the pump up. The water will flow through the system, providing nutrients to the plants and oxygenating the water for the fish.
13. Fill the top container (the growbed) with some sort of growing media. You can use clay pebbles, gravel, or another growing medium that is suitable for aquaponics.
14. Once this has been done, you are ready to add the fish and to start putting plants into your system. Follow the guidelines provided for the specific fish and plants you choose.
15. Read up on aquaponics for more details. Do some research to learn more about this sustainable system and how to take care of it properly.
